items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote, US (Remote) About Mixpanel Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com . About the Customer Engineering Team Mixpanel's Customer Engineering teams are analytics consultants who embed themselves within our enterprise customer teams to drive business outcomes. We work with prospects and customers throughout the customer journey to understand what drives value, and serve as the technical counterpart to our Sales organisation to deliver on that value. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Customer Value Architects, Product, Engineering, and Support to successfully roll out self-serve analytics within our customers' organisations, help manage change, execute on technical projects and services that delight our customers, and ultimately drive ROI on the customer's Mixpanel investment. About the Role Our Customer Engineers are inquisitive, nimble, and able to clearly articulate the technical benefits and requirements of Mixpanel to developers and product managers, while also communicating the business value of our product to senior executives. In your first month, you'll become a Mixpanel expert—both in features and functionality as well as implementation. You'll shadow customer calls and demos with current Customer Engineers and Account Executives while learning to articulate our value proposition, and be trained on Mixpanel's internal systems and tools. Within your first three months, you'll be directly involved in deal cycles with Account Executives. You'll lead the technical qualification for customer use cases and deliver customised demos for prospects and existing customers, working directly with leadership at the prospect's organisation to understand business challenges that can be solved through an analytics platform. You'll also work with the prospect's business and technical teams to scope and execute proof-of-concept projects to establish Mixpanel's value—including consulting on data ingestion methods, overall architecture, success criteria, and rollout strategies for analytics tools across an organisation. Responsibilities Serve as a trusted technical advisor for prospects, providing strategic consultation on data architecture, governance, instrumentation, and business outcomes Communicate and consult effectively at all levels of the customer's organisation to earn trust and influence buying decisions Bridge the technical-business gap—working with senior stakeholders to define success for proofs-of-concept and ensuring successful execution and outcomes Leverage your Mixpanel expertise and technical/consultative skills to impart best practices throughout proof-of-concept projects Partner with Account Executives to drive revenue growth, serving as the key technical contact for customers Partner with post-sales teams to ensure that pre-sales value propositions translate into tangible post-sales results Develop relationships and uncover the needs of key technical stakeholders within your assigned book of business Be the "Voice of the Prospect" by collecting feedback from potential Mixpanel customers and sharing it with the Product team We're Looking For Someone Who Has Fluency in business and conversational Spanish and English. The ability to communicate with stakeholders at all levels—from discussing APIs with developers to organisational efficiency with CIOs. A demonstrated track record of qualifying and selling technical solutions to executive stakeholders 6+ years of experience in a Software-as-a-Service Sales Engineering or related role Experience in data querying, modelling, and transformation using tools such as SQL, dbt, Python, Business Intelligence platforms, or Product Analytics tools Familiarity with databases and cloud data warehouses (e.g., Google Cloud, Amazon Redshift, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Databricks) A successful record of experience in sales engineering, consulting, or technical project management Excellent written, analytical, communication, and presentation skills Strong process and project delivery discipline Proficiency with AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code, Gemini The ability to travel as needed Bonus Points For Experience with value engineering frameworks: translating customer pain into quantified business outcomes, building ROI calculators, and leading executive-level value conversations tied to measurable KPIs Exposure to product-led growth (PLG) environments and sales-assisted conversion motions Background in high-growth SaaS environments (Series B–E or beyond) #LI-Remote Compensation The amount listed below is the total target cash compensation (TTCC) and includes base compensation and variable compensation in the form of either a company bonus or commissions. Variable compensation type is determined by your role and level. In addition to the cash compensation provided, this position is also eligible for equity consideration and other benefits including medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage. You can view our benefits offerings here . Our salary ranges are determined by role and level and are benchmarked to data released by Radford, a global compensation database. The range displayed represents the minimum and maximum TTCC. To stay on top of market conditions, we refresh our salary ranges twice a year so these ranges may change in the future. Within the range, individual pay is determined by experience, job-related skills, qualifications, and other factors. If you have questions about the specific range, your recruiter can share this information. Pay Range $184,500 — $217,000 USD Benefits and Perks Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care Mental Wellness Benefit Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays Enhanced Parental Leave Volunteer Time Off Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break *please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary* Culture Values Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress. Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes. One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone. Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations. Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star. Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible. Why choose Mixpanel? We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions. Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mixpanel-senior-customer-engineer-latam-spanish-speaking

items.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We’re looking for someone to join our team in Lead Generation Strategy & Operations and play a key role in scaling our go-to-market operations. This role is at the intersection of technical problem-solving and operational excellence, focusing on building and maintaining tools, automations, and dashboards that empower our sales, data, and product teams to execute with precision. As part of the Revenue Operations team, you'll collaborate across functions to design and implement systems that streamline sales processes, enhance decision-making, and drive growth. The GTM Strategy and Operations team operates as strategic advisors to key cross-functional partners, podded by functional area (pre- vs. post-sale) to drive revenue acceleration, insights, and business growth. This is an exciting opportunity to bring technical and analytical expertise to a fast-paced, impactful environment. In this role, you will be responsible for: E2E Process Management - Build and maintain strategic automations and standardized processes that support cross-functional teams and promote consistency and adoption. Cross-Functional Collaboration - Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Events, Partner) to drive initiatives that enhance revenue generation and operational effectiveness. Leadership Partnership - Serve as a trusted partner to leadership, providing strategic insights, actionable recommendations, and performance reporting. Experimentation - Develop and test new ideas, workflows, and sources that improve critical levers within each functional area. Data-Driven Strategy - Oversee analytics and performance analyses across pre-sales functions. Identify areas of opportunity and acceleration; build dashboards and insights that inform experimentation and guide lever improvement. Reporting & Analytics - Lead the design and management of dashboards, reports, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure and enhance team performance. Who you are We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You’ll strive with us if you: Are passionate about audio AI driven by a desire to make content universally accessible and breaking the frontiers of new tech. Are a highly motivated and driven individual with a strong work ethic. Our team is aware of this critical moment of audio AI evolution and is committed to going the extra mile to lead. Are analytical, efficient, and strive on solving complex challenges with a first principles mindset. Consistently strive for excellence , delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations. Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside. What you bring 4+ years of Revenue Operations at high-growth technology companies Proven track record of developing and implementing end-to-end solutions, from data collection and analysis to execution. Can break complex problems into smaller, actionable solution steps Strong analytical skills, with proven expertise in SQL and data visualization using BI tools (e.g. Sigma) Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Highly adaptable, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement. Strong coachability and willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote, California, United States, AMER From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. About the Role The Director of AMER Enterprise Sales Field Operations is the primary operations partner to the VP of AMER Enterprise Sales. You will own the operating rhythm of the region: forecasting, pipeline generation and inspection, and business reviews. You will also shape the region's go-to-market strategy, expansion plans, and capacity model. In this role, you will act as the COO to the VP of AMER Enterprise Sales, ensuring our business is growing efficiently and effectively. You need to think strategically about the Enterprise business, understanding the implications of changing market and team dynamics and proactively developing solutions that enable us to win. You will lead a team of three field operations managers and analysts. Success in this role means a more accurate forecast, a healthier pipeline, measurable gains in rep productivity, and increasing ARR across AMER Enterprise. The work you do will shape how Fivetran grows in the Americas. This role sits within the GTM Strategy and Operations organization. What You’ll Do Forecasting and pipeline Own the AMER Enterprise forecast process, including call methodology, roll-up, and accuracy tracking against commit and best case, giving leadership a number they can commit to with confidence. Drive pipeline generation planning: with the marketing, partner, and sales leadership teams set coverage targets by segment and source, track progress, and flag gaps early enough to act, so each quarter starts with the pipeline needed to hit plan. Run pipeline inspection with sales leadership, focusing on deal quality, stage progression, and slippage, so risk surfaces while there is still time to save the deal. Operating cadence and performance management Design and run the region's operating cadence: weekly forecast calls, pipeline reviews, monthly business reviews, and quarterly business reviews. Continuously refine those cadences so they drive decisions rather than reporting. Run AE performance reviews with frontline and second-line managers, using consistent metrics to identify coaching needs and performance risk, so managers act on facts rather than anecdotes. Identify and prioritize the metrics the field uses to run the business, and partner with GTM Analytics to build and maintain the supporting dashboards, giving every leader in the region a shared view of performance. Lead deep-dive investigations into performance questions, and turn findings into specific recommendations that change how the region sells. Regional strategy Shape GTM strategy and org structure for AMER Enterprise by region and sales motion, setting the team up to win as enterprise AI demand grows. Build the analysis behind regional expansion decisions, such as which territories to enter next and in what sequence, so we invest where the opportunity is largest. Design region- and motion-specific SPIFFs, then measure whether they changed behavior and results. Annual planning and capacity (in partnership with Strategy and Planning) Support quota setting for the region, bringing field context to top-down targets so quotas are both ambitious and attainable. Support and refine territory carving so territories are balanced and match the coverage model. Pressure-test assumptions in the bottoms-up headcount model and coverage ratios, so hiring plans reflect real field performance. Validate rep productivity and ramp assumptions against actual performance data. Team leadership Lead, hire, and develop a team of field operations managers and analysts and grow them into strategic partners to sales leadership. Set clear priorities for the team and allocate its capacity against the needs of AMER Enterprise leadership. Who you'll work with VP of AMER Enterprise Sales and their leadership team: your primary stakeholders and day-to-day partners. Strategy and Planning: annual plan, quota, territory, and capacity modeling. Revenue Operations: CRM, systems, process, and data integrity. GTM Analytics: dashboards, reporting, and analytical deep dives. Enablement: onboarding, ramp, and skill gaps surfaced through performance reviews. Skills We’re Looking For 8+ years in sales operations, sales strategy, management consulting, or a related analytical role, including 4+ years supporting enterprise sales teams directly. 4+ years managing people, ideally analysts or operations managers. Track record of owning a forecast process and improving its accuracy. Experience running sales operating cadences and business reviews with senior sales leaders. Working knowledge of annual planning: quota setting, territory design, capacity and coverage modeling, and ramp assumptions. Strong analytical skills, including building models in spreadsheets and working with CRM and BI data (for example, Salesforce, Tableau, Looker, or SQL). Ability to turn analysis into a clear recommendation and defend it with sales leaders. Bonus Skills​ Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with a consumption-based or usage-based pricing model. Experience designing sales incentive programs or SPIFFs. Experience supporting regional expansion or new-segment launches. Prior experience as the dedicated operations partner to a regional sales leader. Perks and Benefits 100% employer-paid medical insurance * Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. RSU stock grants* Professional development and training opportunities Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities Monthly cell phone stipend Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. * May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region. We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion , but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream . Read about us in Forbes . Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities. To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video. To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here . We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form . We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/fivetran-director-enterprise-sales-field-operations-americas

items.description: Company Description At Turner & Townsend we’re passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people to realise their potential, and doing our part to create a prosperous society. Every day we help our major global clients deliver ambitious and highly technical projects, in over 130 countries worldwide. Our team is dynamic, innovative, and client-focused, supported by an inclusive and fun company culture. Our clients value our proactive approach, depth of expertise, integrity and the quality we deliver. As a result, our people get to enjoy working on some of the most exciting projects in the world. Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com Job Description Due to increased workload and securing new contracts within the aviation sector, Turner & Townsend has a new opportunity for a Senior Consultant, specialising in IM and data management, to join our team. Our team are recognised as global experts in the development and deployment of IM on major projects and programmes, delivering client outcomes which mutually benefit the supply chain and add value to projects. The approach underpinning our delivery is: Forward thinking Careful and proactive planning Shared understanding Transparency and collaboration Independent and open methodology We work holistically with our wider business to provide an environment for innovation and deliver success on projects where IM is core to the delivery and operation of assets. We lead the IM process at organisational, programme and project level through: Discovery and understanding Client adoption strategy and strategic project setup Project and programme IM execution planning IM implementation and supply chain management IM compliance checking and data verification Our specialist staff work globally, using cutting edge tools and techniques to deliver the vision of the world’s best clients. The Opportunity The individual will have the opportunity to work alongside a highly skilled team delivering and implementing Information Management from strategy level to project, programme and portfolio level for aviation clients. Our current openings are specifically for opportunities in aviation. You do not need specific sector experience, but it is favourable. Key Responsibilities To fulfil the duties of a Senior Consultant, specialising in IM, the candidate will be able to: Strategy Development: Capture client requirements to design and author bespoke IM strategies and workflows that align with industry best practices, including the need to produce documentation with an understanding of their inclusion in contracts and appointments. Implementation Leadership: Manage the rollout of IM methodologies across programs and projects, ensuring successful adoption by clients, design teams, and contractors. Technical Assurance: Conduct structured model reviews, clash detection, and data analysis to mitigate risks and ensure delivery against project requirements. Stakeholder Management: Facilitate workshops and interface with project partners to communicate strategies and act as an ambassador for digital services. Commercial & Business Support: Create bid proposals, write business case, and contribute to the development of internal documentation and quality processes. Team Supervision: Lead teams by peer-reviewing deliverables, supporting colleagues, and maintaining high quality standards. Qualifications Experience & Technical Skills Professional Experience: Minimum of 3+ years in a IM Manager role, preferably with a strong understanding of consultancy environments and project lifecycles focused with assets Standards Compliance: Deep working knowledge of BS EN ISO 19650, the Information Management Initiative Framework (IMI Framework, Formally UK BIM Framework), and industry information management standards. 3D Authoring: Proficiency in industry leading 3D modelling software such as Revit or ArchiCAD for interrogation. Coordination & Validation: Expert use of clash detection and model checking tools like Solibri and Navisworks. Common Data Environment (CDE) Experience: Strong experience of CDE platforms such as Autodesk Forma (Formerly ACC), Mfiles and Maximo, to manage information flow, document control, and project collaboration. Reporting: Proficiency with data visualisation tools like Power BI or Tableau to create dashboards and interpret project metrics. Data Verification: Ability to analyse and validate model data, including an understanding of COBie data requirements. Emerging Technology: Understanding of the wider technology market to support client delivery and drive research and development. Personal skills Stakeholder Communication: Ability to facilitate workshops, act as a digital ambassador, and interface effectively with clients, design teams, and contractors. Leadership & Influence: Proven capability to lead teams, champion digital services, and manage complex stakeholder relationships. Critical Thinking: A proactive approach to identifying risks, proposing appropriate mitigations, and analysing complex requirements. Inquisitive Mindset: A strong desire to research the emerging technology market and continuously learn new software skills. Autonomy & Drive: Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and maintains self-motivation to meet deadlines. Team Collaboration: Ability to work effectively within diverse, multi-skilled teams to achieve shared project goals. Qualifications: Preferably educated to degree level or with sufficient demonstrable workplace experience to satisfy the requirements of the role. Additional Information Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change. _We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance._ Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community. Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/ #LI-VF1 #LI-Hybrid SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable. No recruitment agency working with Turner & Townsend will ask candidates to pay a fee at any time._ _Any unsolicited resumes/CVs submitted through our website or to Turner & Townsend personal e-mail accounts, are considered property of Turner & Townsend and are not subject to payment of agency fees. Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Service Bus experience. Experience working with Microsoft Azure integration services. Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipeline experience. Improve solution performance, maintainability, and user adoption. Reduce recurring issues through effective troubleshooting and root cause analysis. Support the growth of the Dynamics 365 capability through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and technical leadership. Contribute to customer satisfaction, retention, and continued service growth opportunities. Ensure solutions are aligned with Microsoft best practices, governance standards, and operational support requirements. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policiesÂ EducationalÂ assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red HatÂ Reward schemes including Version 1âs Annual Excellence Awards & âCall-Outâ platform.Â Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.Â And many more exciting benefitsâ¦ drop us a note to find out more.Â â¯Â Â VersionÂ 1 is an equal opportunities employer.Â We are committed to building a diverse,Â inclusiveÂ and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.Â We want every candidate to have a positive and accessible recruitment experience. items.description: StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels. The Manager of Client Analytics Partnership (CAP) for APAC is a leadership role combining people management, high-touch client engagement, and deep technical expertise in the programmatic advertising ecosystem. Reporting to the VP of Global Data & Analytics, you will lead the APAC Client Analytics Partnership team delivering strategic client reporting, advanced data insights, and custom measurement solutions across APAC regions. This role is highly client-facing and relationship-driven . As a trusted measurement consultant, you will partner directly with key client executives, lead strategic discovery workshops, and translate complex business goals into sophisticated, data-driven analytics frameworks. You will also bring strong technical depth and comprehensive mastery of programmatic media and adtech measurement to hands-on support for high-priority strategic partnerships. StackAdapt is a remote-first company; however, for this position, we are prioritizing candidates based in Singapore to enable regular, in-person collaboration with key regional clients and partners. What you will be doing: Lead and mentor the Client Analytics Partnership (CAP) team across APAC, establishing strategic goals and fostering team development. Serve as the primary measurement consultant for Sales and Client Service leads, driving executive-level conversations across APAC enterprise accounts and agency holdcos. Provide technical guidance and direct support on high-priority client partnerships, measurement testing plans, learning agendas, and custom attribution frameworks. Translate complex regional analytics requirements to scaled solutions teams and product team to build scalable, high-impact client deliverables and data pipelines. Help support recruitment and GTM of prioritised initiatives to feed the pipeline of potential case study candidates. Collaborate with NORAM analytics leads to build enterprise-level measurement tactics, ensure efficient cross-regional project alignment, and represent APAC market needs globally. Advises on measurement strategy and planning in key new business development, and directly participates in client pitches. Represent APAC market needs to identify region-specific nuances in GTM materials. What you’ll bring to the table: 6+ years of experience in analytics, strategy, or data insights roles within adtech, media, or digital marketing. Deep programmatic expertise with proven mastery in multi-channel campaign measurement, DSP/SSP data structures, and translating raw programmatic data into strategic business recommendations. Knowledge of regional ad policies and guardrails on privacy and data governance laws. Strong technical depth with proficiency in data visualization and analytics tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, advanced Excel), with the ability to interface effectively with data architects and engineering teams. Proven client-facing experience partnering with major media agency holding companies and enterprise advertisers across complex multi-market environments. Exceptional data storytelling and executive communication skills, with a track record of influencing C-suite and senior marketing decision-makers. People management experience or a strong track record as a player-coach leading cross-functional strategic initiatives. Deep understanding of measurement methodologies and strategies , including incrementality, brand and engagement lift, test design, attribution models (including the limitations of last-touch attribution and application of multi-touch attribution), and marketing mix modelling (MMM). The compensation range listed for this role reflects the expected base salary for candidates located in the posting country based on a global rate. It is informed by market data and the approved budget for this position. StackAdapt maintains different compensation ranges for roles across other countries and regions, and final offers will be aligned to the candidate’s current location. We do not ask c andidates about current or prior salary history, and we will not use such information, if volunteered, in setting an offer. This range represents base salary only. Depending on the role, candidates may also be eligible for additional compensation such as annual bonuses, commissions, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits package. Factors Influencing Final Compensation: The final compensation offer will be determined by a variety of factors, which may include, but are not limited to: the candidate's specific experience, technical skills, knowledge, abilities, and relevant education, licensure, and certifications. Other business factors, such as organizational needs and budget alignment, may also be considered in the final offer. items.description: Counterpart Health is an AI‑powered physician enablement platform that delivers clinical insights to providers at the point of care. Our flagship product, Counterpart Assistant, is embedded into clinicians’ workflows and integrates with EHR systems, helping care teams drive value-based outcomes, close care gaps, and proactively manage chronic disease. As we grow our data ecosystem, expanding across legacy interoperability networks, QHIN/TEFCA connectivity, and direct HIE integrations, we need rigorous analytical ownership to ensure the clinical data powering our platform is complete, reliable, and actionable. You will serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for clinical data completeness and effectiveness at Counterpart Health. Sitting within the Data Products pillar, this role owns the end-to-end understanding of our clinical data lifecycle: where data comes from, where it breaks down, and how each vendor or integration pathway performs across our customer markets. Your analysis will directly shape vendor strategy, facility targeting, and data pipeline investments, thus ensuring that the clinical evidence our care teams depend on is consistently available and trustworthy. As a Data Analyst, you will: Proactively identify and monitor which healthcare facilities consistently generate high-quality, usable clinical documents (e.g., EHRs, discharge summaries, procedure notes) to precisely locate and quantify data gaps. Conduct deep-dive analyses by mapping and correlating facility-specific data across disparate sources like structured claims, clinical care summaries (CCDAs), and ADT messages to uncover systematic patterns of missingness, latency, Experience with TEFCA/QHIN frameworks and evolving national interoperability standards. Familiarity with vendor-specific data exchange platforms (e.g., Bamboo Health, HSX, Particle Health, Kno2). Background in value-based care, population health, or clinical data operations. Experience with claims-clinical data reconciliation (e.g., matching EOBs to clinical encounter records). Comfort working with Python or similar tools for data manipulation and automation. or incongruence in clinical records. Establish and maintain clear, transparent reporting on ADT coverage across key geographic, organizational, and technological dimensions (e.g., by county, facility, and underlying EMR system). Based on rigorous analysis of data flow and quality, recommend and guide the implementation of optimal technical configurations for existing data vendors (e.g., Bamboo Health, PCC, Experian, HSX). Conduct comprehensive evaluations and proof-of-concepts for potential new data integration technologies (e.g., Kno2 vs. Particle Health) to assess viability, quality improvements, and strategic fit. Systematically determine the existence and completeness of documentation associated with specific patient visits or encounters. Develop a data-driven framework for prioritizing facility targets for direct data acquisition, assessing impact, cost-effectiveness, and technical feasibility. Inform and guide vendor strategy around national initiatives such as TEFCA and QHIN adoption, ensuring Counterpart Health is positioned for compliant, high-quality data exchange. Partner cross-functionally with Product Managers to define data requirements, Engineers to implement reliable pipelines, and Clinical teams to validate data quality and clinical utility. Act as a critical liaison to identify and remove operational and technical bottlenecks, ensuring a predictable, scalable, and reliable clinical data flow across all customer markets. You should get in touch if you have: 2+ years of hands-on data analytics experience, with direct exposure to healthcare data interoperability Strong hands-on experience with healthcare data standards: HL7, CCDA, and ADT messages. Proficiency in SQL and comfort working with large, complex datasets (claims, clinical logs, interoperability data). Background in analyzing interoperability networks (e.g., Carequality, CommonWell, eHealthExchange) or HIE integrations. Skilled at data visualization and able to present complex findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong investigative mindset, i.e., you enjoy digging into the “why” behind missing data and diverging metrics. Self-directed and able to manage multiple analytical projects (vendor comparisons, visit-level reconciliation) without constant supervision. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with TEFCA/QHIN frameworks and evolving national interoperability standards. Familiarity with vendor-specific data exchange platforms (e.g., Bamboo Health, HSX, Particle Health, Kno2). Background in value-based care, population health, or clinical data operations. Experience with claims-clinical data reconciliation (e.g., matching EOBs to clinical encounter records). Comfort working with Python or similar tools for data manipulation and automation. Benefits Overview : Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions. Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare. Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location. Professional Development : Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews. Additional Perks: Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities Reimbursement for office setup expenses Monthly cell phone & internet stipend Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams Paid parental leave for all new parents And much more! About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions. Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care. With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software. Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility. #LI-REMOTE Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company. Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is: $77,000—$100,000 USD

items.description: About WOO X WOO X is a global centralised crypto trading platform offering spot and perpetual futures trading. With roots in quantitative trading, we focus on the details that matter to traders: liquidity, execution quality, and reliable tools. Transparency is part of the product. Our live Proof of Reserves & Liabilities dashboard gives users visibility into reported platform assets and user liabilities. Our team is fully remote. We’re looking for people who know their craft, are curious about the business, and want a hand in improving how the exchange works. About the role We’re looking for a Senior Data Engineer to maintain and develop WOO X’s data platform. You’ll build the pipelines and data models that make exchange data reliable and useful for analytics, reporting, and day-to-day business decisions. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a focus on platform engineering. You’ll work with engineering and business colleagues to understand how data is produced and used, address quality issues, and make the platform easier to maintain as requirements evolve. What you’ll do Build and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines using Python, SQL, Kafka, and Spark. Develop and operate Airflow workflows, including scheduling, dependency management, retries, and recovery. Design and maintain data models and warehouse datasets for analytics and reporting. Improve data quality and freshness through validation, monitoring, and investigation of upstream and downstream issues. Optimise pipeline and query performance, and manage processing and storage costs. Work with data users to define datasets and metrics, and document data flows, transformations, and dependencies. What you’ll bring Data engineering experience within crypto or Web3, including responsibility for production pipelines or a data platform. Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience building maintainable data processing workflows. Hands-on experience with Airflow, Kafka, and Spark. Experience with data warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data modelling. The ability to investigate data discrepancies, troubleshoot pipeline failures, and resolve underlying causes. The ability to work independently and communicate technical details and business requirements clearly in Mandarin. Nice to have Experience at a centralised crypto exchange, particularly with trading, order, or account data. BI experience, including supporting dashboards, defining metrics, or preparing datasets for business users. Strong English communication skills. Working with us This role is fully remote within APAC, with Mandarin as the team’s main working language. You’ll work on a data platform connected to the daily operations of a crypto exchange and help colleagues get dependable answers from its data. If you enjoy building data systems and understanding how people use them, we’d like to hear from you.

items.description: Who are we? At UpGuard , we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process around 10 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk. We build the Risk Operations Center, the AI platform where lean security teams run cyber risk end to end. It combines security ratings, threat intelligence and AI agents to give teams one view of risk across their vendors, attack surface and workforce. We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale. Where does this role fit in? UpGuard has recently replatformed its analytics stack onto a greenfield foundation built on BigQuery, dbt, infrastructure as code in OpenTofu, CI/CD through GitHub, and a governed semantic layer that both people and AI agents query. We are seeking an experienced data engineer to help take that platform to the next level. Reporting to the Director of Data Engineering, this role is the strong technical lead within the data engineering team. You will work under the Director's guidance to evolve the platform and raise its engineering standards, and you will set the example for how the team builds, reviews and ships. The platform has a broad contributor and consumer base. Analysts, data scientists and business teams build on it, query it and increasingly reach it through AI agents. Keeping those stakeholders well served and satisfied is a central measure of success in this role. What will you do? Technical Leadership: Act as the senior technical voice within the data engineering team by guiding design decisions, reviewing code, mentoring engineers and contributing to the platform roadmap set by the team. Platform Evolution: Help take UpGuard's recently built GCP data platform to its next stage, proposing and delivering improvements to scale, reliability, performance, cost and AI workflows. Engineering Standards & CI/CD: Raise engineering standards across the platform, and build and maintain the CI/CD pipelines, PR checks, BI model validation and developer environments that keep changes safe to ship. Stakeholder Engagement & Satisfaction: Treat the analysts, data scientists, and business teams who depend on the platform as customers. Understand their needs, scope and prioritise requests with them, set clear expectations, follow through on commitments, and track how well the platform serves them. Contributor Enablement: Support the growing group of analysts, data scientists and business users who contribute dbt code, through onboarding, documentation, AI agents, review practices and developer tooling that make good contributions the easy path. Data Integration: Design, build and maintain reliable pipelines that bring data from internal systems (CRM, billing, support, marketing automation and product events) and third-party sources into BigQuery using managed connectors, event streams and vendor APIs, and write data back to operational systems where needed. Platform Operations & Maintenance: Manage infrastructure as code in OpenTofu, run containerised workloads on Docker and Kubernetes, maintain build scheduling and deployment pipelines, and keep the platform monitored, patched and well documented. dbt Development: Author and review dbt models across the staging, source-level and business-level layers, and uphold the team's conventions for modelling, grain testing and documentation. Data Quality: Implement and maintain data tests, source freshness checks, observability and alerting, and take part in incident response so that problems are caught and fixed before stakeholders find them. Data Governance & Privacy: Implement access controls as code, process access requests, and apply data classification, PII masking, audit logging and data subject request handling in line with the team's governance policies. AI Enablement & Conversational Analytics: Build and operate the data, semantic layer and tooling that power conversational analytics and AI agents, including MCP access, context and evaluation that let LLMs query structured and unstructured business data accurately and safely. What will you bring? Proven Experience: 5+ years in data engineering, including significant hands-on work on a production cloud data platform. Technical Leadership: Experience as a tech lead or senior engineer guiding the work of others through design review, code review and mentoring. AI Fluency: Fluency using AI/LLM tools to accelerate development, review and documentation. Stakeholder & Consulting Skills: A track record of engaging stakeholders, scoping ambiguous requests, managing expectations and communicating clearly with technical and non-technical audiences. dbt Expertise: Very strong, hands-on dbt development covering modular modelling, testing, macros, packages, snapshots, documentation and performance tuning at scale. Experience with a semantic layer such as MetricFlow, Omni’s YAML or LookML is valued. Infrastructure as Code: Experience managing cloud infrastructure with OpenTofu, CDK or Terraform. Containers & Orchestration: Confidence running workloads on Docker and Kubernetes, ideally GKE. Experience with Dimensional Data Modeling techniques and complexities Data Integration: Experience with managed ingestion tools such as Fivetran or Airbyte, event pipelines such as Segment or Pub/Sub, and REST APIs. Data Quality & Governance: Practical experience implementing data testing, observability tooling such as Elementary, access controls and data masking. BigQuery: Deep working knowledge of BigQuery, including partitioning, clustering, cost and quota management, IAM and complex SQL. Proven ability to implement PII detection, masking, role-based access control (RBAC), and automated data lifecycle policies in modern cloud data platforms. What will give you an edge? Conversational Analytics & AI Management: Experience building or operating conversational analytics, MCP servers, retrieval or tool-calling layers for LLM agents, or evaluation frameworks that measure the accuracy of AI answers on business data. B2B SaaS Experience: Experience working within a software organisation, ideally a B2B SaaS business, and familiarity with metrics such as ARR, NRR/GRR, pipeline and churn. CRM Systems: A firm understanding of CRM data models such as HubSpot or Salesforce, including deals, pipelines, lifecycle stages and property history, and how that data flows into analytics. Modern BI: Familiarity with Looker, Omni or a comparable modern BI tool, and an understanding of how semantic models and BI layers consume warehouse data. Data governance experience in heavily regulated industries or access control around highly sensitive data Hands-on experience designing data architectures compliant with GDPR , the Australian Privacy Act , or similar global privacy regulations (e.g., CCPA/CPRA). UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work! Apply now to find out why! As an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Please Note: Not all roles can be performed from the United States. Please check your specific job listing to confirm its advertised location. If the role you are applying for is listed as based in the US, we are currently only able to support hiring in the following locations: CA, CO, FL, IL, MA, MD, MO, OR, PA, TX, WA, and DC. Before starting work with us, you will need to undertake a national police history check and reference checks.

items.description: Job Title: PhD Scientist - STEM Expert Job Type: Contractor Location: Remote(Worldwide) Commitment: Flexible — fits alongside your current role Location: Fully remote You’ll need: A completed PhD in a STEM field, plus hands-on research experience Your tasks: Build difficult technical problems from your own research and define what makes an answer correct These tasks are hard to build, and that’s the point. We’re looking for people with genuine depth in their field: the problems where the textbook answer isn’t enough, where the right approach depends on reading the constraints correctly, where a plausible-looking answer is quietly wrong. Required Skills Research Data Analysis Experimental Design Scientific Writing Statistical Analysis Laboratory Skills Wet Lab Clinical Research MATLAB Python SolidWorks Biostatistics Epidemiology Clinical Trials Data Visualization Spectroscopy Chromatography What you’ll do Design difficult technical problems drawn from your own research area, with realistic constraints and supporting data. Provide the correct solution and walk through the reasoning that gets there. Define objective criteria for correctness, so another researcher reviewing the work would reach the same verdict. Review problems built by other contributors for technical accuracy and soundness of method. Flag problems that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable rather than submitting them. What we’re looking for Completed PhD in a STEM field. This is a hard requirement. Hands-on research experience — work you did yourself, not work you read about. Wet lab, research lab, or academic experience is strongly preferred. Able to explain why an answer is correct clearly enough that another researcher could verify it. Publications or a record of research contribution is a strong plus. Prior experience on AI training or evaluation projects is a plus, not a requirement. How the selection process works Apply and complete the screening questions Complete the AI interview for this role — it’s how your expertise gets in front of the client Profile review Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up Originally posted on Himalayas

From the first patient interactions with digital intake forms to the final insurance processing and post-visit communication, our system supports docto
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Utah URL: https://www.chirocat.com/ About Us and Why We're Hiring We're ChiroCat, and we build cloud-based chiropractic software that practices across the United States love and trust. From the first patient interactions with digital intake forms to the final insurance processing and post-visit communication, our system supports doctors and their staff every step of the way. We’re modernizing the chiropractic software space in big ways, but much more importantly, we’re bettering the lives of our doctors, their team members, and especially their patients. The bottom line: we LOVE to help people who help people. And that’s where you come in! We’re building something special at ChiroCat; both with our product and the people behind it. We’re not like “the other guys,” and our customers know it. They tell us, and more and more, they’re telling their peers about ChiroCat, too. But truth be told, we haven’t done a great job of showcasing what sets us apart to the rest of the world. And now we want everyone to feel that from the first time they come across us. That’s where you come in! We’re hiring our first dedicated marketer. If you’re the right fit, you know that a brand is much more than a logo, voice is more than just words, and a website isn’t just a funnel. You’re a skilled writer and will help us find our voice and strengthen it. You’ve been around the block and know how to build a strategy toward a better future, but you’re not satisfied to sit behind reports and dashboards. You’re excited to roll up your sleeves and start doing the work yourself. Website, ads, social, email, internal guidelines, in-app messaging: you’ll touch all of it. And as we grow, your opportunity grows with us. What We're Looking For REQUIREMENTS For this role, you must: Have at least 4 years of hands-on marketing experience, including real ownership of brand, messaging, and content (not just executing someone else’s plan) Be an exceptional writer who can adapt to a brand’s voice, and have samples to show us Have hands-on experience running paid social campaigns: building them, testing creative, and improving results based on what the numbers tell you Have experience managing a company’s social media presence, including engaging with the community, and not just publishing posts Be comfortable writing and updating website and landing page content in a CMS (Currently Webflow) Be self-directed: you can take an ambiguous list of needs, decide what matters most, and make a case for it; continuously iterating your way toward excellence Be a thoughtful communicator in written and spoken forms. It’s an art you enjoy improving! Love to learn. In short order, you’ll need to get fluent in the world of chiropractic, medical practices, and the people who run them. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS These aren't required, but will help you stand out: Marketing experience in healthcare, medical practice, or B2B SaaS Experience shaping or refreshing a brand’s voice, messaging, or identity Experience leading a small team, or managing freelancers and agencies Design skills (Figma, Canva, or similar). If you use AI design tools, you use them with enough taste that nobody can tell. Experience with email marketing platforms and in-app messaging tools (we use Intercom) Experience managing online reviews and reputation (G2, Capterra, Google) Comfort making short-form video Familiarity with chiropractic care. (Being a happy chiropractic patient counts a little.) Note: If you believe you’re a fit, but don’t meet our preferred qualifications, still apply! We’re more interested in finding the right person, than the perfect resume. Life at ChiroCat ChiroCat started with a simple mission: Empowering caregivers to transform lives through tools they trust. In an industry dominated by big conglomerates or funding-dependent startups, we're privately owned and stable. That means we can run our business as we choose. Our culture is built on genuine care for our customers, each other, and the meaningful work we do. HOW YOU'LL WORK AT CHIROCAT Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We’re based in southern Utah, but most of our team works remotely. This role is open to candidates located in U.S. time zones (Pacific, Mountain, Central, Eastern) or internationally within UTC-8 to UTC-4. You’ll need to live in one of these time zones, since this role requires strong overlap with our team and customers. Working these hours from elsewhere won’t qualify. Balanced Work, Balanced Life: We work a standard 40-hour week and are fans of legitimately unplugging after hours. We're in this for the long haul and want you rested and focused. Exceptions exist, but we mostly work standard business hours in our local time zone. Take Vacation (Seriously): Most team members take three to four weeks per year — real vacations where you're not tied to your laptop or phone. We'll look forward to seeing pictures in our team #water-cooler channel! Great Benefits: We offer fantastic health, dental, and vision insurance, with 100% of the premium covered for you and affordable rates for dependents. This is a salaried role with a starting salary of $95k–$130k a year. Most new hires start in the lower to middle part of that range, and the top end is reserved for the rare candidates with truly exceptional, deep, and directly relevant experience. You’ll Make a Real Impact: This role will have an incredible impact on the lives of our doctors and staff, not to mention the patients they serve. You’ll be instrumental in helping chiropractors find and trust ChiroCat as their EHR of choice. ChiroCat is the core of their business and their ability to serve patients, so their success with ChiroCat has far-reaching implications. Additionally, we're growing, and the road ahead is exciting. You'd be joining at a stage where you can meaningfully shape our brand and voice, perception in the market, and our trajectory. That kind of impact doesn't come along often. And do it with Great People: We're firm believers that the foundation of success is building a great team. You’ll be joining a team full of truly exceptional people. The kind you’ll be excited to work with and learn to care about. People who get stuff done. Who are genuine to their core. Who hold humility and confidence equally well at the same time. Who support each other and care deeply about our customers. It’s a strong culture that’s apparent the moment you walk through the [digital] door. And we can’t wait to see how you’ll make us even better. If this sounds like your ideal environment, read on because now we’ll dig into the role itself. What You'll Do at ChiroCat At ChiroCat, marketing isn’t about being the loudest voice in the room. It’s about being the most trustworthy one. Chiropractors get plenty of noise from software vendors: big promises, long contracts, and slick ads for products that feel twenty years old. We want people to meet the real ChiroCat, the same one our customers already know. Everything we put into the world should sound like us, look like us, and be true. Your early focus will be brand: making sure that whatever someone sees of ChiroCat, whether it’s our website, our ads, our social posts, our reviews, or the messages inside our app, gives them an accurate (and awesome) picture of who we are. Next up is widening the funnel and building our inbound lead flow. Down the road, perhaps you’ll build a marketing team, one amazing hire at a time, but let’s not get ahead of ourselves. This role reports to the CEO and works closely with our Head of Customer Success, our CTO, and our Sales team. A TYPICAL WEEK MIGHT INCLUDE: Rewriting a page of our website so it sounds like us, and not like every other EHR vendor Taking over our Facebook ads from our CEO (Psst… he’s relieved, and honestly, so are the ads and the people viewing them!) Jumping into a Facebook group thread where chiropractors are comparing software, and being genuinely curious and helpful instead of defensive or salesy. Planning next week’s social posts, and making sure at least one of them shows off the people behind ChiroCat (our team is way more fun than our current feed suggests); next week you’ll execute that plan. Working with our Customer Success team to rewrite in-app messages so new customers feel like they’re hearing from ChiroCat, not a robot Responding to a G2 review thoughtfully and honestly Sitting in on a sales call or reading through support chats to hear how chiropractors actually describe their problems Briefing a designer on next week’s ad creative, or making it yourself Drafting an email campaign that people actually want to open Bringing a proposal to the CEO: “Here’s what I think we should work on first, and why.” Learning the difference between a 98940 and a 98941 (you’ll get there, we promise) You’re the right fit if: You think in brand, not just funnel. Leads matter, and you know how to get them (we’ll need lots of them). But you also know that the way people feel about us impacts our success from beginning to end. Words matter to you. You obsess over the right word and notice when a sentence is trying too hard. You can write in a voice that isn’t your own, yet somehow make it sound effortless. You don’t wait for the next task. You look around, spot what’s missing, and come up with a plan. You’re the driver, not a passenger. You have taste. You can tell when something looks off, sounds generic, or feels like it came out of a template (or AI), and you won’t ship it. You’re humbly confident. You’ll make a strong case for your ideas, and you’ll change your mind when someone shows you something better. You love being a jack of all trades. Writing copy in the morning, digging into ad performance after lunch, and tweaking a landing page before you log off sounds like a great day to you. You measure what matters. You care about results more than activity, and you’re honest about what’s working and what isn’t. You’re obsessive about getting a good ROI on our ad spend and efforts. You’d rather build than maintain. A website that needs a rethink and a brand that’s still taking shape sounds like an opportunity to you, not a mess. You see feedback as a gift. Even when it’s offered imperfectly but kindly, you stay curious instead of defensive, and look for the nugget that helps you grow. Ready to Apply? We don’t recommend waiting until the last minute. WHAT TO INCLUDE (IN PDF FORMAT, PLEASE): Your resume A cover letter (Yep, we read them!) Page 1: Skip the formal stuff and help us get to know you. Pretend we just met at a picnic. Introduce yourself, explain why you’re interested, and why you think you’d be great in this role. Include the word "rambunctious" somewhere (we want to make sure you're real and read this whole thing). Page 2: Answer this in 1-2 paragraphs: “Pretend you’re hiring for this role. What is the most important trait or skill you’re looking for in an applicant? Why?” PS: Not interested, but know someone who might be? Please pass it along! items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. The Community You Will Join: Guest Experience is responsible for Search and Discovery, Merchandising, and end-to-end online software experience worldwide from top-of-funnel discovery through post-booking engagement. We are looking for a talented Data Scientist to join the Guest Data Science team. This tech lead will be at the core of using AI and casual inference to understand user behavior in our app, detect underlying intent, and to build data products needed to provide a compelling and personalized experience of our app. We build products that help guests find the inventory most relevant to them in our marketplace. The Difference You Will Make: As a Senior Staff Data Scientist, you will lead innovation efforts to build methodologies to identify and evaluate the preferences important to every guest, at every step of their online discovery funnel. You will be instrumental in shaping our data strategy to drive guest conversion and regular engagement with the Airbnb platform across our Homes, Experiences and Services business verticals. This role emphasizes technical excellence and driving business impact with cutting-edge science. Your role will involve close collaboration with Product to identify in-product optimizations and shape UX design architecture to path how guests navigate from surface-to-surface in our app. The ideal candidate will demonstrate to be a domain expert with granular user behavior and sequence datasets in a marketplace setting. You will hold a high bar for our customer experience and balance a passion for AI with a strong desire to accurately understand user behavior and business success. Your efforts towards personalized content discovery will help make Airbnb feel tailored for you, maintaining a dialogue with our guests to deeply understand their preferences and reflect that understanding back to them, enabling every guest to easily discover the travel they will love. A Typical Day: Learn: Develop deep understanding of how guests navigate and re-engage with our app via analysis, research, and by leveraging granular user action and sequence datasets. Partner: With product and engineering, drive technical frameworks and science leadership to explore innovative paradigms for detecting revealed preferences and quantifying online frictions. Build: Write code for prototypes to detect and quantify taxonomy of guest preferences via iterative development of data frameworks, models and artefacts derived from AI toolkits Evaluate: Assess assumptions and efficacy of derived guest preferences via measurement and validating hypotheses linked to online guest action and engagement. Setup experiments and data feedback loops to own a high bar over continuous impact. Influence: Regularly present findings and recommendations to leadership audiences to inform strategy and cross-functional deliverables. If you’re passionate about going deep into personalized user experiences, we want to hear from you! Your Expertise: Causal inference expertise with marketplace experience Preferred domain experience in search, UX discovery, personalized evidence systems Advanced degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Econometrics or related field. 9+ years of industry experience with a PhD (or 12+ years with a Masters) Strong in communication with XFN partners in product, engineering, and design to enable data-driven product development with a focus on the user experience. Expert in at least one programming language for data analysis (Python or R) with familiarity in SQL. Comfort with developing proof-of-concept prototypes. Passionate about AI and possessing a learner’s mindset towards LLMs and dynamic systems. Proven ability to succeed in both collaborative and independent work environments Demonstrated willingness and track record of engagement with the technical community Your Location: This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from. Equal Employment Opportunity: Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. How We'll Take Care of You: Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. Pay Range $224,000 — $280,000 USD Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ airbnb.com or @ ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/airbnb-senior-staff-data-scientist-guest-host-marketplace-ai
