items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - India Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. Location Note We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, the role must be performed from within India. The Opportunity We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join Oportun’s Model Risk Management team and help provide independent oversight of models used across the business. You’ll evaluate model design, methodology, assumptions, implementation, performance, and ongoing monitoring to help ensure models are appropriate, well-controlled, and aligned with Oportun’s risk-management standards. This is a senior individual contributor role that combines quantitative analysis, independent model validation, governance, and cross-functional influence. You’ll work closely with model developers, Risk, Data Science, Compliance, Internal Audit, and other stakeholders to challenge model approaches, identify material risks, and strengthen model risk practices across Oportun. At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You’ll independently review and validate statistical, machine learning, and decisioning models used across Oportun, including models supporting consumer credit loss forecasting, liquidity and funding, and capital markets activities. You’ll assess model methodology, assumptions, data quality, feature selection, implementation, performance, stability, and limitations. You’ll perform quantitative testing, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, back-testing, and other validation activities. You’ll review model monitoring frameworks and help identify performance deterioration, emerging risks, and areas requiring remediation. You’ll evaluate model documentation for completeness, clarity, reproducibility, and alignment with model risk management standards. You’ll provide effective challenges to model developers and business stakeholders while maintaining constructive working relationships. You’ll communicate validation findings, model risks, limitations, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. You’ll support model governance processes, including model inventory, risk tiering, validation scheduling, issue tracking, and remediation follow-up. You’ll partner with Risk, Compliance, Data Science, Product, Engineering, and other teams to strengthen model controls and governance practices. You’ll help improve model risk frameworks, validation methodologies, documentation standards, monitoring practices, and governance processes. You’ll use data and analytics to identify trends and emerging risks across the model portfolio. You’ll look for thoughtful ways to use AI tools to improve research, analysis, documentation, testing, and model risk workflows while maintaining appropriate human review. You'll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully — to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster Who You Are The right fit looks like this You’re a rigorous and curious quantitative professional who enjoys understanding how models work, where they can fail, and how their risks should be managed. You’re comfortable challenging assumptions, asking detailed questions, and supporting your conclusions with clear analysis. You combine technical depth with strong judgment and communication skills. You can work independently, explain complex quantitative issues clearly, and build credibility with model developers and senior stakeholders. You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return. What You Bring Skills & experience Required 5+ years of experience in data science, model validation, model risk management, quantitative risk, statistics, or a related field. Strong understanding of statistical modeling and machine learning techniques such as logistic regression, gradient boosting, decision trees, neural networks, or similar methods. Strong understanding of how defaults, recoveries, prepayments, loan seasoning, and macroeconomic conditions influence consumer loan portfolio losses and cash flows. Experience developing or validating consumer credit loss forecasting models using methods such as vintage/cohort analysis, roll-rate or transition models, survival analysis, time-series models, or probability of default (PD), loss given default (LGD), and exposure at default (EAD) frameworks.Strong proficiency in Python, R, SQL, or similar quantitative programming tools. Experience working with large datasets and performing advanced statistical analysis, model testing, or performance evaluation. Strong understanding of model validation techniques, performance metrics, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, stability analysis, and ongoing monitoring. Experience evaluating model assumptions, data quality, limitations, implementation, and business use. Experience independently leading complex analytical or validation work from scoping through final conclusions. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical findings and explain complex model risks clearly. Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently while partnering effectively with model developers, Risk, Compliance, and senior stakeholders. Nice to Have Experience in model risk management or independent model validation. Experience with credit risk, fraud risk, consumer lending, fintech, banking, or another regulated financial services environment. Familiarity with model governance frameworks, model inventories, risk tiering, validation schedules, issue management, or regulatory expectations. Experience validating machine learning or AI models. Experience developing or validating liquidity, funding, or cash-flow forecasting models, including evaluating funding needs and liquidity under stress scenarios. Familiarity with capital markets models used for loan valuation or securitization, including assessing how key assumptions affect valuations and projected cash flows.Experience with AWS, SageMaker, Databricks, or other cloud-based analytics and modeling platforms. Experience with Spark, PySpark, Hive, or other large-scale data technologies. Master’s degree or PhD in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Finance, or another quantitative discipline. Experience using AI-assisted tools to support research, coding, documentation, validation, or quantitative analysis. Our AI Mindset We b uild with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together . Why Oportun What's in it for you Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: India Benefits: Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance Provident Fund Life & Accident Insurance Internet, Fuel, Meal & Telephone Allowances Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE #LI-SS1 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ . We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-senior-data-scientist-model-risk-management-r14365

items.description: Company Overview Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models. Operating Principles Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together: Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line. Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools. Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time. Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet. We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team. AI-First by Default We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate. That means more than using the tools. We expect you to: Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster. Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you. Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet. Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place. We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment. Note: this role is based remotely out of Europe. Regional Expectations Based in Europe with strong overlap to customer business hours in the region. Excellent written and spoken English. Additional European languages are a plus. The Opportunity Deepgram is hiring a Revenue Operations Analyst to help build and operate the systems, data, and workflows that power our GTM organization. This is a hands-on role for someone who likes getting into the details: fixing broken workflows, improving data quality, supporting quote-to-cash and usage-based billing processes, and finding ways to automate repetitive work. You’ll work closely with GTM Engineering, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, and Renewals to make our commercial systems more reliable, scalable, and efficient. What You’ll Do Support and improve quote-to-cash workflows, including CPQ, order forms, contract changes, subscriptions, entitlements, and downstream system updates. Partner with Finance and GTM Engineering on usage, billing, and monetization workflows, including reconciliation across CRM, product, billing, and finance systems. Serve as a hands-on Salesforce and GTM systems operator, building reports, dashboards, flows, automations, and system enhancements. Maintain strong data quality and governance across accounts, opportunities, contracts, usage, renewals, and customer records. Troubleshoot and resolve GTM systems and process issues, identifying root causes rather than relying on manual workarounds. Identify repetitive or high-friction workflows and help build automation and AI-enabled solutions to reduce manual effort. Support the systems and reporting used to operationalize forecasting, routing, territory, quota, and commission decisions. Partner with the Director, GTM Engineering on system requirements, testing, implementation, documentation, and ongoing optimization. Help create scalable operating processes as Deepgram grows, while staying close to the day-to-day work that surfaces where systems need to improve. It’s Important to Us That You Have 3–4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Operations, Business Systems, or a related role. Strong hands-on Salesforce experience, including reporting, flows, automation, and data management. Experience working across CRM, CPQ, billing, contract, or other GTM systems. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail. A track record of improving workflows, not just executing existing processes. Comfort using AI and automation tools to reduce manual work and improve operations. Ability to work cross-functionally across GTM, Finance, and technical teams. It Would Be Great If You Had Experience in a usage-based or consumption-based business. Experience with CPQ and contract-generation tools. Familiarity with billing or metering systems. SQL or experience working with GTM/customer data. Experience with tools such as Claude, Cursor, n8n, Workato, Retool, or similar automation environments. Experience in a high-growth SaaS or AI company. Notice : We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @ deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping! About the Role: We are seeking a talented and motivated, best-in-class Data Engineer II. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This position will own the data pipelines, transformations, and reporting processes that support accurate, complete, and timely furnishing of customer account information to credit bureaus. This role presents an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment while taking hands-on ownership of a critical customer-facing data function. You will dig into account data and code, debug SQL and Python workflows, and carry issues from investigation through verified resolution. You will partner with Customer Service to resolve technical dispute escalations, with Compliance to apply approved reporting requirements, and with Engineering when a fix is needed in production services or the consumer app. We are looking for an independent problem solver who can manage recurring reporting operations while improving the systems behind them. What You’ll Do: Own recurring credit bureau furnishing operations, including data preparation, validation, submissions, bureau feedback, exception resolution, and reconciliation Build, maintain, and debug SQL transformations, Python scripts, and data pipelines that produce credit reporting data Trace discrepancies from account activity and source records through transformation logic to furnished outputs; identify root causes and implement lasting fixes Investigate escalations from Customer Service, explain what happened to account data and what should be reported under approved policies, and provide evidence to support their dispute responses Identify all accounts affected by reporting defects, implement corrections and controlled reprocessing, and verify the resulting reporting outcomes Develop automated tests, reconciliations, monitoring, and alerts to catch inaccurate, incomplete, duplicate, or unexpected reporting before submission Partner with Engineering on defects in production services or the consumer app, providing reproducible examples, affected-account analysis, and clear requirements; validate fixes through the reporting pipeline Work with Compliance to translate approved reporting requirements into technical rules and escalate ambiguous reporting scenarios Document reporting logic, data lineage, procedures, and incident resolutions so the process is repeatable and can be supported by others What We Look For: Degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related quantitative discipline 3+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or software engineering, including hands-on ownership of production data pipelines and operational workflows Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, account-level reconciliation, data profiling, and troubleshooting transformation logic Strong Python skills, including the ability to read unfamiliar code, debug existing scripts, and implement maintainable fixes Demonstrated ability to independently investigate ambiguous problems, prioritize recurring operations and incidents, and carry issues through to verified resolution Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, monitoring, and safe deployment and reprocessing of data workflows Excellent problem-solving skills, with a track record of tracing data defects across systems and preventing recurrence Strong business judgment and communication skills; able to explain technical findings to Customer Service and Compliance and work effectively with Engineering Fluent in English Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication. Preferred Knowledge and Skills: Experience with credit reporting dispute workflows, e-OSCAR, Metro 2 format, and investigating escalations from customer support teams Experience with dbt, Redshift, PostgreSQL, AWS, and workflow scheduling or orchestration tools Experience in consumer lending, servicing, payments, financial services, banking, fintech, or BNPL The Tech You’ll Work With: Python Redshift, PostgreSQL Data build tool (dbt) WS, G Suite, Mac Coding agents Claude, ChatGPT Interview Process: Application submitted (you are here) Wonderlic test (30-40 min) Interview with recruiters (30 min) Online coding assessment focused on SQL, Python, and debugging Verbal case study interview. Walk through a credit reporting discrepancy, trace the data and code, and explain how you would correct and prevent the issue. Verbal behavioral interview. Share examples of independently resolving data incidents, improving reliability, and partnering with Engineering and Customer Service. Offer About You: You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire. #Li-remote #Full-time To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sezzle-data-engineer-ii-credit-reporting

items.description: Design Headquarters: Costa Rica, Remote Our Mission: 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. Our People: People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner Business Solutions Partner — GTM & Finance Systems Location Costa Rica Function / Dept Business Technology — Enterprise Applications Reports to Director, Enterprise Applications Position Summary 6sense is seeking an Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner to help transform how business functions leverage AI, automation, and enterprise technology to achieve their goals. This role sits at the intersection of business consulting, AI solution design, automation engineering, and value realization. You will partner with teams across Go-to-Market, Customer Success, Support, Legal, Finance, and Partner Operations to identify opportunities where AI and automation can simplify work, improve user experiences, reduce costs, and accelerate business outcomes. Unlike a traditional Business Systems Analyst or Business Solution Partner, this role is expected to move beyond requirements gathering. You will evaluate business processes, build proof-of-concepts, create AI agents, develop low-code automations, and validate business value before solutions are scaled into production. Working closely with the Enterprise AI Engineering team, you will translate complex business challenges into technical requirements and implementation plans while independently delivering design prototypes and lightweight solutions using platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Workato, and other approved enterprise AI technologies. A successful candidate combines strong business analysis skills with hands-on technical aptitude. They can engage stakeholders, map workflows, build basic automations, create AI-powered solutions, measure outcomes, and communicate recommendations to both business and technical audiences. This is a growth role within a new Enterprise AI career track. You will work under the guidance of the Lead Enterprise AI Business Solutions Engineer and will be measured on business outcomes, including adoption, productivity gains, automation impact, cost avoidance, and process improvements. As you progress, you will take increasing ownership of a portfolio of business capabilities, including identifying, developing, delivering and maturing measurable AI-driven value. Responsibilities Tool Inventory & AI Efficiency Discovery Build and maintain the AI and tool inventory for your assigned function: owner, use case, active users, annual cost, renewal date, AI features in use, contract exit terms and replacement feasibility. Find where AI features we already pay for are unused, duplicated or overlap with other tools, and document the findings. Track renewal dates and flag every contract at least 120 days before the notice date so a build-vs-buy decision can be made in time. Run discovery interviews and working sessions with stakeholders to understand how work actually gets done, and surface the business problem behind the requested feature. Map current processes and estimate the time spent, the number of people involved and the frequency, so every opportunity has a baseline. Build-vs-Buy Analysis & Business Cases Prepare the inputs for build-vs-buy analysis: what the tool does, how deeply it is integrated, compliance burden, usage compared with cost, and realistic replacement scope. Contribute to business cases that compare three-year build, run and support cost with vendor cost, working with the Lead and with Enterprise AI Engineers on the build side. Agree baselines with business owners before work starts and record their sign-off, so savings and hours returned can be validated later. Recommend which candidates to pursue first, using renewal timing, savings potential and build feasibility. Prototyping & Applied AI Build prototypes and simple agents with Claude and Copilot to test whether a tool, or part of a workflow, can be replaced or improved. Write clear, build-ready context for Enterprise AI Engineers: the process, the data involved, example inputs and outputs, acceptance criteria and edge cases. Help define evaluation criteria, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints and escalation paths before anything reaches production. Design the process around the AI: what changes for the seller, agent or analyst, what training is needed and how exceptions are handled. Bring AI fluency to stakeholders: help non-technical teams understand what these tools can and cannot reliably do, and set realistic expectations. Stakeholder Partnership Serve as the named Business Solutions Partner for your assigned function, and the point of contact for intake, priorities and status. Translate business needs into clear, buildable stories and acceptance criteria, and translate technical trade-offs back into language stakeholders can act on. Keep stakeholders informed on what is changing, what is being built and what may move more slowly during the transition. Escalate misalignment, scope drift and risk early to the Lead before they become executive issues. Hands-On Salesforce & Delivery Configure and deliver declarative Salesforce solutions (flows, validation rules, record types, page layouts, permission sets, reports and dashboards) for small requests, with guidance on larger ones. Understand Apex, integrations and data model implications well enough to scope work accurately and hold a credible technical conversation with engineers. Own UAT for your function: define test scenarios, coordinate stakeholder testing and support release sign-off. Maintain accurate documentation of processes, solution designs and system dependencies. Measurement & Ways of Working Track adoption (percent of target users active) for anything shipped in your function, and report what is working and what should be retired. Report hours returned and spend avoided using the agreed baseline, and flag figures that are not yet validated. Work in the team’s agentic delivery model: use the intake agent, async standups and automated sprint summaries instead of status meetings, and give feedback on what to improve. Contribute to team standards for the inventory, business case template and requirements. Skills & Experience Required 2–4 years of relevant experience as a business analyst, business solution partner, business systems analyst, Salesforce administrator or operations analyst supporting business stakeholders, preferably at a SaaS company. Hands-on Salesforce administration experience (Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud), including Flow Builder, validation rules, permission sets and reporting. Salesforce Certified Administrator, or obtained within the first six months in the role. Daily, practical use of AI tools such as Claude, Copilot or similar, with solid prompt design and an understanding of their limits. Strong spreadsheet and data fluency: cleaning data, building summaries and sizing a problem. Process mapping and structured interviewing skills. Clear written and spoken English; able to present findings to U.S.-based stakeholders. Must be located in Costa Rica and able to maintain consistent working overlap with U.S. business hours. Preferred Experience putting an AI or automation solution into a live business process, even a small one, and measuring the result. Familiarity with GTM processes (lead to cash, pipeline, forecasting) or Support operations (case management, routing, knowledge), or with Finance, Legal or Partner operations. Basic financial literacy: reading a vendor cost, comparing build and run cost, and calculating a payback period. Exposure to SQL, APIs or low-code tools; interest in using Claude Code under guidance. Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator, Business Analyst or Agentforce Specialist. Experience in an Agile team; familiarity with Jira, Asana or similar. Bilingual English/Spanish. What we value Curiosity and a bias to build and test, not just to document. Honesty about what is validated and what is an estimate. Comfort with change, since this track is new and will keep evolving. How This Role Is Measured Accuracy and completeness of the tool inventory for your function. Percent of renewals in scope identified and reviewed at least 120 days before the notice date. Prototype quality, as rated by the stakeholder and the engineering lead. Hours returned and spend avoided on initiatives you support, validated by the business owner. Adoption of anything shipped in your function. What Success Looks Like First 90 days Inventory for your function is complete and reviewed with business owners. Renewal calendar for your tools is documented, with the next three renewals ranked by savings potential. Two or more stakeholder discovery sessions completed, with baselines drafted for the top opportunities. First prototype built with Claude or Copilot and reviewed with the Lead and an engineer. First year Your stakeholder group treats you as its partner for systems and AI work and routes requests to you rather than escalating. At least two prototypes evaluated end to end, and at least one taken to production with Enterprise AI Engineers, with measured impact. At least one initiative with a documented baseline, business-owner sign-off and a validated hours-returned or spend-avoided number. Renewals for your function reviewed before notice dates, with a documented decision on each. You are operating toward IC4: leading a build-vs-buy analysis from discovery to recommendation with little guidance. Our Benefits: Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces. We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds. Equal Opportunity Employer: 6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com . We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. A ll email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain . We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments . If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@ 6sense.com To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/6sense-business-solutions-partner-enterprise-ai

items.description: Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients. About the Role Dandy is seeking a Procurement Lead to help scale our growing Procurement organization. This role is responsible for ensuring uninterrupted supply of production materials through inventory planning, purchase order management, supplier coordination, and continuous process improvement. The Procurement Lead serves as the operational owner for a portfolio of suppliers and materials while partnering closely with Materials Planning, Finance, Manufacturing, and Operations. In addition to executing day-to-day procurement activities, this individual will improve processes, document best practices, develop reporting, and mentor junior procurement team members. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving operational problems, building scalable processes, and driving measurable business impact. What You'll Do Procurement Operations Manage the end-to-end purchasing process for assigned commodities and suppliers Create, monitor, and expedite purchase orders in NetSuite Manage supplier communication regarding lead times, order confirmations, shortages, and delivery issues Resolve purchase order discrepancies, invoice issues, and receiving exceptions Monitor open purchase orders and drive timely supplier follow-up Inventory Planning Review inventory health and demand signals to prevent stockouts and excess inventory Execute purchasing decisions based on forecasts, reorder points, and business priorities Partner with Materials Planning to balance inventory investment with service levels Monitor supplier performance against lead time and delivery expectations Supplier Management Build strong working relationships with suppliers Identify supply risks and escalate mitigation plans Support supplier performance reviews and continuous improvement initiatives Partner with suppliers to improve delivery performance and reduce operational issues Process Improvement Develop and maintain Procurement SOPs and documentation Identify opportunities to automate or simplify procurement workflows Create dashboards and reporting that improve operational visibility Standardize best practices across the Procurement team Cross-Functional Partnership Collaborate with Manufacturing, Operations, Finance, AP, Logistics, and Planning teams Communicate inventory risks, supplier constraints, and purchasing priorities Support new product introductions and material transitions Participate in cross-functional projects that improve supply chain performance Leadership & Team Development Mentor and train Procurement Agents and Buyers Share subject matter expertise and establish best practices Support onboarding of new team members Serve as a resource for complex procurement questions and escalations Qualifications 3+ years of procurement, purchasing, supply chain, or inventory planning experience Experience purchasing production materials in a manufacturing environment Strong ERP experience (NetSuite preferred) Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills Experience building reports and analyzing inventory data Strong written and verbal communication skills Ability to prioritize multiple competing requests in a fast-paced environment Preferred Experience with demand planning or inventory planning Experience writing SOPs and improving operational processes Experience mentoring or leading team members Knowledge of supplier performance metrics and procurement KPIs Success in this Role Within your first year, you will: Maintain healthy inventory levels while minimizing stockout risk Improve purchase order cycle times and supplier responsiveness Create scalable procurement documentation and reporting Drive measurable process improvements across Procurement Become a trusted partner to Operations, Planning, and Finance Help develop and elevate the capabilities of the Procurement team Req ID: J-218 For full-time positions, Dandy offers a wide range of best-in-class, comprehensive, and inclusive benefits tailored to each country where we operate. Our local benefits packages typically include healthcare, dental, mental health support, parental planning resources, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off—ensuring our team members are supported no matter where they live and work. items.description: StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels. Senior Manager, Client Analytics Partnership - EMEA The Senior Manager of Client Analytics Partnership for EMEA leads a team of individual contributors responsible for developing client measurement strategies, delivering actionable insights and building strategic partnerships that support growth across the EMEA region. This role is a people manager role and also requires hands-on client support on high-priority client partnerships. The Sr. Manager identifies geo-specific measurement needs, shapes strategies, and leads global testing and reporting initiatives, ensuring the Client Analytics Partnership team delivers impactful insights and data-driven strategic client support while fostering innovation and team development. This role reports to the VP of Global Data & Analytics. StackAdapt is a remote-first company. Candidates should be based in London or the surrounding area, with regular travel to meet clients. What you will be doing: Lead the Client Analytics Partnership (CAP) team, ensuring strategic goals are met and pursuing market development. Oversee the development, education, and implementation of market-specific measurement strategies, testing plans, learning agendas, and reporting adoption across AM and AE teams. Provide direct support on high-priority client partnerships or vendor relationships that lead to overall team capability development. Help support recruitment and GTM of prioritised initiatives to feed the pipeline of potential case study candidates. Translate regional needs to scaled solutions teams or product team to develop client deliverables that meet their business/marketing reporting objectives. Demonstrate and incorporate AI and automation as the foundation for scaling best practices and analytics support. Influence StackAdapts EMEA market strategy by addressing repeated client reporting needs and anticipating future challenges. Identify and develop best practices that align with different verticals and business objectives, ensuring scalable client measurement solutions Serve as the primary measurement consultant for Sales and Client Service Leads and engages in leadership-level conversations for EMEA markets Advises on measurement strategy and planning in key new business development, and directly participates in client pitches Collaborates with NORAM counterparts to create enterprise-level measurement tactics and ensure efficient division of projects across the regions for collective efforts. Represent EMEA market needs to identify region-specific nuances in GTM materials. Partners closely with the scaled solutions, product and technical engineering team, though this role does not manage data engineering, pipelines, or dashboard development. What you’ll bring to the table: 7 to 9 years of experience in a similar role, preferably within the digital media or programmatic advertising landscape servicing clients. Experience leading and developing client-facing analytics or measurement professionals. Experience in guiding teams through measurement strategies, test designs and learning objectives to set KPIs. Knowledge of industry-standard performance metrics and media KPIs. Knowledge of regional ad policies and guardrails on privacy and data governance laws. Experience working with internal teams, cross-functional partners, and supporting client relationships. Proficiency in using reporting tools (such as Tableau, PowerBI, ThoughtSpot, BigQuery, and Google Analytics) and media buying platforms for data analysis. The ability to translate and articulate complex measurement concepts to both executive C-suite stakeholders and technical engineering audiences. Expert understanding of client servicing and campaign management. Deep understanding of measurement methodologies and strategies, including incrementality, brand and engagement lift, test design, attribution models (including the limitations of last-touch attribution and application of multi-touch attribution), and marketing mix modelling (MMM). The compensation range listed for this role reflects the expected base salary for candidates located in the posting country based on a global rate. It is informed by market data and the approved budget for this position. StackAdapt maintains different compensation ranges for roles across other countries and regions, and final offers will be aligned to the candidate’s current location. We do not ask c andidates about current or prior salary history, and we will not use such information, if volunteered, in setting an offer. This range represents base salary only. Depending on the role, candidates may also be eligible for additional compensation such as annual bonuses, commissions, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits package. Factors Influencing Final Compensation: The final compensation offer will be determined by a variety of factors, which may include, but are not limited to: the candidate's specific experience, technical skills, knowledge, abilities, and relevant education, licensure, and certifications. Other business factors, such as organizational needs and budget alignment, may also be considered in the final offer. Access to a comprehensive mental health care program Health benefits from day one of employment Work from home reimbursements Optional global WeWork membership for those who want a change from their home office and hubs in London and Toronto Robust training and onboarding program Coverage and support of personal development initiatives (conferences, courses, books etc) Access to StackAdapt programmatic courses and certifications to support continuous learning An awesome parental leave program A friendly, welcoming, and supportive culture Our social and team events! Please note: Benefits and perks may vary depending on your country of employment and the nature of your engagement. In locations where StackAdapt does not have a legal entity, employment and benefits are administered in accordance with local regulations and partner policies. StackAdapt is a diverse and inclusive team of collaborative, hardworking individuals trying to make a dent in the universe. No matter who you are, where you are from, who you love, follow in faith, disability, superpower status, ethnicity, or the gender you identify with (if you’re comfortable, let us know your pronouns), you are welcome at StackAdapt. StackAdapt is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. items.description: Product Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, US; Remote, US About Pinterest: Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product. Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible. At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI. Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here . We are looking for an Analytics Engineering Manager II, Core Data Science to help improve the quality and velocity of data science at Pinterest. You will shape the future of the people-facing and business-facing products we build by creating rock-solid data foundations and tooling, and by leading a high-performance team that partners closely with our Core Data Science organization. What you'll do: Build, inspire, and grow a high-performance, diverse team of analytics engineers with an inclusive culture. Develop best practices for instrumentation and experimentation and communicate those to product engineering teams. Build and prototype AI tools and analysis pipelines iteratively to provide insights at scale while developing comprehensive knowledge of data structures and metrics, advocating for changes where needed. Use AI to accelerate analysis, prototyping, and iteration—drafting pipelines, exploring approaches, and automating repeatable documentation and QA—while applying judgment and verification to ensure correctness and quality. Work closely with Data Scientists and Engineers to build tools and processes that enable self-service of key datasets, insights, and metric investigations. Contribute to comprehensive documentation of tools and datasets, and drive the strategy for better data quality and data democratization within Pinterest. Work cross-functionally to build and communicate key insights, collaborating with product managers, engineers, designers, and researchers to help build the next experiences on Pinterest. What we're looking for: 6+ years of experience working with data in a fast-paced, data-driven environment, including experience managing engineers. Ability to manipulate large data sets with high dimensionality and complexity; fluency in SQL (or other database languages) and a scripting language (Python or R), including nested data structure manipulation, windowing functions, query optimization, and data partitioning techniques. Experience conducting workflow orchestration and ETL/ELT with huge, complicated datasets and handling DAG data dependencies. Consistent track record of supplying analytics solutions to existing teams, with the ability to take open-ended goals and scope them into defined, impactful objectives. A team player able to partner with cross-functional leadership to quickly turn insights into actions, and an accountable operator who proactively identifies project opportunities amid competing priorities. Demonstrated ability to use AI to improve speed and quality in your day-to-day workflow, with a strong track record of critical evaluation and verification of AI-assisted work (testing, source-checking, data validation, peer review). High integrity and ownership: you protect sensitive data, avoid over-reliance on AI, and remain accountable for final decisions and deliverables. Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience. Desired but not required: Experience in automation, anomaly detection, or infrastructure/workflow optimization. Experience building internal tooling to maximize engineering velocity. Relocation Statement: This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model. In-Office Requirement Statement: We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role. This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/month and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country. #LI-REMOTE #LI-AG8 At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise. Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here . US based applicants only $177,185 — $364,795 USD Our Commitment to Inclusion: Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you require a medical or religious accommodation during the job application process, please complete this form for support. By submitting this application, I certify that all information submitted in my application and throughout the hiring process is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that any false statement, omission, or misrepresentation may disqualify me from employment consideration or result in termination if discovered after hire. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pinterest-manager-ii-engineering-analytics-engineering-core-data-science

items.description: Fleetworthy offers the only complete technology suite for fleet readiness, uniting safety and compliance, toll management, and weigh station bypass solutions. We help fleets streamline operations, control costs, and operate with confidence. Trusted by 90% of the top fleets in North America, Fleetworthy offers the most adopted toll management solution and largest weigh station bypass network. Going beyond regulatory requirements, our safety and compliance capabilities strengthen safety programs and enable proactive audit readiness. We support millions of vehicles and drivers and are recognized across the industry for innovation and leadership. Fleetworthy is shaping the future of fleet readiness with AI-enabled, connected fleet technology that keeps drivers safe, fleets compliant, and operations running at peak efficiency. Learn more at fleetworthy.com. About the Role Fleetworthy is seeking driven, energetic, and ambitious individuals to join our team as Business Development Representatives (BDRs). This is more than just a sales role. It’s the first step in an intentional, growth-oriented career path that feeds directly into our sales organization. As a BDR, you’ll play a critical role in fueling our pipeline through outbound prospecting and strategic lead generation. We’re looking for naturally competitive, goal-oriented people who are passionate about building a meaningful career in sales. This is a high-impact role with a clear development path: after 18–24 months of strong performance, BDRs will have the opportunity to be promoted into the sales organization. As well as selling, you’ll be sharpening your skills with hands-on training, mentorship, and professional development. This program is designed to be a launchpad for Fleetworthy’s future leaders, giving you the tools, exposure, and experience to thrive in a high-performance sales environment. Individuals with a high degree of adaptability and willingness to be coached are extremely well suited for this role. Key Responsibilities Conduct outbound prospecting through calls, emails, and social channels. Work with various lead sources in support of strategic campaigns to qualify or disqualify based on specific criteria. Identify decision-makers and key influencers using research tools such as ZoomInfo, Salesforce, Gong, LinkedIn, Industry Media, and Google. Nurture prospects effectively until they are ready to engage with an Account Executive. Execute a consistent outreach cadence to secure qualified meetings. Build rapport with prospects by offering relevant resources (e.g., webinars, white papers, case studies, industry insights). Uncover customer pain points and needs by asking insightful discovery questions. Demonstrate a fundamental understanding of Fleetworthy’s solutions to articulate value and overcome objections. CRM Hygiene - accurate records of all activity and prospect information in the system, deduping records, identifying parent-child relationships, and deeply researching accounts. Consistently meet or exceed activity goals related to outreach, conversations, and meetings booked. Embrace a growth mindset and bring a positive, energetic attitude to your daily work. Regularly align with internal stakeholders such as sales VPs, Account Executives, Marketing, Customer Success, and other teams. What You’ll Gain Opportunities for career progression into Account Executive or other revenue-generating roles after 18–24 months of strong performance. Dedicated coaching and mentorship from experienced sales leaders. Structured training in sales methodology, prospecting strategies, and industry knowledge. Ongoing development opportunities including workshops, certifications, and leadership exposure. A front-row seat to Fleetworthy’s strategic growth initiatives and innovation in the fleet compliance space. The chance to be part of a tight-knit, performance-driven sales culture where your success is recognized and rewarded. Qualifications 1–3 years of experience in inside sales, outbound prospecting, or lead generation. Strong communication, active listening, and storytelling abilities via phone, email, and social. Confidence in conducting high-volume outreach and engaging busy executives Proven ability to manage time, prioritize tasks, align with internal stakeholders and maintain high activity levels. Self-motivated with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Demonstrated success in outbound prospecting and lead qualification. Working knowledge of CRMs and modern sales tools (Salesforce, Gong, etc.) and a high degree of comfort learning and leveraging new technologies. Knowledge of the transportation, compliance, or telematics space is a plus, but not required. A positive, coachable attitude with a willingness to learn and grow. Tools Leveraged in this Role Salesforce Gong LinkedIn ZoomInfo Qualified Microsoft 365 Slack Claude Lovable Internal Dashboards Fleetworthy is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture that is respectful and welcoming of individual differences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, nationality, national or ethnic origin, civil status, age, citizenship status, sexual orientation, disability, genetic information, familial status, marital or registered civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity status, gender identity, gender reassignment, military or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

items.description: Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. GET TO KNOW US At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company. We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! THE OPPORTUNITY We are hiring a Staff Platform Engineer specialized in Observability for our Platform area in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil. Wellhub runs at high scale, on many Kubernetes clusters. Our engineers need logs, metrics, traces and profiles they can trust, at a cost the business can sustain. We build and run this platform ourselves, on open source standards. Your mission is to make it a product that engineers choose to use, and not a set of dashboards they must ask for. What you will work on: Observability as a Service . A self-service platform that balances performance and cost. Hard problems: high-cardinality metrics, log retention, distributed tracing, profiling. Golden Paths . Defaults that let a developer instrument code in minutes and get good signals without operating anything. The platform itself . Collection, storage, query and alerting that stay reliable when the company grows. We also watch the watchers: the platform must tell us when it is broken. Our stack includes Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Tempo, Pyroscope, Kafka, Kubernetes, AWS, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Crossplane and HashiCorp Vault. You will write code in Go, Ruby or Python to build our tools. YOUR IMPACT Our team does not run services for other teams. We build tools and abstractions so each team can own and run its own services end to end. Your work will rest on four things: stability , performance , cost and evolution of the platform. In this role you will: Review our current platform with fresh eyes. Say what is wrong, propose better solutions, and help the team evolve them. Own our observability stack end to end. Keep it resilient, scalable and ready for growth. Evolve the Kubernetes-based infrastructure it runs on. Close the gap between complex infrastructure and developer experience. Build the abstractions that let teams manage their own observability. Set standards and guidelines, and write them down through RFCs. Work with the whole team day to day: pair on designs, review proposals, mentor engineers and help make decisions as a technical reference. Live the mission: care for your own wellbeing and your colleagues'. WHO YOU ARE You like to remove friction. You want your work to help many engineers. This role may fit if you have: Built and run observability at scale (metrics, logs, traces), not only designed or used it. You can tell us what broke and what you changed. Deep knowledge of Kubernetes and AWS (or GCP or Azure), including networking and the real cost of moving data. You possess excellent communication skills in both English and Portuguese. Deep, hands-on expertise with open source observability tools such as Prometheus, Thanos, Grafana, Loki or Tempo, and with OpenTelemetry collection and instrumentation. A specialist's depth in the hard parts: high-cardinality data, retention and storage, query performance, and keeping the observability platform itself reliable. A habit of reasoning from the constraint (cost, reliability, performance) and not from the tool. You can explain trade-offs and say what you do not know. Experience building products for other engineers, with attention to adoption, ownership and developer experience. Strong software engineering skills. You write code to build tools and automation. Fluent English and Portuguese, spoken and written. Bonus points if you have: Cost optimization for high-volume telemetry (FinOps). Internal tools, CLIs or Kubernetes operators; Crossplane. Service mesh knowledge (Istio, Linkerd or similar). Experience with RFCs and technical leadership without direct reports. CNCF certifications (CKA, CKS, CKAD, PCA, OTCA). We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in AWS, Kubernetes, Software Engineering, and Observability Practices with open source solutions are mandatory requirements. WHAT WE OFFER YOU With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs! Our benefits include: WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content. HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance. FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office. PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday! PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled. CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn ! Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here. Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos. #LI-REMOTE #LI-CM1

items.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We’re looking for a RevOps Systems Architect to design and build the systems behind a modern, AI-powered go-to-market engine. This isn’t a Salesforce admin role, and it isn’t a support function. You’ll be the technical owner of how our GTM stack fits together: Salesforce at the core, surrounded by the data, enrichment, engagement, billing, and AI tools our revenue teams depend on. You’ll operate as an architect and a hands-on builder. You’ll set the technical direction for our CRM and GTM tooling, then ship it yourself with Flows, Apex, SQL, and custom services, including Salesforce MCP servers and AI tooling that make our CRM a first-class participant in AI-driven workflows. For larger efforts, you’ll partner with our engineering team, scoping, designing, and delivering together as a technical peer. In this role, you will: Own the architecture of our GTM systems: the Salesforce object model and data architecture, how data moves between Salesforce and the rest of the stack, and the standards that keep it all healthy and scalable. Design and build integrations between Salesforce and adjacent tools (data warehouse, enrichment, sales engagement, billing/CPQ, internal apps), choosing the right tool for each problem, whether that’s native Salesforce, Apex, middleware, or custom services. Build and maintain automations using Flows, Apex, and custom services that power GTM processes end to end, with a bias toward solutions that are intelligent, observable, and maintainable. Develop and maintain Salesforce MCP servers and AI agents that extend CRM functionality into AI-powered workflows, and define how AI fits into our revenue operations over time. Design and own SQL-based data pipelines that feed dashboards and revenue reporting, making sure the numbers leadership relies on are trustworthy and traceable to source. Translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical strategy, from stakeholder conversation through design, build, rollout, and adoption. Raise the bar for the team: establish best practices for change management, testing, documentation, and technical debt, and mentor teammates on systems thinking. Partner with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Engineering to prioritize the systems work with the highest business impact. Requirements 8+ years in Salesforce administration and development, with a track record of owning a complex, high-growth org and its architecture, not just maintaining it. Strong Apex skills: you can design, build, debug, and maintain triggers, custom logic, and integrations independently, and you know when not to write code. Demonstrated experience integrating Salesforce with other systems via APIs, middleware, or custom services, and designing for failure modes, data integrity, and scale. SQL proficiency: you decompose ambiguous questions into well-structured queries and are comfortable with complex joins, aggregations, and pipeline logic. A systems mindset: you can hold an end-to-end GTM process in your head, trace a field from origin through every downstream dependency, and anticipate what breaks when something changes. Strong judgment and ownership: you scope problems yourself, make sound build-vs-buy and architecture calls, and drive projects to completion with little direction. Clear communicator who can explain tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and earn trust across teams. Excited by AI-native systems and curious about where Salesforce, MCP, and AI agents intersect. You’re already experimenting in this space. Bonus: Familiarity with dbt or modern data transformation tooling. Experience with BI tools such as Sigma or Looker. items.description: Wir verwandeln bedeutende Momente in wunderschöne Erinnerungen. celebrate ist eine Markengruppe mit der Mission, in ganz Europa schöne Momente in bleibende Erinnerungen zu verwandeln: mit hochwertigen Papierwaren, Fotoprodukten und besonderen Geschenkartikeln. Zur Verstärkung unseres DevOps-Teams suchen wir dich als Senior DevOps Engineer (m/w/d) – zur Übernahme unserer Observability-Plattform und für ein zuverlässiges, kosteneffizientes AWS- und Kubernetes-Setup hinter unseren Shops. Die Rolle ist remote-first in Deutschland, und du berichtest an unseren Head of DevOps innerhalb unserer Tech Foundations Unit. Das jährliche Gehalt für diese Position liegt zwischen € 65.000 und € 85.000 (Senior). Deine Rolle Volle Verantwortung für unsere Observability-Plattform auf Grafana Cloud und Alloy/OpenTelemetry – von Alert-Regeln und Dashboards mit den Produktteams bis zur Einhaltung des Kostenrahmens Zuverlässigkeit unserer Shops durch SLOs, Incident-Leitung und Postmortems, deine Woche in der On-Call-Rotation und Peak-Vorbereitung mit Lasttests, Node-Sizing und Pre-Scaling Weiterentwicklung unserer EKS-Plattform mit Karpenter, ArgoCD und Helm, inklusive Cluster-Upgrades, neuer AWS-Accounts und Infrastructure as Code mit Terraform und CDK Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Produktteams durch PR-Reviews, Deploy-Freigaben und Reliability-Fixes in ihrem Code, mit Raum für deine Weiterentwicklung in Security-Themen Tech-Stack AWS (EKS, VPC, WAF, RDS/Aurora, S3) Kubernetes & Karpenter ArgoCD & Helm Kyverno Terraform / AWS CDK GitHub Actions & Renovate Grafana Cloud & Grafana IRM Alloy / OpenTelemetry Prometheus Deine Benefits Wir schätzen Flexibilität: Flexible Remote-Arbeit, Teilzeitoptionen, moderne Hardware (Macbooks), kollaborative Büroflächen (Flex Desks) Wir begrüßen New Work: Agile Arbeitsweise, Fair Pay, Kompetenz- und Führungsmodelle Wir möchten, dass es dir gut geht: Nilo.health, Corporate Benefits, JobRad, Workations, Sabbaticals, 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub sowie dein persönliches Benefit nach Wahl: Wellpass, Hansefit oder das DB-Jobticket Wir wollen mit dir wachsen: Interne Weiterbildung, Coaching, regelmäßige Feedback- und Wachstumsprozesse, flexible externe Lernmöglichkeiten Wir sind ein Team: Office-Frühstück und Lunch, (freiwillige) Events, Remote Team-Building, Office Dogs, und exklusive Family & Friends-Rabatte Dein Profil Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer DevOps-, SRE- oder Plattform-Rolle mit Kubernetes im Produktivbetrieb, Helm und GitOps sowie fundierten AWS- und Terraform-Kenntnissen Praxiserfahrung mit Metrics, Logs und Traces, Produktions-Incidents und SLOs sowie ein Software-Engineering-Hintergrund, z. B. mit Python, Go oder TypeScript Gute Englischkenntnisse und klare schriftliche Kommunikation, Deutsch ist ein Plus Dein Mindset Strukturiert – Wenn nachts ein Alert anschlägt, behältst du den Überblick, leitest den Incident und sorgst dafür, dass aus dem Postmortem am nächsten Morgen ein besseres Runbook wird. Pragmatisch – Du behebst lieber gemeinsam mit einem Produktteam einen Timeout oder ein Resource-Limit, als ein weiteres Tool einzuführen, und hast die Kosten immer im Blick. Neugierig – Du schaust dir gern den Code unserer Engineers an, um ihre Probleme zu verstehen, und bist offen dafür, dich nebenbei in neue Bereiche wie Security einzuarbeiten. Über celebrate company celebrate company ist eine Gruppe aus sechs Marken: Atelier Rosemood, celebrate apps, celebrate digital printing, faireparterie, kartenmacherei und mintkind. Gemeinsam betreiben wir E-Commerce-Shops, Produktionsstätten und weitere digitale Services in ganz Europa, die alle dasselbe Ziel haben: bedeutende Momente in wunderschöne Erinnerungen zu verwandeln. Unsere Kultur basiert auf einem Growth Mindset, offenem Feedback und Flexibilität. So übernehmen wir Verantwortung, testen mutig Neues und entwickeln uns gemeinsam weiter. Bereit, dich zu bewerben? Wir freuen uns, dich kennenzulernen! Bewirb dich jetzt über unser Online-Bewerbungsformular. Keinen Lebenslauf zur Hand? Uns reicht auch ein Link zu deinem Linkedin Profile in deiner Bewerbung. Melde dich bei weiteren Fragen direkt bei Mario (Talent Acquisition Manager). E-Mail: Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Accelerate Your Career: After your probation period, you’ll receive regular performance and salary reviews every 6 months, giving you clear opportunities to advance based on your impact, growth, and contributions. Your career progression is merit-based; the more you learn, take initiative, and consistently deliver quality work, the faster you can level up. Become Your Best: Set personal & professional goals every quarter with your talent coach. Get optional counselling along the way. Global Impact: Build products that reach users worldwide and truly make a difference in the world! Public Recognition: Track your achievements as you build a personalportfolio & track record. Join a Culture of Drivers : Become part of a team that’s striving to be their very best. Monthly salary ranges from AUD 420–600 , depending on hiring region, experience, and local market benchmarks. items.summary: Lemon.io helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us. New roles for Senior React Full-stack Engineers come in all the time, and several are open right now. Two ways to work with clients Contract: most roles are contract-based. You join the client’s team and work as part of it. Direct hire: some clients hire engineers full-time, and we support you through the process. Because companies trust our vetting, applying through Lemon.io is often a shortcut.
