Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for…
items.description: At Qualtrics , we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers. When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing. Enterprise Account Executive - DACH Why We Have This Role Qualtrics is on the lookout for a proactive, collaborative seller that can help us lead and own the strategy for selling Experience Management (XM) SaaS within the largest accounts in the DACH market. We’re helping the world’s leading companies improve experiences. Our solutions allow our clients to have a 360° view of the entire experience enabling them to uncover what matters most to clients and employees with the ability to take action in real time. In the Enterprise Sales role, you will be working with Major Accounts with an overarching objective to drive company revenue growth through net new customer acquisition and expansion in our current customer base. This person will work collaboratively to meet sales goals and deliver the highest standard of integrity, quality, and customer service to our clients. How You’ll Find Success Relationship Building: Master stakeholder mapping to cultivate relationships with multiple contacts within an account, ensuring lasting partnerships. Negotiation Skills: Navigate negotiations with professionalism, understanding the art of give-and-take. Multi-Selling Approach: Drive engagement with various business stakeholders in parallel to create multifaceted selling opportunities. Empathetic Competitiveness: While being competitive, possess the ability to empathise and understand others’ perspectives. Entrepreneurial Mindset: Take initiative to grasp the expected outcomes and context, working independently to drive results. Effective Communication: Influence effectively at all levels, creating trust and collaboration within the team. How You’ll Grow By joining Qualtrics, you become part of a revolutionary team committed to shaping groundbreaking experiences. You will help us expand the XM category beyond where it is today with more advanced use cases & pioneering advancements in AI. Our mission is to build technology that positively impacts businesses and makes them more human. As a member of our global sales organisation, you will take ownership of a dedicated territory and develop robust strategies designed to drive demand and revenue. We foster an environment that encourages big-picture thinking, innovation, and creativity, enabling you to build relationships with multiple decision-makers and articulate the unique value proposition of Qualtrics. Things You’ll Do Focus on acquiring new business and sell the Qualtrics Platform to key accounts. Develop comprehensive account plans, from power maps to demand generation and closing strategies. Manage relationships between Qualtrics and senior executives of both client and prospect companies. Strategising internally with SDRs (sales development representatives), solutions consultants, partners etc to create demand and drive senior engagement in accounts. Gain a thorough understanding of prospects' business issues and industry challenges to craft tailored solutions. Build compelling business cases that demonstrate clear ROI and value for clients. Maintaining a real-time understanding of Qualtrics' offerings and the competitive landscape to provide win-based proposals and pricing strategies. What We’re Looking For On Your Resume Significant experience selling SaaS solutions, and experience in discussing strategic business issues at Director and C level in Large Enterprise accounts. Significant demonstrated success in driving and navigating C-level engagement & connections at the highest level. Significant experience in leading, planning and closing 7 figure deals. Significant experience in owning the full commercial capacity of Strategic Accounts. Strong track record in achieving and exceeding sales quotas. Ability to be creative in driving engagement with new contacts within an account. Fluency in German and English. You are passionate about educating potential clients on solutions relevant to their situation and helping them understand how the software can drive a return on investment for them. You can leverage your network in the market to generate interest in Qualtrics solutions. You have a desire to manage a territory like running your own consultancy. You engage with clients at all points of the sales cycle - from prospecting and acquiring clients, through demoing the Qualtrics product, to negotiating and closing, and beyond. You have the agility to adapt, pivot and change your approach based on the needs of your business. You partner well with internal teams and bring together internal resources that enable successful closure of deals. What You Should Know About This Team Qualtrics global sales team is dedicated to changing the way our customers focus on experiences. Forrester reports that companies generate a 674% return on investment when using Qualtrics. Now that's a solution you can get behind. As an Enterprise Sales professional, you will focus on new revenue through strategic, relationship-based selling. Our most successful sales employees have a track record of exceeding quotas, acting as trusted advisors to clients and being passionate teammates. The Qualtrics platform is versatile, adding value to a limitless array of decision makers. If you love a strategic, analytics sales process working with a variety of industries, departments and buyers, selling Qualtrics XM will always keep you learning and growing. Challenges excite us, as we view them as opportunities for growth and positive transformation. We are not merely observers of change; we actively initiate and drive it. Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits Worldwide and diverse community that enjoys helping each other At Qualtrics we are constantly working to create an environment where everyone feels safe and comfortable coming to work and can, as a result of our culture, make their best possible contribution to our team The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model : While this role is exempt from working in office, our hybrid work model remains elegantly simple for the rest of the company: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #remote Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic. ​​​​​​​Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws: Family & Medical Leave Act , Equal Opportunity Employment , Employee Polygraph Protection Act Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Qualtrics will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know. Not finding a role that’s the right fit for now? Qualtrics Insiders is the one-stop shop for all things Qualtrics Life. Sign up for exclusive access to content created with you in mind and get the scoop on what we have going on at Qualtrics - upcoming events, behind the scenes stories from the team, interview tips, hot jobs, and more. No spam - we promise! You'll hear from us two times a month max with fresh, totally tailored info - so be sure to stay connected as you explore your best role and company fit.

items.title: Growth Product Manager, HTS Media
items.summary: Headquarters: Toronto - Remote About the Role As a Growth Product Manager, HTS Media, you will own the roadmap for growing advertiser demand across brands: more qualified pipeline, faster campaign launches and higher advertiser spend within Hopper's ecosystem, working closely with engineering leadership, the sales team, Ad Operations and Account Ma
items.description: Product Headquarters: Toronto - Remote About the Role As a Growth Product Manager, HTS Media, you will own the roadmap for growing advertiser demand across brands: more qualified pipeline, faster campaign launches and higher advertiser spend within Hopper's ecosystem, working closely with engineering leadership, the sales team, Ad Operations and Account Management. This is a builder role: you will start by owning the roadmap for sales pipeline and sales efficiency, using AI-assisted systems to create demand and make every seller faster, then grow into owning the platform roadmap, including the campaign buying interfaces, in partnership with engineering leadership. In your first year, you'll be judged on the pipeline your systems create, how much faster campaigns go from signed to live, and growth in spend per advertiser. What would your day-to-day look like Own the roadmap for sales pipeline and sales efficiency, with goals and success metrics tied to a revenue target Build AI-powered systems that generate demand, from account research and signal-based targeting to personalized outreach and follow-up, and measure the pipeline and meetings they produce Grow into owning the platform roadmap for the campaign buying interfaces with engineering leadership: write the specs and decide what gets built, and in what order Work with Ad Operations to remove friction between a signed campaign and a live one Put insights into the buying interface, such as forecasts, benchmarks and media plan recommendations Use SQL on booking, search and campaign data to size opportunities, find advertiser results and decide what to build next Run demand experiments across channels such as LinkedIn, email and events, and track results in internal dashboards Support HTS Media positioning and reusable sales materials (deck templates, one-pagers and case studies), and the HTS Media website and offers site An ideal candidate has 4+ years of experience in product management or growth at a technology company, ideally in B2B SaaS, marketplaces or ad tech; experience in online advertising or travel is a plus A track record of owning a roadmap and shipping product with engineering that moved a measurable growth metric, such as pipeline, conversion, time to launch or spend per account Hands-on experience building AI-assisted or automated workflows that a real sales team used, with tools such as Clay, n8n, Zapier or Make, and LLM APIs (equivalents are fine), and the ability to describe what you built and what it produced Strong SQL on a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, and comfort turning booking, search and ad-serving data into decisions, forecasts and in-product insights Excellent writing and specification skills, and the ability to work with engineering leadership and communicate clearly with advertisers and internal teams Self-driven and organized, and comfortable building without a playbook in a fast-growing business Perks and benefits of working with us Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for group insurance plan Hopper offers life, short term and long term disability coverage HSA that covers eligible medical and dental expenses All employees and dependents have access to Dialogue’s telemedicine services, anytime, anywhere All employees have access to an RRSP plan with automatic pre-tax withdrawals per pay Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards! Unlimited PTO Carrot Cash travel stipend Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business Open communication with management and company leadership Small, dynamic teams = massive impact About Hopper At Hopper, we're building the leading travel technology platform in the world, and we're doing it by solving real problems for real travelers globally. Our Hopper consumer booking platforms and HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), our B2B business, work together to give travelers something the industry has never reliably offered: transparency, flexibility, and real savings on every trip. We combine massive amounts of data and AI with proprietary fintech products to make that happen, not just another booking engine, but a fundamentally better way to plan and experience travel for our customers and our partners. We are proof that better-for-the-customer and better-for-the-business can be one in the same And we're continuing to grow fast! The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times, with 70% of our users being Gen Z and Millennials, next-generation travelers. Today, our biggest opportunity is powering travel fintech, commerce, and loyalty for some of the biggest brands in the industry. Our first HTS partnership with Capital One helped launch a dedicated travel portal for a major financial brand's cardholders, and we've since expanded across some of the biggest names in travel and banking, including Air Canada, Uber, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), and Nubank, powering everything from a single fintech integration to a full end-to-end travel loyalty portal. That's our trajectory: we started as a small, disruptive app within the travel space, and now we're the engine under the hood powering how Travel Tech works. What that looks like in practice: Billions of dollars in travel and travel fintech move through Hopper and HTS every year Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Disruption Assistance for Any Reason, post exceptionally strong customer satisfaction because the terms are clear and resolutions are instant, no questions asked Nearly 30% of app customers add a fintech product to their booking, and those customers are 1.6x more likely to book with us again HTS now drives more than 90% of the business, proof of how fast B2B has scaled Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies) can plug the company’s fintech, commerce and AI solutions into their own channels, whether that's a single integration or a full end-to-end travel portal Come take off with us! #LI-Remote At Hopper, we leverage AI-driven tools to assist our team in efficiently reviewing applications. These tools help us assess qualifications fairly and objectively. By submitting your application, you acknowledge the use of these automated screening technologies. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hopper-growth-product-manager-hts-media

items.summary: Headquarters: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States URL: https://www.skillz.com About Beamable Beamable is the backend and LiveOps infrastructure platform for game developers, the system that lets studios build, operate, and scale live games without constructing the underlying architecture themselves. Backend services, identity, analytics, meta-game sys
items.description: Product Headquarters: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States URL: https://www.skillz.com About Beamable Beamable is the backend and LiveOps infrastructure platform for game developers, the system that lets studios build, operate, and scale live games without constructing the underlying architecture themselves. Backend services, identity, analytics, meta-game systems, virtual economies, and AI-native tooling: all integrated into a single platform that eliminates the point-solution stitching that has defined game development for too long. Beamable also powers Wingman, an agentic LiveOps product that gives game teams a unified operating system to understand, optimize, and act on live game performance in real time. This is the future of how games are operated. Beamable is part of FIRY , a founder-led global technology portfolio operating at the intersection of gaming, AI-powered performance marketing, and developer infrastructure. Acquired in January 2026, and together with Skillz, our competition platform, and RZR , our AI-driven ad network, Beamable sits at the foundation of a compounding ecosystem that no standalone competitor can replicate. If you want to build the infrastructure that games run on at a company with the vision and resources to back it — Beamable is the right place to do it. About the Role Beamable is seeking a Head of Product to shape its platform vision and lead its next phase of growth in the game backend market. This is an opportunity to build the product function from the ground up, guide the platform from early access through public release, and advance AI integration to deliver meaningful value for game studios. As the company’s senior product leader and sole product practitioner, you will own product strategy, roadmap, launch milestones, and success metrics, combining strategic direction with hands-on execution. You will work directly with studios and design partners, represent Beamable’s product vision at industry events, and translate customer insights into clear priorities. Success in this role means delivering a successful public launch, developing early-access studios into reference customers, and establishing a product foundation that drives adoption and sustained revenue growth. Responsibilities Product Strategy & Vision Ownership. Set the product vision for Beamable’s platform — spanning player engagement, developer tools, data enrichment, and player intelligence — and own the roadmap from early access through public release and beyond. Partner with the CRO on packaging, pricing, and tracking the studio funnel quantitatively. Public Release & Launch Execution. Drive Beamable’s product through its launch milestones: early design partners, public release, and strategic partnerships. Define and own the go/no-go criteria for each milestone, ensuring the product ships when it’s ready to win. Studio Partnership & Customer Discovery. Spend meaningful time every week with studios, design partners, and game developers — running discovery calls, demos, onboarding sessions, and roadmap reviews. Join sales calls and paid pilots with the CRO and turn each design partner into a reference case. AI Integration & Product Intelligence. Define the guardrails, data policies, and feedback loops that make Beamable’s AI capabilities safe, effective, and trustworthy for game teams. Integrate with best-in-class tools studios already use and shape the intelligent systems that differentiate the platform. Metrics Ownership & Product Function Build-Out. Define success metrics across the studio lifecycle — time to value, pilot conversion, retention, usage, and revenue per studio — and do your own analysis in SQL. Establish the product processes Beamable runs on: discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch reviews. Key Competencies Platform Product Strategy. Proven ability to set and execute product vision for a developer-facing platform, owning the strategy across multiple capability areas simultaneously — not just a feature set. Customer-Facing Product Leadership. Equally credible with studio heads, producers, and engineers. Comfortable running a demo, leading a discovery call, supporting a sale, and representing the product at industry events including GDC and Gamescom. Gaming Live-Ops Domain Expertise. Deep understanding of what a studio’s growth or live-ops team does day-to-day — events, offers, economies, segmentation, player support, and player data — and what slows them down. AI/ML Product Judgment. Experience shipping AI or ML-driven features to production. Knows where AI adds genuine value, where it needs guardrails, and how to define data policies that serve both studio needs and platform integrity. Data Fluency & Metrics Ownership. Can build dashboards, write SQL, and live with retention, churn, and revenue metrics over time. Runs experiments before big bets rather than after. 0-to-1 Startup Product Leadership. Comfortable being the only PM in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment. Has built product processes from scratch and can hold the strategy and the execution at the same time. Technical Depth. Conversant in data warehouses, APIs, SDKs, and system design. Can earn the respect of engineers and studio technical leads without needing a dedicated translator. Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Design, or a related field; equivalent experience considered. 10+ years in product management, including experience as a product lead or head of product owning a product line’s strategy — not just a feature set. Proven experience in gaming live-ops — either running live games or building tools for teams that do: events, offers, economies, segmentation, player support, or player data. Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup as a solo or founding PM, with demonstrated comfort operating in ambiguity with shifting priorities. At least one AI or ML-driven feature shipped to production and used by real customers. Demonstrated data fluency: SQL, product analytics tools, and a track record of living with business metrics over time to drive decisions. Experience with customer engagement platforms (Braze, CleverTap), game backends (PlayFab, Nakama, Unity Gaming Services), or data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery) preferred. Experience taking a product from early access to public launch preferred. Total Starting Compensation including Base + Bonus + Equity: $212,625 + Bonus + Equity Location: Remote - CA, NV, or NY Travel Requirement: Less than 10% Why Beamable Comprehensive Benefits. 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. 401K matching, equity incentives, pre-tax benefit options, and more. Wellness Support. Meditation and mental health resources, physical fitness coaching and classes, family planning assistance, virtual therapy sessions, and more. Time Off. Competitive PTO and company holidays. Beamable embraces diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with applicable fair chance ordinances. #GC-Remote #GC-1 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/firy-head-of-product-beamable

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://wisetechglobal.com Company Description WiseTech Global is a leading developer and provider of innovative software solutions for the logistics, global trade and supply chain industries worldwide. We serve more than 22,000 logistics companies across 193 countries, 23 of the 25 largest global freight forwarders worldwide. With the acquisition of e2open, we have expanded our network to encompass over 500,000 connected enterprises across manufacturing, logistics, channels and distribution. With the vision to be the operating system for global trade and logistics, we are creating a multi-sided marketplace connecting carriers, logistics providers, importers, exporters and shippers. Job Description A Pivotal Moment — Why Join E2open Now In August 2025 WiseTech Global, developer of the world's leading logistics execution software CargoWise, completed its strategic acquisition of e2open. This acquisition represents one of the most significant strategic moves in global supply chain technology in recent years, and it creates an extraordinary moment to join this business. WiseTech's CargoWise platform has historically focused on logistics service providers such as freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers. The e2open acquisition brings a deep, complementary product suite and customer base on the other side of the supply chain: the buyers, importers, exporters, shippers, manufacturers and brand owners who generate the freight in the first place. Together, the two businesses create something that has never existed before: a truly end-to-end, multi-sided global trade and logistics marketplace connecting demand, planning, supply, channel, transportation and execution in one ecosystem, all underpinned by AI and data at scale. The Opportunity We are seeking an experienced and driven Area Sales Director to join our growing US sales organization. Each Area Sales Director owns a portfolio of approximately 20-30 enterprise accounts within our CPG business unit. This role sits at the intersection of sales and professional services, with our most successful team members acting as strategic consultants and trusted advisors to our clients to help drive wider adoption of our existing product suite. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery. What You'll Do Build and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving cross-sell, upsell and new logo revenue. Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Germany Munich Als Head of Lead Generation verantwortest du den Aufbau, die Performance und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Leadgenerierung. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Cold Calling. Du bringst fundierte praktische Erfahrung aus der telefonischen Kaltakquise mit, weißt, wie erfolgreiche Outbound-Prozesse funktionieren, und kannst dieses Wissen an ein Team weitergeben. Du bist sowohl operativ als auch strategisch tätig: Du führst und trainierst unsere Cold Caller, optimierst Prozesse und erschließt bei Bedarf weitere Kanäle zur Leadgenerierung. Dabei bist du technisch affin, prozessverliebt und nutzt gerne technische Lösungen und KI-Tools, um unsere Leadgenerierung smarter und effizienter zu gestalten. Tools wie Zapier, Claude Code, Enrichment Tools wie Lusha und Co sollten dir bekannt sein! Aufgaben Operatives Cold Calling: Du kontaktierst potenzielle B2B-Kunden telefonisch, qualifizierst Leads und vereinbarst Termine für unser Sales-Team Teamführung und Training: Du führst unser Cold-Calling-Team, schulst neue Mitarbeitende und coachst das Team, um die Gesprächsqualität und Performance kontinuierlich zu verbessern Strategische Leadgenerierung: Du entwickelst unsere Leadgen-Strategie weiter, definierst Ziele und optimierst bestehende Prozesse. Weitere Outbound-Kanäle: Du steuerst und entwickelst zusätzliche Kanäle wie LinkedIn-Outreach, Cold Mailing und Paid Ads Performance-Management: Du analysierst KPIs, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und sorgst für die Erreichung individueller und gemeinsamer Ziele Prozessoptimierung: Du entwickelst Leitfäden, Standards und Best Practices für eine effiziente und skalierbare Leadgenerierung und nutzt Technologie, KI und Automatisierung, um unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich zu optimieren Qualifikation Was du dafür mitbringen musst: Mindestens 1 Jahr praktische Cold-Calling-Erfahrung Erfahrung in der B2B-Neukundengewinnung Erfahrung in der Führung und im Training von Vertriebsteams Du bist technisch affin, prozessverliebt und bringst Erfahrung mit KI-Tools mit und hast Lust, diese gezielt im Vertrieb einzusetzen Idealerweise Erfahrung mit weiteren Outbound-Kanälen Strategisches Denken und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität Benefits Betriebliche Weiterbildung Flexible Arbeitszeiten 100 % Remote - Arbeite von überall! Unsere Vision? Wir bauen das beste Livetrainingsangebot für Unternehmen im deutschsprachigen Markt auf! Aktuell haben wir zu viele hungrige Interessenten und brauchen dringend High-Performer, die sich unsere Mission anschließen wollen. Wenn du also hungrig auf mehr bist und massiv wachsen möchtest - bewirb dich noch heute bei uns! Art der Stelle: Festanstellung, ggf. items.description: Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows. Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson. Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations. As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design. At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey. This is a remote role that must be based in EST. At Tines, our Customer Experience organization is recognized by customers for the quality of our work, responsiveness to their needs, and commitment to helping them realize meaningful value from our platform. Within Customer Experience, the Renewals team plays a critical role in protecting and growing our customer relationships by creating a predictable, consistent, and customer-centered renewal experience. Renewal Managers partner closely with Customer Success, Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Legal, and Deal Desk to manage the commercial renewal process, navigate complex negotiations, identify risk early, and ensure customers can continue their partnership with Tines with clarity and confidence. As M anager, Renewals , you will lead and develop a high-performing team of Renewal Managers responsible for executing renewals across our customer base. You will be accountable for renewal performance, forecasting accuracy, commercial execution, team development, and the processes that allow the function to scale. You will also play a key role in strengthening the broader customer lifecycle at Tines, helping establish clear ownership and operating rhythms between Customer Success, Renewals, and Sales while ensuring that customer value, risk, and commercial strategy come together effectively at renewal. What will you be doing? Lead and develop a team of Renewal Managers, providing coaching, commercial guidance, and clear direction to drive strong customer and business outcomes. Own renewal performance across the portfolio, with accountability for Gross Revenue Retention, renewal rate, churn and contraction outcomes, and on-time renewal execution. Establish and maintain a consistent renewal forecast, providing leadership with clear visibility into renewal timing, risk, expected outcomes, and areas requiring intervention. Guide Renewal Managers through complex customer negotiations involving pricing, contract terms, multi-year agreements, competitive pressure, procurement, and other commercial challenges. Ensure renewal engagement begins early and that Renewal Managers have the customer context, risk signals, value realization, and relationship insights required to execute effectively. Partner closely with Customer Success to ensure clear ownership between customer outcomes and commercial renewal execution, with CSMs focused on value, adoption, relationships, and risk mitigation while Renewals leads the commercial renewal process. Collaborate with Sales and Account Management to identify and coordinate expansion opportunities associated with renewal cycles while maintaining clear ownership across teams. Partner with Revenue Operations to improve renewal forecasting, CRM workflows, dashboards, automation, reporting, and operational discipline. Develop scalable renewal motions across customer segments, including high-touch, mid-touch, and digital or automated approaches where appropriate. Establish clear renewal playbooks, timelines, escalation paths, handoffs, and operating cadences that create consistency for customers and internal teams. Establish and manage metrics and KPIs that measure renewal effectiveness, including GRR, logo retention, forecast accuracy, renewal timing, cycle time, multi-year adoption, team productivity, and portfolio health. Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain strong commercial talent as the Renewals function and company continue to scale. What will you bring with you? 7+ years of experience in SaaS, enterprise software, Customer Success, Account Management, Renewals, Sales, or a similar commercial customer-facing environment. 3+ years of people leadership experience, with a demonstrated track record of coaching and developing high-performing customer-facing or commercial teams. Experience owning or managing a meaningful recurring revenue portfolio and delivering against retention or renewal targets. A strong understanding of SaaS business metrics including ARR, Gross Revenue Retention, Net Revenue Retention, churn, contraction, renewal rate, and expansion. Experience building and managing renewal forecasts with a high degree of operational rigor and predictability. Strong commercial judgment and experience navigating pricing, negotiation, procurement, contracting, and customer objections. The ability to coach teams through complex commercial situations while balancing customer relationships, revenue protection, and long-term business value. Experience working closely with Customer Success and Sales teams to coordinate customer strategy and commercial outcomes. Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to identify trends, diagnose performance, and determine where intervention is required. A track record of improving workflows, standardization, automation, or systems to increase organizational efficiency and capacity. Strong cross-functional leadership skills and demonstrated ability to influence Revenue Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and executive stakeholders. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to navigate both detailed commercial discussions and senior executive conversations. What success looks like In this role, you will build a Renewals organization that creates greater predictability for the business and a simpler, more consistent experience for customers. Your team will engage customers earlier, identify and address risk before renewals become reactive, execute commercial conversations with confidence, and provide accurate visibility into renewal outcomes. Customer Success teams will be able to remain focused on driving value, adoption, strategic relationships, and risk mitigation while Renewal Managers bring dedicated commercial expertise to the renewal process. At the same time, you will help Tines develop a renewal motion that can scale with the business combining strong talent, clear ownership, operational discipline, automation, and data to improve retention and strengthen long-term customer relationships. Target Annual Compensation: $150-170K OTE (70/30 split) Applicants for this opportunity must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. #LI-SW1 At Tines, we’re all about trying new things and taking the leap. If you’re second-guessing your application, we hope you’ll trust your gut and take the leap too! Applying for a new job isn’t always easy, especially if you’re thinking of a career pivot – but we’re big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you’ve nothing to worry about. A variety of experience, perspectives, and voices makes us the company we are . We’d love to hear from you. Tines provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to sex, race, colour, ethnic or social origin, genetic features, language, religion or belief, political or any other opinion, membership of a national minority, property, birth, disability, age or sexual orientation. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Scope of Work Clean, preprocess, and structure complex and messy datasets using advanced statistical software (such as R, Python, SAS, or Stata). Apply and document basic descriptive and inferential statistical analyses to uncover trends and patterns in real-world data. Develop clear and compelling data visualizations to illustrate key findings and support model development. Contribute expertise in dataset annotation, labeling, or enrichment to enhance the quality of AI model training datasets. Draft concise, well-organized written summaries of methods, analyses, and results for a non-technical audience. Collaborate asynchronously with project stakeholders to clarify requirements, resolve ambiguities, and improve deliverables through effective written and verbal communication. Continuously identify data quality issues, provide actionable recommendations, and document solutions for handling dirty or incomplete data. Preferred Qualifications Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Biostatistics, or a related quantitative field. Expertise in cleaning and preparing complex, messy (“dirty”) datasets with R, Python, SAS, or Stata. Proficiency in basic descriptive and inferential statistical techniques, including hypothesis testing and regression analysis. Strong programming skills in Python or R for statistical analysis, data manipulation, and visualization. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex findings to non-technical and technical audiences with clarity and precision. Experience working with large, unstructured, or noisy datasets across a variety of domains. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on detailed documentation and collaboration in remote environments. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Product Headquarters: Burlington, MA OR US Remote Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market? Look no further than Veracode! Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment. Learn more at www.veracode.com , on the Veracode blog , and on LinkedIn and Twitter . We are looking for a motivated Performance Test Engineer with 3–5 years of experience to join our Quality Engineering team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in performance testing, scripting, and analyzing application performance. You will work closely with Performance Engineers, Developers, and Quality Engineers to identify performance bottlenecks, validate application scalability, and ensure our products meet performance and reliability expectations. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, execute, and maintain performance test scripts using tools such as Apache JMeter, Locust, and K6 . Conduct load, stress, scalability, and endurance testing for APIs and web applications. Execute weekly release performance tests , analyze results, identify regressions, and report findings to ensure release readiness. Analyze performance test results to identify bottlenecks, response-time degradation, and resource utilization issues. Monitor application and infrastructure metrics, including CPU, memory, throughput, latency, and error rates. Collaborate with development teams to investigate performance issues and validate fixes. Develop and maintain reusable performance testing scripts and test data. Participate in integrating performance tests into CI/CD pipelines. Document test scenarios, execution results, and performance findings. Support performance regression testing as part of regular release cycles. Work with senior engineers to improve performance testing frameworks and processes. Required Qualifications 3–5 years of experience in software testing, including hands-on performance testing experience. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Practical experience with Apache JMeter or similar performance testing tools. Good understanding of performance testing concepts, including load testing, stress testing, throughput, latency, and concurrency. Experience testing REST APIs and understanding HTTP/HTTPS protocols. Basic programming or scripting experience with Python, Java, or JavaScript. Ability to analyze performance results and troubleshoot application issues. Familiarity with Linux environments and basic command-line utilities. Understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile methodologies, and CI/CD processes. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with K6, Locust , or other modern performance testing frameworks. Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus. Working knowledge of AWS services such as EC2, EKS, CloudWatch, and basic cloud networking concepts. Basic understanding of Kubernetes and Docker , including containers, pods, deployments, and resource utilization. Experience with UI test automation using frameworks such as Cypress, Selenium, or Playwright. Familiarity with AI-assisted testing and development tools , including using generative AI to create test scripts, analyze results, troubleshoot failures, or improve automation efficiency. Basic knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) concepts. Familiarity with Git commands and repository management , including branching, committing changes, creating merge requests, and resolving basic merge conflicts. Experience with GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar automation pipelines. Basic understanding of databases, SQL queries, and application architecture. Familiarity with distributed systems and microservices. What We’re Looking For A curious engineer who enjoys troubleshooting and understanding how systems behave under load. Someone comfortable analyzing data and communicating technical findings. A proactive team player who can work independently on assigned testing activities while collaborating with senior engineers. An engineer interested in leveraging AI and automation to improve testing efficiency and engineering productivity. A strong desire to learn new performance engineering tools, technologies, and methodologies. What we offer you: Outstanding Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage to meet all your healthcare needs. Wellness benefits to help you focus on what’s most important. “Take What You Need” time off policy. Extensive development and training offerings to help you grow your career at Veracode. Generous 401k match to help save for your future . Amazing community of professionals who take pride in what we do every day. Compensation Transparency In accordance with U.S. pay transparency laws, Veracode provides compensation transparency for roles based in the United States. Click here to view our compensation ranges by grade. Please note, specific compensation may be influenced by various factors including candidates experience, education, and work location. Job Grade: Career Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information. Here’s our recruitment promise to you: Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers. Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware. Email Verification: Recruiting emails from Veracode will always originate from an “@veracode.com" email address. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter, or telephone communication claiming to be from Veracode, please reach out to us at careers@veracode.com before taking any further action. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/veracode-performance-test-engineer

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/9wfGQ1tsnTpFJumPRzBDFL/jobs-at-the-fidget-game About The Fidget Game We're both an educational company and a toy company. We make multisensory educational board games for Pre-K through Grade 6, built on the science of reading and aligned with math standards, plus collectible toys, squishies, and unboxing products kids love to open, trade, and share. Founded by a former teacher with six years of classroom experience across six countries, The Fidget Game has grown into a fast-growing consumer brand: Used in 50,000+ schools 1,000,000+ games sold Featured on Shark Tank Our next chapter: becoming a household name in children's educational games and toys. The Opportunity We're hiring a Senior Head of Marketing to lead our marketing department, strengthen our brand, and drive profitable growth across educational games, sensory toys, and collectibles. This is a hands-on senior leadership role covering both strategy and execution. You'll set the plan, direct the team, and own the results, so our founder can step back from day-to-day marketing decisions. You'll lead the marketing team: Head of Growth: paid media strategy, buying, and acquisition Head of Creative Marketing & Partnerships: creative production, content, and creator partnerships Video Editor, Graphic Designer, and Junior Creative Strategist What you own vs. what you influence. You own marketing strategy, creative direction, campaign and launch priorities, team performance, and the approved marketing budget. The Head of Growth owns the marketing KPIs and paid buying, marketplace teams run Amazon advertising and channel budgets, and the CEO approves the overall budget and major investments. Responsibilities Lead brand positioning, creative direction, storytelling, and multichannel campaign execution. Drive product launches, influencer programs, organic social, and marketplace marketing. Build and manage a high-performing marketing team, agencies, and processes. Partner with growth teams to improve performance through continuous creative testing. Develop integrated marketing strategies aligned with ambitious revenue and growth targets. What You'll Own Strategy & growth Build annual and quarterly marketing plans tied to revenue, profitability, and brand goals. Lead integrated marketing across Shopify/DTC, Amazon (US, Canada, UK), TikTok Shop, retail, and B2B, in partnership with channel owners. Recommend budgets and investments to the CEO, then manage the approved budget against targets. Performance & accountability Align marketing goals, plans, and campaigns with the KPIs owned by the Head of Growth: MER, CAC, ROAS, conversion rate, AOV, LTV, retention, and contribution margin. Build dashboards and reporting that make results visible, and act quickly on what's underperforming. Work with Finance, Operations, and Sales so marketing decisions fit margins and inventory. Brand & creative Sharpen our positioning as both a trusted educational brand and an exciting toy brand, for parents, educators, and kids. Set creative direction and priorities for the Head of Creative Marketing & Partnerships. Run a structured creative testing loop between Creative and Growth, balancing storytelling with commercial results. Social, creators & community Lead strategy for organic social, influencers, creators, UGC, and affiliates, with clear goals for each. Guide founder-led content so it supports brand and commercial objectives. Align organic, creator, TikTok Shop, and paid efforts. Launches, schools & events Build a repeatable launch playbook for frequent product releases, with clear goals, budgets, and owners. Partner with B2B Sales on marketing to teachers, schools, districts, and retailers. Lead marketing for trade shows such as New York Toy Fair, and represent the company at key events. Team & AI Coach the team, set clear expectations, and run regular performance reviews. Put in place a RACI, campaign calendar, and project systems that keep execution consistent. Build practical AI workflows across research, planning, ideation, and reporting, and train the team to use them. Manage agencies and external partners against clear expectations. What Success Looks Like First 30 days: understand and take ownership Learn our products, customers, channels, and unit economics. Assess current performance, team, workflows, budgets, and reporting. Take over day-to-day marketing priorities and team coordination. First 90 days: set the strategy Present a 12-month marketing strategy with quarterly priorities, targets, and budget recommendations. Launch KPIs and dashboards, a creative testing process, and a RACI for the department. Ship the first wave of integrated campaigns under your leadership. First 12 months: deliver growth Hit agreed targets for revenue, acquisition, retention, and profitability. Have repeatable systems running for launches, creators, organic social, and creative testing. Run a department that operates independently, with minimal day-to-day founder involvement. What You Bring Required 8+ years in consumer brand, integrated, or e-commerce marketing, including 3+ years managing teams. Experience as a Head of Marketing, Marketing Director, or equivalent senior leader. A track record helping scale a $20M+ DTC, e-commerce, or CPG brand, with measurable revenue and efficiency gains. Strong command of Shopify/DTC, acquisition, retention, and multichannel marketing. Fluency in marketing financials (MER, CAC, ROAS, contribution margin, AOV, LTV) and experience building budgets and forecasts. Proven wins in brand campaigns, influencer marketing, organic social, short-form video, and product launches. Experience leading creative and performance teams, functional leaders, and agencies. Advanced, hands-on AI skills, with real examples of improving marketing efficiency. Ability to travel occasionally for trade shows and company meetings, such as New York Toy Fair (expenses covered). Bonus points Toy, children's, educational, or family brand experience. Marketing to parents, teachers, or schools. Amazon, TikTok Shop, retail, or international e-commerce experience. Building marketing systems in a fast-growing, founder-led company. Competitive salary based on experience _______________ Due to the high volume of applications, we can only contact candidates who have been selected for an interview. If you haven't heard from us within 3 weeks of applying, please know that we've decided not to move forward with your application this time. To keep the process fair for all applicants, we're unable to respond to direct messages or emails about application status. We truly appreciate your interest in The Fidget Game and thank you for taking the time to apply! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/the-fidget-game-senior-head-of-marketing

We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply! About Thrive Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar. Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon. Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together. The Opportunity This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat. The Role Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Strategist, you'll ensure Thrive operates at peak performance by establishing efficient processes, implementing best practices, and fostering growth within your team in both technical and strategic areas. Your mission will be to develop and execute project growth initiatives, lead a high-performing team, and uphold our company philosophy. You’ll focus on setting your team up for success by enhancing the systems used to build, maintain, and grow client relationships through continuous improvement of philosophies, programs, policies, and processes. Working Within Our Values: At Thrive, we value teamwork and a "no politics" culture. This means that no matter your title, everyone is committed to contributing in whatever way is needed to ensure project success. Your role involves both high-level, strategic leadership and rolling up your sleeves for hands-on execution when required. Your focus of responsibilities will be: Domain: Recognized as an emerging leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges, elevate team skills, and drive program growth by enabling teams to excel in their projects and careers. Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across mid-sized projects. You’re responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators. Client : Organizing and leading high-impact client relationship drivers, such as client onboards and business reviews, and using the latest and most cutting-edge methods and tools available to achieve successful outcomes. Example: You lead strategic conversations with small to mid-sized clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts. People: Elevating people you work directly and indirectly with to bring best-in-class solutions to projects through their thinking and execution. Supporting the development of team members to grow company performance expertise. Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a manager level, you address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are an expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care. Company: Lead a culture of project excellence in the Performance department by guiding daily interactions, developing initiatives, and aligning individual efforts with organizational goals. Monitor team workflow, use business intelligence tools to optimize people and project allocation. Example: You lead team-level conversations and support initiatives that keep Thrive on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed. We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role: In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships. In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others. In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. Qualifications You have executed, planned and maintained multi-channel, full funnel performance marketing accounts of $200k+ USD media spend per month at a consistently positive ROI for the client across multiple platforms at a time (e.g., Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, Display, Programmatic Platforms, TikTok, Twitter, Spotify and others). You have experience directly collaborating with and delegating to junior team members as a senior account manager. You have contributed to the development of multiple team members by leading training and providing strategic guidance and project leadership to the point of developing others to the next stage of seniority / role level. You have advanced analytical skills and are experienced in using visualization tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or similar platforms to pull, sort, analyze and draw insight from ad platforms, analytics, and / or business intelligence tools. You’ve managed performance media across a range of business verticals and sizes (ecommerce, demand gen, etc), and have been responsible for pacing, forecasting and reporting the impact of performance media on overarching business goals. You have successfully managed client and / or key stakeholder relationships (ranging in seniority) via weekly touchpoint meetings, quarterly business presentations and asynchronous communication channels (Slack, email, Asana, etc). You’ve resolved difficult stakeholder situations, keeping priorities organized and objectives aligned and have consistently received buy-in on strategic proposals or deliverables. You have effectively communicated with clients on marketing concepts such as incrementality, KPI selection, attribution and business economics and have incorporated marketing measurement considerations into your strategic approaches. --- Equal Opportunity Employer Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued. Competitive Total Compensation Package At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France. Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love. Tide facts: Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing Over $300 million raised in funding 3,000 Tideans globally We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg ABOUT THE TEAM: Tide Payroll lets UK small businesses pay themselves and their staff, file with HMRC and run pensions from the same place they bank. Thousands of businesses rely on it every payday, so it has to be right every time. You will lead a small, cross-functional team and shape where Payroll goes next. ABOUT THE ROLE: The engineering challenge here is correctness and reliability. Payroll works out tax, National Insurance, student loans and pensions, then sends them to HMRC and pension providers on fixed deadlines. A pay run is either right on payday or someone is paid the wrong amount. Holding that standard as member numbers grow, and as tax rules change every April, is the core of this role. As an Engineering Manager at Tide you will design, build and run the products in your area. We have a long roadmap ahead of us and rarely run out of interesting problems to tackle. This role offers an exceptional opportunity to make a real difference by taking ownership of engineering practices in a rapidly expanding company. We trust and empower our Engineering Managers to make real architectural decisions that affect their domain and shape the future of Tide’s One Platform. We work in full-stack teams, grouped under common domains that own products in Tide’s product catalogue. Our engineers self-organise, gather together to discuss technical challenges, and set their own guidelines in our Communities of Practice. As Engineering Manager for Payroll, you will be: Owning the full Payroll stack: a Go backend, a React web frontend, an Angular microfrontend, and the Payroll Backoffice tools. Defining the target architecture, including whether the React app stays or is replaced, and making the platform ready for expansion into other markets Owning the reliability of every pay run, HMRC filing and pension submission, and building the monitoring that tells us something has failed before a customer does Turning HMRC rules and their edge cases into clear product rules, working with our compliance advisers when a case is unclear Leading the engineers in your team, carefully dividing your time between design, coding and coaching. You will be the person people turn to for advice and solutions to difficult problems Running the escalation rota with Operations and fixing the causes of repeat issues, not each case Regularly aligning your roadmap and architecture with other Engineering Managers to make multi-domain work succeed Working closely with product, mobile engineers, operations and compliance to turn requirements into well-engineered solutions Making key contributions to our Communities of Practice, including how teams use AI tools in their daily work WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR: Experience and background Extensive experience (10+ years) building server-side applications. Go is ideal; strong experience in Java or another strongly typed language also works Working knowledge of modern web frontends (React or Angular), enough to guide design decisions and review code Experience running microservices and building and consuming RESTful APIs Experience engineering scalable and reliable solutions in a cloud-native environment Experience replacing or retiring part of a live system without disrupting customers A track record of improving reliability: monitoring, alerting, incident response and service levels that reflect what customers experience Comfort with detailed rules: you enjoy getting to the bottom of a complex case and making the answer repeatable A mindset of delivering secure, well-tested and well-documented software, and owning your code and your team’s processes from development to production Exposure to complex solutions in financial or payment services, and to integrating with third-party providers and partners Experience with relational databases and with continuous integration, delivery and deployment The ability to explain technical concepts to a non-technical audience Nice to have UK payroll, tax or pensions knowledge (RTI, PAYE, auto-enrolment). We will support you to take the CIPP payroll course if you do not have it Flutter experience OUR TECH STACK: (Only for technology roles) Java, Spring Boot and JOOQ for the RESTful APIs of our microservices, with Go in Payroll (we welcome people used to any strongly typed general-purpose language) Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS, SQS and Kafka MySQL and PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users) Docker, Terraform and EKS to run the platform DataDog and Rollbar to keep it running GitHub with Sonarcloud, Semgrep and solid testing to power the CI/CD pipelines. New joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first 2 weeks Angular and React on Web, Flutter for the Mobile App Fivetran, Snowflake and Looker for BI, and Python with ML libraries for automated decisioning and risk management WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN: Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans: Competitive salary Group Life Insurance Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing 24 ⁄ 7 Employee Assistance Programme 25 days holiday with the ability to buy extra days We invest in your development with a £1,000 professional L&D budget per year Access to ‘salary sacrifice’ benefits such as Cycle to Work scheme and pension contribution Spacious brand-new office in Liverpool street with an all-day snacks bar Enhanced family-friendly leave 3 days for L&D or volunteering time off per year Flexible working options Sabbatical leave Share options TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community. #MP-1 #LI-REMOTE TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard. At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members’ diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard. Please be aware that: Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel. Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf. If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.
