items.description: Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins. Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end. Overview As the Senior Growth Marketing Manager , you are responsible for spearheading Rithum’s digital advertising efforts and driving efficient client acquisition across online channels, with a strong emphasis on B2B Google search engine marketing (PPC). You own performance marketing strategy and execution end to end, partner with creative, product, and analytics teams, and are accountable for ROI, client acquisition, and revenue growth targets. At Rithum, all team members are expected to leverage AI to work smarter, accelerate decision-making, automate repeatable work, and improve outcomes. You are encouraged to continuously identify opportunities to apply AI, data, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, drive innovation, and deliver greater value for our clients, partners, and teams while maintaining appropriate judgment, quality, security, and compliance. Responsibilities Paid Media Strategy & Execution Spearhead digital advertising strategy, developing and executing performance marketing plans that drive efficient client acquisition, revenue growth, and ROI targets, with an emphasis on B2B Google search engine marketing (PPC). Manage digital advertising campaigns end to end, including planning, implementation, execution, optimization, and performance analysis. Execute and manage digital paid media plans for PPC and display on a real-time bidding platform. Monitor and optimize advertising budgets to ensure efficient allocation of resources and maximize ROI. Deep understanding of content strategy for paid media and be able to work cross-group collaboratively with the content team and/or agency to outline and deliver needs. Search Platform Management Manage, review, and perform daily account responsibilities for Google Ads and other search platforms. Maintain and monitor keyword bids, daily and monthly budget caps, impression share, quality score, audience lists, and other key account metrics. Manage the creation of large keyword lists and tie them consistently back to the overall SEM strategy. Testing, Analytics & Optimization Monitor KPIs including click-through rate, conversion rate across each funnel stage, cost per acquisition, return on ad spend, and lifetime value, and take proactive action to improve campaign performance. Conduct A/B and multivariate testing on ad variations, messaging, and targeting parameters to maximize campaign effectiveness. Use data-driven insights to identify optimization opportunities across audience targeting, ad creative, bidding strategies, and landing pages. Conduct deep-dive analysis to answer specific business questions, uncover insights, and recommend improvements to digital marketing strategies and tactics. Reporting, Collaboration & Innovation Build digital marketing analytics dashboards and prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reports and presentations that communicate results, insights, and recommendations to key stakeholders. Collaborate with creative, product, and analytics teams to align and integrate marketing efforts, and manage relationships with external agencies, vendors, and partners to support campaign execution. Embed AI into campaign planning, audience analysis, creative testing, and reporting, and share effective prompts and workflows across teams. Stay informed about industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in growth marketing, and incorporate innovative strategies into campaigns. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications 8+ years of experience in B2B Google search, digital advertising, growth marketing, or a related field, driving measurable results against ROI targets. Proficiency in digital advertising platforms, including Google Ads, Facebook Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Twitter Ads, and other relevant channels. Hands-on experience with performance marketing tools such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and Facebook Business Manager. Proficiency using analytics tools such as Excel, Salesforce, Looker Studio, Tableau, or Domo to drive business insights. Experience measuring and monitoring performance of brand search keyword campaigns versus non-brand search campaigns. Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude) to improve productivity through research, communication, analysis, documentation, automation, workflow optimization, and decision-making. Preferred Qualifications 10+ years of experience in digital advertising, growth marketing, or a related field. Bachelor's degree in the applicable discipline or related field preferred. Experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology environment, with deep knowledge of B2B client behaviors and growth marketing trends. Experience creating targeted lists in Salesforce and leveraging 6sense. Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, generate insights, and make data-driven decisions. Project management skills, including prioritizing and managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. Creative, problem-solving mindset with a track record of meeting or exceeding performance targets and KPIs. Travel Required Up to 10% Other Duties Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. What it’s like to work at Rithum When you join Rithum, you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds. As part of the Rithum team, you are valued, supported, and included. Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. To ensure work and life balance works for you, we also offer an array of resources to support you and your families, including comprehensive benefits and wellness plans. At Rithum you will: Partner with the leading brands and retailers. Connect with passionate professionals who will help support your goals. Participate in an inclusive, welcoming work atmosphere. Achieve work-life balance through remote-first working conditions, generous time off, and wellness days. Receive industry-competitive compensation and total rewards benefits. We believe in transparency and fairness in our compensation practices. For this position, the expected base pay range is: $130,000-$190,000 per year. This range represents the base pay for the role across all U.S. locations and is determined based on market data, internal equity, and experience. Final compensation may vary depending on geographic location, skills, and relevant experience.In addition to base pay, we offer a discretionary bonus for non-sales roles, a comprehensive benefits package, and, where applicable, sales incentives. For this position, the expected discretionary bonus is 12% of the annual base salary. Benefits Medical, dental and vision benefits: Affordable health care plans and company HSA contributions, starting on Day 1 A 6% 401(k) match Competitive time off package with 20 days of Paid Time Off, 9 Company-Paid holidays, 2 paid floating holidays, 7 paid sick days, 2 Wellness days, and 1 Paid Volunteer Day; at 3 years of service PTO increases to 22 days, and at 5 years it increases to 25 days 12 weeks primary caregiver leave & 4 weeks secondary caregiver leave Accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity insurance Pet insurance Legal assistance and identity theft insurance plans Life insurance 2x salary Access to the Calm app and the Employee Assistance Program $65/month Remote work stipend for internet Culture and team-building activities Tuition assistance Career development opportunities Charitable contribution match up to $250 per year Rithum is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other protected characteristic. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations in accordance with the law for qualified applicants. If you require assistance during the interview process due to a medical condition or need support accessing our website or completing the application process, please reach out to us by completing the Accommodations Request Form . Your comfort and accessibility are important to us, and we're here to ensure a seamless experience as you explore opportunities with our team.

items.description: Product Headquarters: US-DC-Remote At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. PRINCIPAL PRACTICE MANAGER - Federal LEAD. STRATEGIZE. TRANSFORM. JOIN US AS A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES PRACTICE MANAGER! Are you ready to own your impact at the forefront of the AI and data revolution ? As a Principal Practice Manager , you’ll be a key driver in transforming the US Federal government through cutting-edge AI-cloud data solutions . You’ll collaborate with top-tier clients, strategize with elite sales teams, and win and lead groundbreaking professional service engagements —all while working with the best minds in the industry! This role is completely remote but preference will be given to those in the DC-metro area. WHY THIS ROLE? Be a Market Leader: Own and execute the strategic vision for Professional Services across all of the US Federal Government for Defense and Civilian. Drive Meaningful Change: Work with clients to unlock the power of AI and data and fuel digital transformations. Collaborate with the Best: Work cross-functionally with top industry experts to win transformative services opportunities and shape the future of cloud data solutions. Grow your Business: Work proactively across accounts to create and mature new opportunities, close deals and grow your business. Crush Your Goals: Meet and exceed bookings, revenue, and consumption targets while delivering exceptional customer experiences . WHAT YOU’LL DO: Spearhead services sales execution and serve as a strategic advisor for key accounts. Engage C-level executives to create and execute services roadmaps that drive real business outcomes. Own the entire professional services lifecycle —from deal strategy and proposal creation to execution and forecasting. Be the go-to expert for cloud-based data management, business intelligence, and AI-powered solutions. Lead high-performing teams while ensuring top-tier customer satisfaction. AS A SERVICES PRACTICE MANAGER, YOU WILL: Be aligned to markets or industries as part of the practice, with services sales alignment to Sales District Manager(s) and Account Executives Be responsible for both driving service sales enablement/execution and ensuring the successful delivery of services for your assigned accounts. Focus on achieving quarterly bookings and revenue targets and creating a pipeline of future opportunities. Be the Professional Services lead across all of the US Federal accounts, through the following: Help create and execute on the overall vision for services - both sales and delivery Own the services delivery roadmap (proposals, closing services opportunities and delivery) Collaborate with cross functional teams to find opportunities, scope, propose and sell services (Professional Services and Training) to both new and existing clients Develop scope and associated SOWs for customer services engagements Drive deal reviews internally to ensure alignment - ensure the scope of the project is well defined for customer success Understand and help optimize business operations processes for services sales Build strong cross-functional relationships within Snowflake GTM teams (legal, deal desk, account teams, sales, PS&T leadership - including workload services - and partner team) Provide bookings forecast and demonstrate strong command of your book of business Align services engagements to key customers business outcomes Drive alignment with executive sponsors and/or customer stakeholders Collaborate with other delivery partners (SIs, GSIs, other PS orgs, etc) in support of project delivery Serve as the initial point of escalation for customer and project team Own project outcomes and manage project financials (revenue forecasting and expense management) Maintain a high level of customer satisfaction as reflected in customer survey scores Collaborate with Education Services team for training delivery Serve as strategic advisor to customer and provide specific services delivery activities for the role/engagement (Business Value roadmap, Business value assessment, strategic roadmap, Data Cloud Assessment, etc) Deep collaboration with AE/SEs on the account for account strategy Develop expertise within their aligned market through working closely with other Practice Directors, Sales teams, and Global Industry Leaders to understand transformational specific use cases and through external research on the current business and technology landscape for your customer base. OUR IDEAL SERVICES PRACTICE MANAGER WILL HAVE: 10+ years of experience in a Sales and Services Delivery role (or similar capacity) interfacing with executives across US Public Sector and US Federal government market Direct experience, ideally within US Federal Government, in a AI, Cloud, Data or Business Intelligence field Strong understanding of business solutions of our target clients, leveraging data as an enabler. Examples include AI-ready data, Customer Data Platforms, cross-industry Data sharing, AI, personalization, etc. Proven track record of meeting booking and revenue targets. Proven ability to communicate and translate effectively across both internal teams and customer organizational structures, developing technology programs, defining milestones, success criteria, resource allocation, and on-time delivery. Strong organizational skills, ability to work independently and oversee multiple projects simultaneously Differentiator: Active TS or Secret Clearance with DoD experience. Differentiator: Big 5 or boutique strategy consulting experience, ideally with experience achieving or exceeding sales targets. Differentiator: Experience in a client support and advisory technical role (solution architect, technical account manager or equivalent) Differentiator: Experience in designing, leading, influencing and selling functional solution sets (e.g. Fraud Waste and Abuse, Health AI, Supply Chain optimization, Re-engineering) or cross-functional Digital Transformations. WHY JOIN OUR PROFESSIONAL SERVICES TEAM: Unique opportunity to work on a truly disruptive software product Get unique, hands-on experience with bleeding edge AI-data cloud technology Develop, lead and execute an market-changing initiative Learn from the best! Join a dedicated, experienced team of professionals Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential. Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/snowflake-principal-practice-manager-federal

items.description: What is PerfectServe? PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue. PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians. Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach: In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years. At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward. If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place! About the role PerfectServe is investing in a unified data platform spanning our product portfolio — the data store, the shared taxonomy, and the pipelines that will let the business answer questions across the whole platform. Our architecture team has mapped the high-level direction and target state. The detailed design is deliberately still open. This is the senior engineering seat that takes it from direction to working platform. You will shape the detailed architecture alongside our architecture team, own the implementation and integration design, and set the engineering standards the team works to — building it with a dedicated team. Why this role, specifically We have done real thinking here — the high-level direction and target state are mapped, and the business case is made and funded. What is deliberately not settled is almost everything below that line. We would rather hire someone with strong opinions about it than fill it in ourselves before you arrive. That is where the consequential decisions live — how entities resolve consistently across a broad portfolio, how time is modeled so a question about last quarter resolves against last quarter's reality, how a metric gets defined once and trusted everywhere. Cheap to get right now, expensive to correct later. So you get a direction to work from and an architecture team to partner with, plus genuine influence over both. If you would rather bring your experience to bear on a platform while it is being built than inherit one that is already set, this is that role. What you will do Own the implementation design across the platform — ingestion, modeling, and the surfaces people consume Shape the detailed architecture from the high-level direction, working with our architecture team Own integration design across a varied set of production source systems Build ingestion pipelines from those systems Model raw data into business-ready datasets, with one agreed definition per metric Set the engineering standards the team works to, including data quality and testing Partner with our platform and operations teams on safe, low-impact extraction from production databases Work directly with the people who need the data, so what gets built answers real questions Mentor data engineers and help shape their work What you bring Substantial experience building and operating cloud data platforms, ideally including one you designed from scratch Comfort making decisions with incomplete information, and the judgement to know which ones are expensive to get wrong Deep SQL, and strong command of a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks or similar) A transformation framework such as dbt, with clear opinions on how to structure a project ELT and change-data-capture experience across relational sources AWS — read replicas, object storage, and moving data between regions without surprises Dimensional or medallion modeling, applied rather than theoretical Workflow orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect or similar) and data quality testing as a habit Nice to have Healthcare data, and experience handling protected health information Multi-tenant data isolation Semantic layer or metrics layer design Modern BI and self-serve reporting tooling Why Join PerfectServe? At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission‑driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation. We offer a salary range of $170,000–$200,000 USD per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and growth potential. This range reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. Compensation is determined by several factors, including experience, skills, and team impact. We regularly review compensation to ensure fairness and consistency. Current employees with questions are encouraged to connect with their manager or People Operations. Benefits: Remote first work environment Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one. 401K - with match and immediately vested. 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy Internal Advancement Opportunities PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

items.description: About Dufour Dufour provides sovereign, automated aerial logistics capabilities. Transitioning from a UAV developer into a defence-first network provider, we deliver complete, repeatable operating systems – combining automated aircraft fleets, control rooms, training, and support – to keep critical supplies moving when conventional infrastructure is disrupted. The Role We are looking for a creative and tech-savvy 3D Concept & Visualization Artist to bring our new aircraft designs to life through compelling photorealistic and concept renderings. Working closely with our communications team, you will visualize our upcoming aircraft platforms in real-world mission scenarios – while providing clean base renders that enable our team to generate fast variations using AI tools. What You Will Do Aircraft & Scenario Renderings : Create photorealistic and concept renderings of our new aircraft platforms operating across diverse environments and mission scenarios. 3D Modeling & Scene Setup : Prepare, optimize, and texture existing CAD models, or build complementary concept assets, environments, and lighting setups from scratch. AI-Ready Base Assets & Enablement : Deliver clean, structured base renders and transparent cutouts that enable our internal team to independently generate quick variations and new backgrounds using AI tools. What You Bring 3D & Rendering Tools : Solid experience in 3D modeling and rendering or real-time engines, such as Blender, Cinema 4D, Rhino, Unreal Engine, KeyShot, or Vizcom. AI Workflows & Post-Production : Experience with AI-assisted visualization tools like Vizcom or ComfyUI and image editing – ideally knowing how to structure base renders for downstream AI workflows; basic 3D animation skills are a plus. Eye for Realism & Design : Strong sense of lighting, scale, and industrial or aerospace aesthetics to translate complex hardware into compelling scenes. High Flexibility & Reliability : Pragmatic and responsive – able to jump in on short notice when urgent requests arise and occasionally deliver polished visuals within tight timelines. Background : Open to everyone with a strong portfolio – ideal as a flexible side job for design students as well as independent freelancers. What We Oﬀer High-Visibility Impact : Shape the visual identity of brand-new aircraft platforms and critical defence-logistics systems. Uncomplicated Collaboration : Direct, fast feedback loops with a small, dedicated team – no bureaucratic overhead. Flexibility : Fully remote setup with flexible working hours that fit easily around your studies or other freelance projects. Fair Compensation : Competitive hourly rate or project-based flat fee. We’re developing a geospatial reasoning agent focused on Crisis Response—helping AI systems understand, assess, and predict real-world events where data is uncertain or incomplete. Your expertise will guide model development and evaluation, laying the foundation for future geospatial reasoning and forecasting applications. We’re looking for experts with deep experience in geospatial analysis, crisis response, or related domains such as damage assessment, agriculture, site selection, supply chain optimization, or forecasting. You’ll evaluate AI-generated outputs, identify analytical weaknesses, and design metrics and test cases that advance model understanding and predictive accuracy. On a typical day, you’ll review geospatial scenarios, validate model outputs, define and refine reasoning frameworks, and collaborate with our team to improve data-driven evaluations. Ideal candidates bring professional experience in geospatial analysis, GIS systems, or spatial modeling within industries such as crisis management, logistics, or environmental planning. Proficiency with geospatial tools and libraries (e.g., QGIS, ArcGIS, GDAL, PostGIS) is preferred. Strong reasoning, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate complex spatial relationships clearly are essential. Ready to apply your geospatial expertise to the frontier of AI? Apply today and help design intelligent systems capable of supporting real-time global decision-making. We offer a pay range of $24 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor, you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet connection; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply. Job title: Geospatial Reasoning Specialist – AI Trainer Employment type: Contract Workplace type: Remote Seniority level: Senior Level Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Radiation Oncologist
items.summary: Role Title: Radiation Oncologist Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging Radiation Oncologists to participate in a project supporting a healthcare technology customer.
items.description: Role Title: Radiation Oncologist Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging Radiation Oncologists to participate in a project supporting a healthcare technology customer. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity focuses on reviewing and providing expert feedback on AI-generated data related to radiation oncology, ensuring outputs reflect clinical accuracy and current best practices. Clear, effective written and verbal communication is essential for success. Scope of Work Review AI-generated datasets pertaining to radiation oncology and assess their clinical validity. Provide constructive, detailed feedback on data accuracy, treatment protocols, and relevance to real-world practice. Collaborate asynchronously with project stakeholders to clarify data specifications and standards. Identify potential gaps or inconsistencies in AI-generated information. Suggest improvements to enhance clinical accuracy, patient safety, and guideline adherence. Document findings and recommendations in a clear, structured format for technical and non-technical audiences. Participate in occasional written or virtual discussions to refine project deliverables. Preferred Qualifications Board-certified Radiation Oncologist with active clinical experience. Strong foundation in current radiation oncology protocols, guidelines, and emerging practices. Demonstrated ability to communicate technical concepts clearly in both written and verbal forms. Prior experience with medical data review, clinical research, or peer-review processes. Comfort with digital collaboration tools and remote engagement environments. Keen attention to detail and meticulous documentation skills. Interest in the intersection of artificial intelligence and oncology is a plus. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: All Other Remote Headquarters: Remote - Athens Remote role based in Athens, covering mostly US East Coast hours (afternoons and evenings in Athens). Independent contractor engagement at $3,500–$4,500 per month (USD), depending on experience. As a contractor, you’ll invoice us monthly and handle your own taxes and social security contributions. ABOUT 3Y HEALTH 3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into other specialties. We're backed by over $200mm from Founders Fund, General Catalyst, SoftBank and 8VC. ABOUT THE ROLE We enter new markets by acquiring a foundational clinic for each specialty and region we go into, and we partner with independent clinics across the country. Every clinic adds entities, filings, contracts, staff records and deadlines that need to stay in order. In this role, you'll own a set of our entities from start to finish. When we acquire a clinic, you'll carry out its integration plan: collect and file the records, prepare the filings, get staff ready for day one and follow up with everyone until each item is closed. Each deal comes with a detailed plan and timeline from the deal lead. Acquired clinics keep running largely as they do today until we bring them onto our platform, usually within a few months. Once a clinic is integrated, you'll keep its entity in good standing, alongside the existing entities you own. You don't need experience in US healthcare. Every deal comes with a detailed checklist, and we'll teach you the US specifics. You need to learn fast, care about details and follow through. You'll work closely with our Corporate Development, Legal, Billing and HR teams in the US, and with a teammate in the same role. WHAT YOU'LL DO Acquisitions Work through each deal's integration checklist from before signing through the first months after close, keep the tracker current, and flag anything at risk of slipping Document how the clinic runs today, such as scheduling, intake, referrals and billing handoffs Check that each acquired entity is in good standing, and that its legal name and tax ID match across IRS, state, bank and payer records Support our team and advisors on payer change-of-ownership notices, Medicare enrollment updates and credentialing checks Map every payer's electronic payment setup (EFT/ERA) and each clinic's bank accounts, so our billing team can keep cash flowing through close Prepare staff for day one: verify the employee roster, gather employment records for legal review, run license and exclusion checks, collect onboarding paperwork securely, and help get payroll, benefits and staff FAQs ready Inventory each clinic's vendors, software and logins, collect business associate agreements (BAAs) for legal review, and track which systems switch to ours at close, later or not at all Follow through after close on staff communication, moving patients of departing providers to remaining clinicians, lease and facility license items, and the former owners' transition commitments Entity management and corporate operations Keep the entities you own in good standing, primarily by managing our vendors: prepare annual reports, state registrations, IRS updates and other filings, and track them to on-time filing with our legal team Maintain entity records, including formation documents, officers, registered agents and ownership Prepare and submit provider and facility enrollments with state Medicaid programs and other public payers, and track them to approval Make sure incoming mail for your entities is logged, routed and acted on, especially anything with a deadline Prepare contracts from templates, route them for signature, and keep our contract management system and renewal dates current Note what worked and what didn't, so our checklists get better with each deal WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 2–5 years in healthcare operations, practice management, credentialing or provider enrollment, or acquisition integration A track record of managing many details and deadlines to completion Comfort working with contracts, licenses and government forms. You read carefully and catch errors. Strong spreadsheet skills, and quick to learn new systems Excellent written and spoken English. Most of your work is with US teams, agencies and vendors, and most decisions happen in writing. Comfort handling confidential information High agency and low ego. You don't need to be chased, and you'll do the tedious work as carefully as the interesting work. Based in Athens and able to work mostly US East Coast hours (afternoons and evenings in Athens) NICE TO HAVE Experience in US healthcare, insurance or another regulated industry Experience working with US companies or customers Experience with corporate filings, contract administration or compliance work Daily use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to work faster WHAT WE OFFER A monthly fee of $3,500–$4,500 (USD), depending on experience A long-term role at a venture-backed US company, working closely with leadership Room to grow as we acquire more clinics and enter new specialties ENGAGEMENT This is a long-term independent contractor engagement with 3Y Health, not an employment contract. You'll need to be registered as a freelancer in Greece, or be willing to register before your start date. You'll be paid monthly in USD. If you meet most of the requirements and the role interests you, we'd like to hear from you, even if you don't check every box. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/3y-health-corporate-integration-operations-associate

items.summary: Headquarters: New York, New York, United States URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/ About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: New York, New York, United States URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/ About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale. About the role We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch. This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend. What you will do Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research. Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency. Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad. Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad. Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named. Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round. Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows. What we are looking for Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them. A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations. Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses. AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how. Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads. Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed. Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here. Pay and structure Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience. Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads. Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales. Our hiring process (exactly how it works) Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow). Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete. Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario. Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more. Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30. We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://impulseuniverse.com Benefits: Bonus based on performance Company parties Flexible schedule About the Event America’s largest Lunar New Year spectacle is back and bolder than ever! Spanning 7 massive halls with over 1,400 vendors, the Asian American Expo brings you the ultimate celebration of mouthwatering Asian street food, nonstop cultural performances, and high-energy excitement. Step into the Year of the Ram, grab your official Red Envelope at the door, and get ready to experience the luckiest weekend of the year! About the Role We are seeking a high-energy, results-obsessed Marketing Contractor to drive direct ticket sales for the Asian American Expo 2027, America’s largest Lunar New Year celebration (7 massive halls, 1,400+ vendors, and hourly cash Red Envelope prize drops taking place January 16–17, 2027 at the Fairplex in Pomona, CA). This is NOT a brand awareness or vanity metrics role. We are looking for a direct-response outreach strategist whose sole focus is converting Southern California local audiences into paying ticket holders through nano/micro-influencers and grassroots digital community channels. Core Responsibilities Nano & Micro-Influencer Acquisition: Identify, pitch, and onboard local SoCal nano/micro-influencers (foodies, lifestyle, family, culture, and local deals) with active, hyper-local followings to promote the Asian American Expo. Grassroots Community Marketing: Actively seat promotional messaging, ticket offers, and event announcements across regional SoCal Facebook groups, local community forums, Nextdoor, Reddit, and cultural community boards. Direct-Response Campaign Execution: Focus messaging around high-converting hooks, specifically highlighting the event scale, food night market, and the "Luckiest Weekend of the Year" Red Envelope cash/prize drops. Weekly Conversion Tracking: Monitor link clicks, promo code redemptions, and ticket conversion rates, optimizing or sunsetting non-performing partnerships weekly. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Primary Metric: Total Event Ticket Sales & Revenue Generated (analyzed on a day by day snapshot compared to last year). Secondary Metric: Number of activated, high-converting local SoCal creators actively posting and driving trackable sales. Qualifications & Requirements Proven Track Record: Demonstrated experience in direct-response marketing, affiliate management, event ticketing, or conversion-focused influencer outreach. SoCal Market Familiarity: Deep understanding of Southern California sub-markets, local food culture, Asian community networks, and regional interest groups (LA, SGV, Orange County, IE). Outreach Hustle: Strong negotiation and persuasion skills to quickly secure high-converting partnerships on lean timelines. Tools: Proficiency with Google Workspace, affiliate/promo tracking tools, Meta/Facebook group networking, and social outreach management. How to Apply Submit your resume along with 1–2 examples of previous campaigns where you directly drove sales or ticket conversions through grassroots outreach or creator partnerships. This is a remote position. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/impulse-universe-inc-asian-american-expo-marketing-local-community-influencer-outreach

items.description: Company Description At Turner & Townsend we’re passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people to realize their potential, and doing our part to create a prosperous society. Every day we help our major global clients deliver ambitious and highly technical projects, in over 110 offices worldwide. Our UK E&NR business is structured into two geographical regions (the North and the South which are divided horizontally roughly around Nottingham) and a third, UK-wide, dedicated Performance Analytics Team driving our approach to digital & data. In the E&NR North & South Region we currently have around 300+ professionals across cost and commercial management, project controls, and project management – and a very strong revenue growth targets for the year. As such, we are actively recruiting for fantastic opportunities across a wide range of clients and sectors including across all aspects of nuclear delivery, renewables, battery storage, transmission & distribution, Carbon Capture Storage and Sustainable Aviation Fuels. We also work closely with our Infrastructure and Defence colleagues with opportunity to work across a wide variety of projects. What we offer you We place a strong emphasis on people development where every individual is encouraged to develop a personalised and bespoke career development plan, aligned to one or more technical, business or client leadership pathways. This creates a working environment where individuals from all backgrounds can thrive. We provide comprehensive APC support, in producing high quality submission documents and getting to the right standard for final assessment. Everyone is allocated a Counsellor and Supervisor and a strong network of wider support with Q&A’s, and we run formal mock processes to assure candidates’ readiness to sit. As a regional team, we have a clear commitment to engagement and a team culture strongly aligned to Our Values. We have an active social community with a strong focus on networking and engagement opportunities through team events, team Corporate Responsibility Days, office chats and informal spontaneous lunchtime or after work connectivity. Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com Job Description A Project Controls Manager (PCM) will lead cross-discipline teams of project controls professionals to deliver effective, consistent, assured and value adding project controls services to our Energy client across diverse and complex programmes. In leading the team, they will be responsible for defining and delivering performance management cadences on complex projects/programmes along with all associated processes & reports. They are accountable for maintaining robust project controls deliverables that provide our clients with accurate data to drive management decisions. They will play a key role in ensuring that client objectives are met and that projects are delivered to time and cost targets and the appropriate quality standards. Key accountabilities As PCM, you have the passion to provide integrated planning and project controls services as required by our clients, which may include: Leading cross-discipline teams of project controls professionals to drive delivery of robust and effective project controls services and continuous improvement in project controls processes. Create efficiency and increasing benefits to our energy client by defining and implementing project controls approaches across the project, programme and portfolio levels to allow effective decision making at all levels. Defining and implementing effective governance and assurance processes around project controls products. Adherence to NEC or FIDIC or similar contract processes for management of project controls data and deliverables. Working with our client to develop relevant breakdown structures, support scope definitions and in turn project controls products with the professionals and senior professionals in their team. Defining scaled, tailored and integrated approaches for project controls and documenting these (for example in a Project Control System Definition). Defining the scope through the identification and management of exclusions, assumptions, interfaces, and dependencies, and coordinate the scope’s decomposition. Working with the Integrated Project Team to establish a robust, accurate Performance Measurement Baseline and manage the change control process. Working with Project and Commercial Management to establish the Supplier Project Controls contract requirements, and collaborating with suppliers to integrate and analyse their performance data. Ensuring scope, cost, risk and schedule integration and alignment, and analyse performance data to provide delivery insight and facilitate delivery decisions. Training and coaching client team and less experienced project team members on performance and reporting management processes and practices. Assuring the quality, accuracy, and integrity of the Project Controls team’s output. Undertaking line management activities including career development and performance management. Ability to interact with Senior Management / Leadership members when delivering updates on Performance Management within a complex project/programme environment. Guide the team on appropriate use of systems and tools (such as Primavera P6, Power Bi, Excel) in relation to Performance Management, Analysis & Reporting. Works to make positive change happen by embracing challenges and opportunities for our client. Effectively connects and communicates with people to collaborate to deliver our best work. Brings out the best in everyone by helping the team in making the most of their potential through proactive collaboration and effective teamworking, working with empathy and treating everyone with care and respect. Qualifications You have significant experience in the application of several Project Controls disciplines (Planning, Cost Estimation, Cost Management, Risk Management or Reporting) in multiple projects in one or more sectors across the whole Project lifecycle. While working for client/operator experience is desirable its not mandatory requirement. You have strong knowledge and proficiency with various project controls specific software packages and can coordinate and work with other teams utilising your multi-disciplinary knowledge. You will be a strong communicator, able to demonstrate leadership behaviours with the ability to influence, manage, motivate, coach and develop a team by fostering a diverse and inclusive environment. items.title: AI Transformation Lead (Senior Product Owner / Business Analyst)
items.summary: The role You sit with US business owners, find the problem worth solving, build the roadmap, and make sure it pays off.
items.description: The role You sit with US business owners, find the problem worth solving, build the roadmap, and make sure it pays off. You combine three jobs most companies split up: strategy and analysis, project management, and adoption. Within three months you fully lead your own delivery team. This is not an engineering role. Our developers write the code; you decide what gets built, lead the team through it, and make sure the client sees the results. If you've been a Product Owner, Business Analyst or Technical Project Manager, this is your next step. What you will do Lead strategic conversations with business owners and build or realign their roadmap. Turn each initiative into a clear plan: scope, user stories, acceptance criteria and estimates with your team. Run the build with your team and keep scope under control. Make sure the client's team uses what we built, with training and live KPI dashboards that show each person whether they're on track. Review results with the client and show the value in their numbers. Your first 90 days: you will have realigned or built a client's roadmap, delivered one or two initiatives from it, and scheduled the review that shows the client what it's worth. What you bring 6+ years as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, Technical Project Manager or consultant, working directly with owners or executives. Roadmaps, user stories and acceptance criteria that developers can build from. Experience leading a small team, or clear readiness to. Proof that people used what you delivered, and a business result you can name with a number. Fluent English, and the ability to explain technical ideas in plain words. At least 3 custom web application projects behind you, and a solid understanding of how systems fit together (data, integrations, AI agents), so you can design the right system with your developers and recommend it with confidence. What we offer $5,000 to $6,000 a month (USD, B2B), plus a monthly team bonus for every sprint point your team delivers. 20 paid days off a year and 5 paid sick days. At least $200 a month for the AI tools you use, with room for more. An intense first month: one-on-one time with the team and both co-founders, and a curriculum on how we get results for clients. We want to learn from your experience too. Room to grow into a bigger leadership role as we scale. Remote. You need to be available for team meetings from 9:00 CET and for US clients in their morning (late afternoon into early evening CET). Central and Eastern Europe preferred; South Africa welcome. Built for people who lead change. This role asks a lot: you'll be the person who helps a client's business change for the better, using AI to give the owner, the team and their customers time for what matters most. If that kind of challenge energizes you, we'd love to hear from you. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: URL: http://cmswa.com Custom Mechanical Solutions delivers energy-efficient HVAC systems across the Pacific Northwest, with deep expertise in healthcare, education, data centers, and retrofit projects. We work with top manufacturers to meet performance and sustainability goals—always focused on quality, care, and progress. If you're ready to grow your career, we’re glad you found us. At CMS, you’ll join a team that supports your development and gives you space to make an impact. We review every application carefully and appreciate your interest in growing your career with our team. About Custom Mechanical Solutions Custom Mechanical Solutions (CMS) provides commercial HVAC equipment and technical solutions for complex building applications. We partner with contractors, engineers, building owners, and manufacturers throughout the equipment lifecycle—from system design and delivery through startup, troubleshooting, and field support. As part of the Meriton family of companies, CMS maintains its specialized technical expertise and customer-focused approach while benefiting from the resources and long-term investment of a growing national organization. Title: Quality & Reliability Engineer Department: CMS National Accounts Location: Fully remote within the United States Travel: Approximately 10–20% domestic and international travel Turn field challenges into better products, stronger processes, and more reliable outcomes. Join a growing National Accounts team where your technical judgment, curiosity, and follow-through will connect the jobsite to the factory and help shape how quality is managed as the business scales. The opportunity CMS is looking for a Quality & Reliability Engineer to own and continuously improve the field-to-factory quality feedback loop for custom commercial and industrial HVAC equipment. You will lead technical investigations, turn incomplete field information into clear problem statements, and keep root-cause and corrective-action work moving through verified closure. This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role. You will work across field operations, project teams, customers, engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and factory quality leaders. Your work will help teams respond faster, create repeatable repairs, reduce recurrence, and apply lessons learned to future projects. Work from where you are. This is a fully remote position that can be based anywhere within the United States. Approximately 10-20% domestic and international travel is expected, including travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico. Travel may be heavier initially while you build relationships with key stakeholders and learn the factory systems. Travel to Mexico is generally expected up to four times per year to support investigations, gather technical evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate corrective actions. What you will own Lead field-to-factory investigations. Coordinate quality issues from initial report through containment, root cause, corrective action, and verified closure. Turn field intelligence into action. Gather the technical evidence needed for faster decisions and translate recurring trends into improvements in design, manufacturing, supplier controls, installation guidance, training, and documentation. Create field-ready solutions. Develop clear, controlled Field Service Bulletins with approved repair steps, safety requirements, acceptance criteria, and closeout evidence. Drive clarity and accountability. Keep owners, milestones, risks, decisions, and overdue actions visible. Remove blockers and escalate high-impact or aging issues when needed. Use data to improve the program. Maintain quality dashboards and reports, identify systemic trends and emerging risks, and provide concise updates to leadership, project teams, customers, and factory partners. Go where the evidence is. Travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico to inspect equipment, support troubleshooting, gather evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate repair effectiveness. You will probably love this role if... When something fails, your first question is “Why?” and you keep digging until the evidence supports the answer. You enjoy both the technical details and the bigger picture, from walking a jobsite and troubleshooting equipment to explaining the path forward clearly. You take ownership without waiting for every step to be laid out, bring the right people together, and keep work moving until the issue is truly closed. You are comfortable influencing across teams, even when you do not directly manage the people involved. You want to help build and improve a quality program, not simply maintain one. Required qualifications A bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or Quality Engineering, or an equivalent combination of technical education and relevant professional experience. At least three years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality, field service, commissioning, reliability engineering, technical investigations, or related technical project support. Strong mechanical and/or electrical investigation and troubleshooting skills. Working knowledge of structured problem-solving methods such as RCA, CAPA, 8D, 5 Why, fishbone analysis, or FMEA. Ability to translate incomplete field information into clear technical problem statements and drive corrective actions through verified closure. Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences. Ability to travel domestically and internationally approximately 10–20%, including travel to manufacturing facilities in Mexico. A valid passport at the time of hire is preferred; candidates without one must be able to obtain one within the first 90 days of employment. Preferred qualifications Five or more years of relevant quality, reliability, field-service, commissioning, or technical investigation experience. Direct experience with commercial or industrial HVAC equipment. Experience with custom air-handling equipment, controls, construction drawings and specifications, startup, commissioning, or active job-site processes. Experience working directly with manufacturing facilities, suppliers, factory quality teams, or field-service organizations. Experience developing technical repair procedures, Field Service Bulletins, corrective-action documentation, or quality dashboards. Compensation and benefits Base salary: $95,000-$125,000 annually, depending on experience. This position is also eligible for a discretionary bonus. Eligible employees may participate in Meriton’s benefits programs in accordance with applicable plan terms. Why CMS National Accounts You will join a fast-moving team supporting complex equipment and significant projects where expectations are high, and the connection between field performance and customer experience matters. This role offers the opportunity to make quality information more complete, corrective actions more durable, repairs more repeatable, and lessons learned more useful across a growing portfolio. If you are ready to solve meaningful technical problems and help build a stronger quality and reliability program, we would like to hear from you. Custom Mechanical Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by an applicant’s or employee’s race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status or any other legally protected status. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship. Salary ranges listed are dependent upon a candidate’s qualifications, experience, internal equity, and the budgeted amount for the specific role and location. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/custom-mechanical-solutions-quality-and-reliability-engineer

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Japan Who we are: Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products. Our culture: We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation. We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule. We're a remote-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to - work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport-optional, work-from-anywhere-on-Earth kind of remote - think flexible within your country, not borderless. Location: Remote - Japan About the role As we expand globally, we’re looking for passionate QA automation engineer. You’ll be part of global QA team, working closely with both global team and client-facing team in APAC region. This role requires business-level English and Japanese skills. You will design a clear set of test scenarios, decide what to automate and what to keep manual, and work with stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Professional Services, and our clients, including banks. What you'll be doing Own automated coverage for APIs and client-facing dashboard in sandbox and production Be the named QA on APAC bank integrations: structured test scenarios, UAT support, regression tests. Set the automation strategy for the surface you own: what runs in CI, what stays exploratory, and what is better left manual. Work with engineers across the full SDLC and shift left. Join design and planning so quality is in the conversation before code is written. Find, record, and document defects so engineer and customer partners can both act on them. Partner with Professional Services and Post-Sales on structured acceptance testing for bank and enterprise deployments. Own the health of the suites you run in CI so failures are real and actionable. What you'll bring Strong hands-on automation (API first, in TypeScript or JavaScript), with a clear strategy for what to automate. Our suites run on Cypress; Playwright or similar experience transfers. You can organize test scenarios so someone else can read the map: scope, priority, automation vs. evidence. 5+ years in software quality, including owning a product or integration end to end. Great written and verbal communication skills in English and Japanese for both internal and external communication. Strong ownership on everything around quality Hands-on with CI and a habit of keeping suites maintainable. Experience in Software Engineering is a plus Experience in working SaaS company is a plus Nice to have: experience with banks or regulators in APAC (for example data privacy under APPI in Japan); Cypress or similar for the occasional UI path; reading Go (our services and their unit tests); Qase or another test-management tool; prior file-based or batch testing. Benefits we offer: Generous compensation in cash and equity Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture Flexible paid time off and Year-end break Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific MacBook Pro delivered to your door One-time stipend to set up a home office — desk, chair, screen, etc. Monthly meal stipend Monthly social meet-up stipend Annual health and wellness stipend Annual Learning stipend Join a fast-growing company with world-class professionals from around the world. If you are seeking a meaningful career, you found the right place, and we would love to hear from you. To learn more about how we process your personal information and your rights in regards to your personal information as an applicant and Sardine employee, please visit our Applicant and Worker Privacy Notice . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sardine-qa-automation-engineer

Clover Care Services is entering a significant period of clinical growth. As we scale our Clover Care Visit (CCV) team, we need a dedicated leader who can turn an ambitious hiring plan into a reliable, repeatable workforce engine—from recruiting pipeline and onboarding capacity through clinician readiness, productivity, and performance. As the Director, Workforce Management , you will connect workforce planning, recruiting, onboarding, leadership capacity, and performance management into one operating system, giving the organization clear visibility into whether we are on pace and what needs to change when we are not. As Director, Workforce Management, you will: Own the CCV workforce plan end to end. Build and run the staffing strategy required to scale the clinician organization, translating long-range growth targets into weekly and monthly hiring, onboarding, and readiness goals. Create visibility from candidate pipeline to “ready to visit.” Establish the operating metrics, forecasting, and reporting needed to understand recruiting conversion, onboarding lead times, attrition, training capacity, and clinician readiness—and surface risks early enough to act. Build a scalable clinician onboarding model. Partner across Clinical, Talent, IT, Operations, and other teams to evolve today’s high-touch onboarding journey into a structured model that can support significantly larger hiring cohorts without sacrificing clinical quality. Build the leadership capacity required to scale. Determine the right model for preceptors, clinical leads, onboarding cohorts, and frontline management so that rapid growth does not create an unsustainable burden on existing clinical leaders. Own workforce performance management. Establish clear, actionable standards and operating rhythms across areas such as attendance, cancellation rates, Clover Assistant Touch, productivity, and normalized performance measures. Make quality and productivity work together. Build performance expectations that reflect accurate, sustainable clinical performance—not simply higher activity—and partner with clinical leaders to ensure workforce decisions support both member experience and quality of care. Turn workforce data into decisions. Build the dashboards, forecasts, and management routines leaders need to understand capacity, identify constraints, allocate resources, and stay ahead of hiring or performance gaps. Create repeatable workforce-management capabilities for CCS. Use the CCV ramp as the first proving ground for processes, tools, and operating models that can later support In-Home Care and other Clover Care Services programs. Operate as a cross-functional leader. Bring together Clinical Activation, clinical leadership, Talent, Operations, Finance, analytics, and other partners around one integrated workforce plan with clear owners, milestones, and escalation paths. Success in this role looks like: In your first 90 days, you will: Build a clear baseline of the CCV workforce funnel and translate the 2027 growth target into a measurable workforce plan spanning recruiting, onboarding, training capacity, clinician readiness, and attrition. Identify the biggest risks and bottlenecks in the ramp and establish the metrics, operating cadence, and accountability needed to address them. Within your first 6 months, you will: Establish a predictable recruiting-to-readiness operating model, including scalable onboarding cohorts, preceptor capacity, and clinical leadership support. Launch workforce dashboards and performance-management routines that enable leaders to anticipate capacity gaps, manage performance, and increase clinician onboarding volume without sacrificing quality. Over time, you will: Help CCV reach its clinician-capacity goals ahead of the 2027 AEP cycle through a sustainable, data-driven approach to hiring, onboarding, and performance. Build repeatable workforce-management capabilities that can extend beyond CCV to support In-Home Care and other Clover Care Services programs. You should get in touch if: You have built or led workforce planning, capacity management, clinical operations, field operations, or another complex people-scaling function where success depended on turning ambitious growth targets into an executable operating plan. You are comfortable owning the full workforce funnel—from recruiting demand and hiring pace through onboarding, readiness, productivity, performance, and attrition. You know how to scale a high-touch operating model without sacrificing the quality, judgment, and human support that made it successful. You are highly analytical and can turn workforce data into useful forecasts, metrics, dashboards, and decisions. You know how to balance productivity with quality, accuracy, and member experience when defining and managing performance. You are an effective cross-functional operator who can create alignment and accountability across clinical leaders, recruiters, operators, analysts, and executives. You are comfortable moving between strategy and execution and thrive in environments where the operating model is still being built. You bring experience scaling distributed clinicians, field teams, home-based care, or another operationally complex healthcare workforce. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Taguig, Metro Manila, Philippines URL: http://getmagic.com Account Manager, Retention & Growth - Remote Application Deadline: 5 December 2026 Department: Talent Team Employment Type: Full Time Location: Philippines Reporting To: Andrew Valle Compensation: ₱60,000 - ₱80,000 / month Description Backed by Y Combinator and Sequoia Capital, Magic has spent 10+ years connecting fast-growing businesses with top remote talent. This is a full-time, in-house, permanent role with full benefits. You'll be a Magic employee owning client relationships on the company's behalf, not a VA placed with a client. Our clients are busy founders and executives who need remote workers to deliver real ROI, and they need a strategic partner to make that happen. You're not here to answer tickets. You're here to protect revenue, grow accounts, and turn happy clients into loud advocates. The pace is live and constant: client calls, escalations, and account health across a real portfolio, every single day, with no handoffs and no delays. Shift: US Eastern hours, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM ET, Monday to Friday (a 9-hour shift), with occasional early or late calls for West Coast clients or urgent situations. Fully remote, Philippines-based. Key Responsibilities Guard your book of business: own a portfolio of accounts sorted by size, health, and growth potential, and hold 90%+ gross revenue retention (GRR) and 110%+ net revenue retention (NRR). Those are the numbers you're graded on. Spot at-risk accounts before clients say a word. Start renewals 60–90 days out, and get save plans moving early. Launch every new client fast: kickoff call within 24–48 hours of signing, then Magic's 30-60-90 day onboarding framework, with a success plan tied to their business goals and an intro to their remote worker. Host quarterly business reviews (QBRs) clients actually look forward to: data-driven, strategic, action-oriented. Become the trusted advisor to founders and C-suite, and multi-thread across each client so one champion leaving doesn't sink the account. Hunt expansion opportunities and make the business case before anyone asks. Surface the story in the data: track churn risk and expansion signals, keep HubSpot clean, send a monthly portfolio health report (retention, NRR, CSAT, NPS, QBR completion), and own every escalation from intake to resolution. Qualifications & Technical Requirements 3+ years of B2B customer success or account management experience, juggling a portfolio of accounts at the same time Direct ownership of revenue retention and expansion targets across the full customer lifecycle from onboarding to renewal Background in SaaS/tech, outsourcing/staffing, professional services/BPO, or marketplace platforms HubSpot experience used daily for pipeline and account health (intermediate-to-expert Salesforce or a similar CRM also works) Intermediate-to-advanced Excel or Google Sheets: pivot tables, VLOOKUP/INDEX MATCH, dashboards, trend analysis Real US market experience: you know US business culture, SMB challenges, and how executives like to communicate Strong written and spoken English, good enough for daily conversations with US-based C-level and Director clients A professional home office: high-speed internet (50+ Mbps), a headset, and a quiet space You treat customer success as a revenue function, not a help desk. You own the outcome, so you don't wait to be told an account is wobbling; you've already spotted it, and your save plan is moving. You're comfortable in a room with a founder or a C-suite exec, and you can plow through a messy escalation without losing the relationship. You read the data, find the story, and walk into every QBR with a point of view. You pitch expansion because the numbers back it up, not because a quota told you to. When something breaks, you adapt, get the right people in the room, and keep going. Application + pre-qualifying questions → HR interview (45 min) → 24-hour reflection period → Panel Interview with Senior CSMs → interview with CS Director → Final Interview with the Head of Sales & CS → Job Offer What's In It For You ₱60,000–₱80,000 gross per month, permanent and full-time, fully remote (Philippines). HMO coverage after regularization, 12 vacation days and 10 sick days a year, 13th month pay, SSS, PhilHealth, and PAG-IBIG. We offer paid training and promote from within: top CSMs move into Senior CSM, Team Lead / CS Manager, and CS Director roles. We're an ambitious, driven team that plows through obstacles instead of waiting for perfect conditions. There's no hierarchy and no politics: you can talk to anyone, on any team, about anything. We respect each other's time, and we actually like working together. Magic is backed by Y Combinator and Sequoia Capital, with more than 10 years of connecting top remote talent with fast-growing businesses and 2,000+ remote workers worldwide. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/magic-inc-account-manager-retention-growth-remote
