items.summary: Headquarters: Atlanta; San Francisco; United States (Remote) Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build produc
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Atlanta; San Francisco; United States (Remote) Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B. We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal. We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people. Upgrade is a fintech company focused on providing affordable and responsible credit to everyday consumers. Our Auto business is growing, and demand generation is how we reach the customers, and partners who power that growth. As a Demand Generation Manager , you will own the day-to-day strategy and execution that drive new business across Auto, spanning paid media, email, content, events, and sales-led campaigns. You will build the campaigns, nurture journeys, and reporting needed to drive measurable pipeline growth and revenue impact. This is a highly visible role for someone who is analytical, comfortable owning cross-functional work end to end, and energized by building and scaling a marketing foundation. You will work in close partnership with Sales, Partnerships, Sales Enablement, and Customer Success, and alongside Lifecycle, Product Marketing, Design, Legal & Compliance, and Data partners, so that acquisition efforts line up with onboarding, engagement, and retention. You will sit at the intersection of growth and marketing execution, working directly with the teams closest to revenue, with real ownership and the ability to shape how Upgrade shows up in the Automotive market. What You’ll Do: Own demand generation strategy for Auto across PPC, email, content, events, and web Refine the GTM, messaging, and value proposition for each business, aligned to ICP and buyer personas Optimize lead acquisition, conversion, and pipeline velocity, and manage and improve MQL quality and performance Partner with Account Executives, Partnerships, and Sales leadership to brainstorm, align on, and launch campaigns, including sales incentives, competitions, and referral programs Refine nurture journeys and build segmentation strategies in HubSpot, Salesforce, and Outreach Lead campaigns end to end (strategy, execution, measurement), defining success metrics and setting a clear reporting cadence Work cross-functionally to move campaigns forward: Design tickets within the sprint cycle, Lifecycle requests, and early Legal, Compliance, and bank review Oversee website strategy and optimization, ensuring alignment with campaign messaging, ICP targeting, SEO best practices, and conversion rate optimization Build performance dashboards and attribution reporting tied to revenue outcomes, working with Data and Sales Ops partners across Heap, Google Analytics, Salesforce, and Tableau Manage the demand generation budget and track program spend against results Continuously test and optimize campaigns for efficiency and effectiveness Use AI-enabled tools when helpful to streamline content development, summarize insights, and improve workflow efficiency, so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality What We Look For: 5-7+ years of B2B or demand generation marketing experience, ideally within fintech, consumer lending, auto finance focused products. Proven experience leading demand generation and pipeline growth, including paid digital channels such as Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads. Proficiency in Salesforce and HubSpot. Demonstrated skills or projects with claude, chatgpt, co-pilot or any other AI tool. Data-driven mindset with strong analytical skills, including experience with attribution, funnel reporting, and dashboards in Tableau (or a comparable BI tool). Track record of designing and analyzing test-and-learn experiments (e.g., A/B tests) to optimize campaign performance. Strong understanding of integrated marketing strategy, with the ability to translate strategy into clear plans and messaging. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting results and recommendations to senior stakeholders. Self-starter who is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cross-functional workstreams in a fast-paced environment. BA/BS degree in business or a closely related field, or equivalent practical experience. Curiosity and adaptability with AI-enabled tools, which are already part of how work gets done across our organization and will continue to expand over time. Nice to Have: Experience with Outreach, Heap, or Google Analytics. Experience partnering with Legal and Compliance on marketing review in a regulated environment. Experience with partner, referral, or sales-incentive programs. Familiarity with website strategy, SEO best practices, and conversion rate optimization. What We Offer You: Competitive salary and stock option plan 100% paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance Flexible PTO Opportunities for professional growth and development Paid parental leave Health & wellness initiatives #BI-Hybrid #LI-Hybrid For California residents: Upgrade's California Notice at Collection and Privacy Policy describes our practices regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of the personal information of job applicants. Environmental & Working Conditions Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations. Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives. The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need. J ob duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position. Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings. Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Upgrade does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or any third parties. Any resume submitted to any employee of Upgrade without a prior written agreement in place will be considered the property of Upgrade, and Upgrade will not be obligated to pay any referral or placement fee. Agencies must obtain advance written approval from Upgrade's Talent Acquisition department to submit resumes and only in conjunction with a valid, fully executed agreement. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upgrade-demand-generation-manager-auto

items.title: Produktspezialist:in (German-speaking)
items.summary: You know SaaS. You like helping people get it right. And you'd rather have a real conversation than a hard sell. Do you speak German natively and want to help organisations get the most from a world-class SaaS platform? Then this might be the role you're looking for. Join a lean-by-design, globally recognised B2B SaaS company as the German-speaking specialist for our DACH+ markets. No cold calling, no quotas — just meaningful conversations that help interested people discover how our software makes their work easier, then supporting them brilliantly once they're on board. You won't be opening the market alone. Our marketing team already brings in German-speaking interest, and our experienced English-speaking sales colleagues handle these leads well. Your edge is simple and valuable: when a German-speaking prospect wants a demo auf Deutsch , or a new client wants onboarding and support in their own language, you're the person who makes that feel effortless — gründlich, verlässlich und auf den Punkt. Join our Rebel Alliance We're a diverse, remote crew that takes the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. You'll be a valued member of our global Client Success team, well supported with the tools, knowledge and people you need to do excellent work. In time you'll learn to work across teams and draw on our collective expertise — and you'll have real backing at every turn to grow into a confident product expert. What you'll do Run German-language demos for warm, interested leads — clearly and confidently Become a product expert (with our support) and answer client and prospect questions accurately Onboard and support clients in German and/or English, setting them up for success from day one Provide responsive, thoughtful support in either German or English Test scenarios carefully so your answers are technically correct, not guessed Report recurring issues to help us improve the product Build trust through honesty, empathy and reliability What you bring (essentials) Native-level German (C2) and strong business English Minimum 3 years SaaS experience in support, onboarding, implementation or technical pre-sales Real technical aptitude. Terms like HTML, CSS, JS, API, integrations, staging vs production, dev console and database queries are familiar — you needn't be a developer, but you should be genuinely comfortable around them and quick to learn the product's technical side A confident communicator, written and spoken, who listens well Comfortable discussing product value and guiding decisions — without the hard sell Highly organised and process-driven; at home in a remote, tool-rich setup Based in EMEA, ideally within DACH or close business-hours overlap (UTC+1/+2) Reliable internet and a dedicated, distraction-free workspace Nice to have Familiarity with awards, grants, recognition or programme-management workflows Experience supporting clients across both German and English The short version If you're technically sharp, genuinely enjoy helping people, and want to be the German-speaking specialist our DACH+ clients rely on, we'd love to hear from you. Komm an Bord!

items.title: Content Reviewer - United States
items.summary: Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust. In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information. Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models Qualifications to succeed in this project: Professional fluency in English Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher) Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred) Why join the project: Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset. Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance Qualification path How to get started: Complete your contributor profile and application Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training Receive your project assignment and access credentials Service Rates The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

items.title: Customer Service Representative
items.summary: Work From Home. Pick Your Schedule. Get Paid Weekly. Welcome to ShyftOff! Tired of traditional jobs that expect you to build your life around a fixed schedule? At ShyftOff, we believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around! We're changing the way customer service works by connecting independent professionals with exciting opportunities to support established businesses, all from the comfort of home. Whether you're looking to earn extra income, take greater control of your schedule, or explore a flexible remote opportunity, ShyftOff gives you the freedom to work differently. Why Choose ShyftOff? No commute. No traditional fixed schedule. More flexibility. More control. 100% Remote: Forget the commute! Work from the comfort of your own home. Weekly Pay: Get paid every week for eligible completed work. You Make Your Schedule: Choose available shifts that fit your lifestyle. Work when opportunities align with your availability. Earn $14-$20 Per Hour: Competitive campaign pay with opportunities to increase your earnings based on program and eligibility. Important: Applications will only be considered if you apply on the ShyftOff website at https://www.shyftoff.com/agents The Role As an independent agent, you take inbound calls for ShyftOff client programs and help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and get what they need. After you join, you choose which programs to apply for based on your qualifications and availability. One of our newest programs include: Financial Services Program — $15–$20 per hour plus incentives + $300 certification bonus Help cardholders manage their money with confidence. You'll take inbound calls from people who rely on their banking cards for everyday life: activating a new card, replacing a lost one, sorting out a disputed charge, or getting a time-sensitive payment through. This is credentialed financial services work on an established account, built for people who want to meet a real bar and stick around. What you'll do: Handle inbound calls on card activation, replacements, lost or stolen cards, balances, and account questions Help customers with payments, transfers, and disputes, accurately and securely Verify customer identity and follow strict security and compliance protocols on every call Spot and help resolve potential fraud with composure Document every interaction accurately in the account's systems Who you'll talk to: cardholders and their benefits managers, often at a stressful moment like a lost card or a charge they don't recognize. Your job is to guide them, protect their account, and get them back on solid ground. Healthcare Program — $14–$20 per hour plus incentives + $200 certification bonus Compassionate, detail-oriented agents support a healthcare campaign, where your role is vital in providing clear information and support. What you'll do: Engage with customers to understand their concerns and provide solutions Clearly explain the breach details and the services offered to them Maintain a high level of empathy and professionalism in all communications Accurately submit CRM tickets to ensure effective issue resolution What Makes You a Fit (all programs) Communication: you connect over the phone, listen well, and stay empathetic even when the caller isn't calm Security and accuracy: you take protecting sensitive information seriously Tech comfort: you can move between multiple systems and databases at once Composure: you think clearly and solve problems in a fast-paced environment Remote customer service or contact center experience is a strong plus; 3+ years of customer service experience preferred What You'll Need (all programs) Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum) A quiet, professional home workspace suitable for customer calls Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed.

What you'll do: Engage with customers to understand their concerns and provide solutions Clearly explain the breach details and the services offered to them Maintain a high level of empathy and professionalism in all communications Accurately submit CRM tickets to ensure effective issue resolution What Makes You a Fit (all programs) Communication: you connect over the phone, listen well, and stay empathetic even when the caller isn't calm Security and accuracy: you take protecting sensitive information seriously Tech comfort: you can move between multiple systems and databases at once Composure: you think clearly and solve problems in a fast-paced environment Remote customer service or contact center experience is a strong plus; 3+ years of customer service experience preferred What You'll Need (all programs) Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum) A quiet, professional home workspace suitable for customer calls Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed.

items.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
items.summary: Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating. We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you. Duties · Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients · Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success · Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required · Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services. · Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines · Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues · Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management · Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment · Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices · Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives Our Technology Stack · Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA · Documentation – Hudu · RMM – Intune / Immybot · Networking – Meraki · Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365 · Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon · Door Access – Avigilon Qualification · 6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support · Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry · Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service · Proven experience leading IT projects · A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications · Background in providing direct end-user support · High level of attention to detail · Excellent verbal and written communication skills · IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent) · Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents Our Core Values Dream Big, Then Make it Real We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard. Do, rather than talk and tell. Client Driven Results Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results. When they succeed, we succeed. Own Your Progress We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes. Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution. We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

items.title: Content Reviewer - United States
items.summary: We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit. A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform. By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself. Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies. Service Rates The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital. Qualification path Qualification Process No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process. Basic Requirements • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English • Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs in the United States • Active use of Gmail and social media platforms • Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online content • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection • Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher) • Access to a personal computer Assessment You must complete an English language assessment, pass an open book qualification exam, and complete an ID verification in order to be successful for this role. These assessments will determine your suitability for the position.

items.title: Freelance Copywriter
items.summary: CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role. The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy. About the Role Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including: Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands Skincare and beauty Tech and software Finance and investing Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability Education Home improvement Automobiles and motorcycles Health and wellness Medical and clinical fields Digital marketing SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply. Responsibilities Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team Qualifications Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content Portfolio featuring published work preferred Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred Compensation Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric. Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate Application Process Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

items.title: Paid Media Specialist
items.summary: Kinsta is one of the top providers of managed hosting for WordPress, with a growing club of 230,000+ businesses including startups, universities, and Fortune 500 firms. We're motivated by excellent quality and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers. That's because, to us, each day is a chance to grow. As a team, we continuously inspire each other to learn new and better ways to make an impact. We own our jobs proudly - our leaders don't hold our hands, but they're in our corner whenever we ask for help - and our environment is flexible and remote-first. As our new Paid Media Specialist, you'll plan, run, and optimize paid social advertising campaigns for Kinsta. You'll join our Performance Marketing team, report to the Paid Media Team Lead, and work closely with Demand Generation, Design, and RevOps to deliver a consistent volume of sign-ups and revenue that supports Kinsta's growth goals. It's a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable with data and enjoys testing new ideas. Your focus is Kinsta's paid social presence across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, and other relevant platforms. You'll reach the businesses, agencies, and enterprises that run their sites on WordPress, through campaigns that cover the full funnel from awareness to customer acquisition. You'll own campaigns from build to optimization, keep conversion tracking reliable, and turn performance data into clear recommendations. We work with teams across the globe, so you should be used to collaborating asynchronously and flexible enough to join the occasional early or late call. The ideal Kinsta Paid Media Specialist is analytical, detail-oriented, curious, proactive, and collaborative. What You Will Do: Plan, build, launch, and manage paid social campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, and other relevant platforms, covering the full funnel from awareness and demand generation to lead generation and customer acquisition. Monitor performance and continuously optimize targeting, bidding strategies, budgets, ad creatives, and landing pages, scaling what works while keeping acquisition costs efficient. Run audience research and competitive analysis to find new opportunities for growth. Develop and run A/B tests across ad messaging, creative assets, audiences, and landing pages. Own conversion tracking: implement, maintain, and troubleshoot it through Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and platform-specific pixels and tags, and work with marketing and technical teams to keep conversion events and attribution accurate. Analyze campaign performance using ad platform data, web analytics, and CRM reporting, and build reports and dashboards that share results and actionable insights. Collaborate with content, design, product marketing, and sales on ad copy, creative concepts, and campaign assets that match our messaging and business priorities. Support our paid media strategy: follow advertising trends and platform updates, and recommend ways to improve campaign efficiency, lead quality, and overall marketing ROI. Use AI tools to streamline research, reporting, ad copy, and creative ideation, automate repetitive tasks, and apply critical thinking to AI-generated recommendations so decisions stay grounded in accurate data and business objectives. What You Bring To The Role: 2-4 years of hands-on experience independently building, launching, managing, and optimizing paid social campaigns, including on Meta, LinkedIn, and Reddit, ideally in hosting, B2B technology, or a related industry. Practical experience setting up and troubleshooting conversion tracking with Google Tag Manager, GA4, and advertising platform pixels or conversion tags. A strong understanding of core paid media metrics, including CPC, CPM, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, and ROAS, and experience analyzing campaign data and turning findings into actionable optimizations. Familiarity with audience targeting, retargeting, and campaign testing methodologies, and an understanding of marketing funnels, attribution, and how paid media contributes to lead generation and customer acquisition. Attention to detail, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities at once. Bonus if you have: Experience running paid media campaigns for B2B SaaS, hosting, PaaS, or other technical products, and familiarity with WordPress or cloud platforms. Experience with CRM, marketing automation, and attribution or reporting tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Looker Studio, Dreamdata, or HockeyStack. Knowledge of advanced conversion tracking, including enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports, and server-side tracking, plus a basic understanding of HTML, JavaScript, cookies, and how tracking tags work on websites. Experience optimizing landing pages and collaborating on conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives. Proficiency in other languages and experience managing non-English paid media campaigns Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to improve campaign workflows, analysis, and creative development. Our Benefits: Annual remote expense budget. Flexible PTO. Paid parental leave. Annual professional development budget: available after one year with Kinsta. Sabbatical: available after three years with Kinsta (and every three years thereafter). Location-specific healthcare benefits (includes vision and dental) for employees hired in the USA, UK, Canada, and Hungary. Pension plan for employees hired in the UK, and 401k contributions for employees hired in the USA. Kinsta is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate and we will take actions to ensure against discrimination in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, citizenship, age, religion, creed, disability, marital status, veteranâs status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. By applying to one of our positions, you agree to the processing of the submitted personal data in accordance with Kinsta's Privacy Policy , including the transfer of your data to the United States. #LI-Remote, #IHSRemote Please mention the word **OUTSHINE** and tag RNDguMjE3LjE0MC4yMjY= when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNDguMjE3LjE0MC4yMjY=). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.description: About Welo Global Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. ROLE OVERVIEW Welo Global is partnering with a social media client to build high-quality training data for AI systems . We are looking for Brazilian experts to help create challenging, expert-level questions and answers in their field. The content that will directly shape how AI understands Brazilian culture, law, history, and society. This is a remote, flexible freelance engagement. All work is done in Brazilian Portuguese . What you'll do For each assignment, you will craft a challenging, expert-level question on a Brazilian topic in your field (one that AI tools cannot fully answer), write the ideal response in Brazilian Portuguese and break that response down into individually cited facts with their sources and relevance. Important: AI tools may be used for research support only. All questions, answers, and fact breakdowns must be your own original work. We are looking for experts in the domain listed in the job posting. Project details Language Pair : Brazilian Portuguese Task : AI data annotation Area of expertise (domain) : TV & Movies Tools : Consumer-grade LLM with search (e.g., Gemini Pro), for prompt difficulty calibration Estimated Volume : 60 hours over approximately 2 months, the hours are flexible, work on your own schedule Location : Remote Engagement Type : Freelance / Independent Contractor If this opportunity aligns with your experience, we would be happy to receive your application. To proceed, please provide the following: Share an updated CV A brief overview of your relevant experience, particularly in TV & Movies and how many years you have worked in the field Your current availability and estimated monthly capacity Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global Job Reference: #LI-JC1 Compensation Additional Information

You will work independently while maintaining clear communication with our NLP experts, ensuring the accuracy and relevance…
items.description: How You'll Contribute As a Freelance Spanish Data Annotation Specialist at Docplanner, your main focus will be preparing and curating linguistically and medically oriented datasets in Spanish to power our machine learning and natural language processing (NLP) initiatives. You will work independently while maintaining clear communication with our NLP experts, ensuring the accuracy and relevance of our data for the Spanish market, and contributing directly to the quality and reliability of our AI-driven products in the medical domain. This role is ideal for candidates with a strong linguistic background in Spanish who are passionate about working in the healthcare and technology space. The ideal candidate has experience in data annotation, transcription, and text analysis, combined with a basic understanding of medical terminology and concepts. Key Responsibilities: Prepare and maintain medically oriented datasets for machine learning purposes, ensuring high-quality data annotation and consistency. Follow and provide feedback on annotation and labeling conventions, as well as perform audio transcriptions in Spanish (aligning audio with text and correcting text based on audio). Implement text patterns to detect and extract named entities in Spanish, such as names, addresses, organization names, ID numbers, and medical terms. Contribute to dictionaries and taxonomies in Spanish for use in NLP systems. Evaluate the correctness and accuracy of Spanish words, sentences, and text structures, ensuring linguistic quality and consistency. Deliver high-quality work within established deadlines and communicate proactively about project progress and challenges. What We're Looking For: Languages: Native Spanish speaker and Full Professional Level of English Linguistic Expertise: A degree or strong background in Italian linguistics, computational linguistics, or a related field. Medical Knowledge: Familiarity with Spanish medical terminology or prior experience in the healthcare domain. Data Annotation: Hands-on experience with data annotation, transcription, and labeling tools. Text Analysis: Proficiency in working with text patterns and dictionaries for NLP purposes. Attention to Detail: Exceptional ability to assess and improve data quality. Self-Management: Strong ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and consistently meet deadlines. Which skills are 'bonus points'? Previous experience in AI, machine learning, or data preparation projects. Knowledge of multiple languages or dialects beyond Spanish and English. Exposure to medical coding systems (e.g., ICD, CPT) or electronic health records (EHR). Experience working as a freelancer on similar annotation or linguistic projects.

items.description: Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands. About the Role Veeam is looking for a Senior Digital Experience Research Analyst to shape how millions of technology decision-makers experience us online. Sitting at the intersection of research, analytics, and digital strategy, you will own the full research lifecycle, from early discovery and user interviews through experimentation, measurement, and optimization, building the evidence base behind decisions across our global web presence. This is a role about bringing data to life: turning behavioral signals, test results, and user voices into narratives that move executives to act. You will work with significant autonomy, influence strategy at the executive level, and partner across marketing, corporate technology, and creative services to make sure every digital experience is built on insight rather than assumption. What You’ll Do Define and own the user research strategy and roadmap, scaling research frameworks, standards, and best practices across teams Lead qualitative and quantitative research initiatives, including user testing, interviews, surveys, competitive benchmarking, and expert reviews Analyze behavioral data and user feedback to uncover insights, friction points, and opportunities that shape product and design decisions Define and evolve the web measurement strategy, monitoring user behavior and performance and reporting through dashboards and executive presentations Own the experimentation program, including A/B and multivariate testing, partnering with design, product, and development teams to validate hypotheses and improve conversion and engagement Craft data stories that pair quantitative evidence with user voices, setting the bar for how insight is visualized and presented Build and maintain scalable research documentation and insight repositories so findings stay accessible and reusable across teams Technologies You’ll Work With Adobe Analytics and Customer Journey Analytics Adobe Target for personalization and testing UserTesting for qualitative research Microsoft Clarity for scroll maps, heatmaps, and session recordings Survey and interview tools What You’ll Bring Four or more years of experience, or equivalent skill, in user research, digital experience, conversion optimization, or a related field Proven experience defining and leading research strategy and programs Strong expertise in qualitative and quantitative research methodologies Hands-on experience with Adobe Analytics and Customer Journey Analytics, and with Adobe Target for personalization and testing Demonstrated data storytelling ability, with examples of readouts that changed a decision Strong understanding of user-centered design principles and familiarity with accessibility standards Highly analytical and strategic, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive alignment across a matrixed organization Bonus Skills Experience with large-scale websites or digital platforms, particularly business-to-business Experience with qualitative research and behavior tools such as UserTesting, Microsoft Clarity, and Hotjar Experience applying AI tools across the research lifecycle, such as synthesizing interview transcripts, clustering open-ended feedback, spotting patterns in behavioral data, or accelerating analysis and reporting Experience building a research practice or insight repository from the ground up Comfort operating in a fast-paced, global environment with multiple competing priorities #LI-TS1 #remote What you'll get Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day Mental health support, therapy sessions, and digital wellness tools via our Employee Assistance Program 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support through Maven, plus paid volunteer time AirVet: 24/7 virtual veterinary care at no cost Legal services, identity protection, and supplemental health insurance options Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning Compensation Transparency Veeam is committed to pay transparency and equitable compensation. For this role, the compensation range below reflects the expected total target compensation (TTC), inclusive of base pay and a competitive performance-based bonus. For roles with a commission plan, the compensation range represents On Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus variable commission. When determining compensation, Veeam takes into consideration factors such as experience, education, skills, and geographic zone. Offers are typically made below the midpoint of the range. In addition to compensation, Veeam provides a comprehensive benefits package, including health coverage, retirement plans, and unlimited time off. items.description: Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online marketplaces that match searchers and “research and compare” consumers with brands . We run these virtual- and private-label marketplaces in one of the nation’s largest media networks. Our industry leading segmentation and AI-driven matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster. They allow brands to target and reach in-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment-by-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results. Our campaign-results-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience. We believe in: The direct measurability of digital media. Performance marketing. (We pioneered it.) The advantages of technology. We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world’s biggest channel. Job Category We are seeking an autonomous, driven, and data-fluent Account Manager to join our performance marketing team, specializing in the health and Medicare insurance category. In this role, you will own client relationships with health/Medicare carriers, brokers, agencies, and aggregators. You will act as a proactive strategic partner—optimizing revenue, managing media performance, and driving client portfolio growth. Because this is a fully remote position, we are looking for a natural self-starter who thrives in an autonomous environment, takes complete ownership of their accounts, and proactively uncovers new revenue opportunities. Responsibilities Client Portfolio Management & Strategy: Own end-to-end relationships with a portfolio of health and Medicare insurance clients, serving as their primary strategic advisor. Proactive Revenue Growth: Proactively identify opportunities to scale client accounts, optimize performance, and expand the client profile to drive category revenue. Performance Optimization: Monitor and analyze key performance indicators—including revenue, Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), and media buying metrics—to hit or exceed client targets and KPIs. Performance Marketing Execution: Manage lead generation, calls, and clicks performance campaigns specifically tailored to the insurance sector. Data Analysis & Reporting: Leverage advanced tools to evaluate campaign performance, build insightful reports, and communicate actionable insights clearly to internal teams and external stakeholders. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal media buying, affiliate, and data/analyst teams to align campaign strategies, streamline execution, and maximize client portfolio performance. Requirements 3+ years of Industry Experience: Direct performance marketing experience within the health and Medicare insurance category (or closely related insurance/financial verticals). Technical & Analytical Proficiency: Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, complex formulas, data manipulation). Strong proficiency in Tableau for data visualization and client reporting. Performance Marketing Expertise: Deep understanding of revenue models, ROAS, media buying strategies, and lead/call/click generation. Exceptional Communication & Interpersonal Skills: High charisma, top-tier relationship-building capabilities, and proactive communication. Autonomy & Ownership: Proven track record as a self-starter who excels in a remote, independent environment without requiring heavy managerial oversight. Regulatory & Compliance Understanding: Strong working knowledge of CMS (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services) marketing guidelines and compliance frameworks essential for Medicare and health insurance performance marketing. Organization: Impeccable organizational skills to manage multiple high-stakes client accounts simultaneously. Nice-to-Haves (Bonus Skills) Familiarity with AI-driven tools and workflows that enhance client management, data processing, or campaign optimization. Prior experience in direct portfolio management with established industry clients. The expected salary range for this position is $70,000 USD to $100,000 USD annually. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on the Company’s compensation practices. The salary may be adjusted based on applicant's geographic location. The position is also eligible to receive performance bonus or commission and equity in the form of restricted stock units. This position is eligible to participate in the Company’s standard employee benefits programs, which currently include health care benefits; (2) retirement benefits; (3) the amount of paid days off (paid sick leave, parental leave, paid time off, or vacation benefits); (4) any other tax-reportable benefits. #LI-REMOTE QuinStreet is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, pregnancy status, sex, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristics protected by law. Please see QuinStreet’s Employee Privacy Notice here and EU/UK Candidate Privacy Notice here .

items.description: Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta. About the role: As a founding Strategic Account Executive for Iberia, you will own 8-12 of the largest strategic accounts across Spain and/or Portugal — IBEX35-caliber banking, telco, insurance, utilities, and travel enterprises. You'll run complex, multi-level sales cycles from 6 to 18 months, build both the business case and the technical win alongside your Solutions Consultant, and drive long-term land-and-expand strategy while continuing to bring in new logos. items.summary: About the Role: At TELUS Digital, we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality.
items.description: About the Role: At TELUS Digital , we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality. As a 3D Spatial Data Expert , you are the "Mapmaker of the Future." You will join our AI Community as a specialist tasked with identifying and labeling the physical world within 3D datasets, such as LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) and 3D meshes. While our Specialists handle complex physics and urban planning, you are the one who teaches the AI the "alphabet" of space—where a curb ends, where a pedestrian begins, and how a robotic arm perceives a shelf. At TELUS, you are helping to build the data foundation for autonomous vehicles, drones, and the industrial metaverse. What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities): 3D Bounding Box Annotation: Placing precise 3D cubes (bounding boxes) around objects in point-cloud data to help AI identify their size, location, and orientation in space. Semantic Segmentation: "Painting" 3D maps to categorize different surfaces—distinguishing between a drivable road, a sidewalk, and a permanent obstacle. Point-Cloud Cleaning: Reviewing raw sensor data from self-driving cars or robots to remove "noise" (like rain or dust) so the AI sees a clear picture of reality. Simulated Data Validation: Comparing AI-generated 3D environments against real-world captures to ensure the digital version is a faithful "twin" of the physical one. Spatial Logic Testing: Answering simple questions about 3D scenes (e.g., "Is the drone's path clear of the overhead wire?") to validate the model's spatial reasoning. Qualification path What You Bring (Mandatory Qualifications): Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in any field. (Preferred: Architecture, Geography, Graphic Design, Game Design, or STEM fields). Native Language: Native-level proficiency in your primary language is mandatory for labeling localized signage and environmental assets correctly. English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level English to follow technical spatial guidelines. Visual-Spatial Skills: Strong "3D vision"—the ability to look at a flat screen and understand the depth and volume of objects. Assessment: In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Payment: Currently, pay rates for experts range from $18 - $50 USD per hour Our Payment terms are defined for each project. Why Join the TELUS Digital AI Community: Community Connection: Work remotely as part of a 1M+ diverse global AI Community of contributors and experts. Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day. Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies. Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects. Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology. TELUS Digital AI Community Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. We are looking for university students, graduates, researchers and experienced professionals with expertise across Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, LLMs, Mathematics, Science, Engineering, Linguistics, Cybersecurity, Psychology, Law, Healthcare, Finance, Education and other specialist disciplines. You do not need a degree specifically called “Artificial Intelligence.” We are looking for people with strong subject-matter expertise, analytical thinking and the ability to assess whether AI is accurate, logical, safe and fit for purpose. What you may work on: Depending on your expertise, you could evaluate: AI & Machine Learning AI/ML concepts and technical outputs Model reasoning and performance Data and technical accuracy Coding and computational outputs LLM & NLP AI-generated text and conversations Language, meaning, context and reasoning Hallucinations and factual accuracy LLM responses and instruction following Mathematical & Logical Reasoning Mathematical calculations Statistics and probability Logic and multi-step reasoning Scientific and quantitative problem solving AI Safety & Red Teaming AI failure modes Unsafe or inappropriate outputs Model vulnerabilities and weaknesses Adversarial and edge-case scenarios Responsible AI behaviour Domain-Specific AI Evaluation Healthcare & Medicine Law Finance, Economics & Accounting Education Engineering & Robotics Physics & Science Business Humanities & Social Sciences Linguistics and other specialist domains You may be asked to: Evaluate AI-generated responses against defined criteria Identify factual, technical, linguistic or reasoning errors Compare multiple AI responses and determine which is stronger Assess whether an AI solution is accurate, relevant and logically sound Identify hallucinations, inconsistencies and potential risks Apply evaluation guidelines consistently Provide clear, structured expert feedback Help establish and maintain high-quality evaluation standards Qualification path This is expert AI evaluation — not traditional data annotation. Who we're looking for You may be a: Min Bachelor's, Master's or PhD graduate Researcher or academic Industry professional Subject-matter expert AI/ML practitioner Relevant backgrounds include: Artificial Intelligence • Machine Learning • Computer Science • Data Science • Mathematics • Statistics • Physics • Engineering • Linguistics • Computational Linguistics • Psychology • Cybersecurity • Law • Medicine • Healthcare • Finance • Economics • Education • Business • Science • Humanities Assessment: In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Payment: Currently, pay rates for experts range from $45 - $160 USD per hour Our Payment terms are defined for each project. Why Join the TELUS Digital AI Community: Community Connection: Work remotely as part of a 1M+ diverse global AI Community of contributors and experts. Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day. Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies. Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects. Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology. TELUS Digital AI Community Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital. Originally posted on Himalayas

Contribute written and verbal analyses articulating complex warfighting, targeting, and IHL concepts for interdisciplinary audiences. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey technical and ethical concepts clearly and concisely. items.title: Investment Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project
items.summary: Are you knowledgeable about investments and eager to shape the future of AI?
items.description: Are you knowledgeable about investments and eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from simple conversational tools into systems capable of analyzing financial markets, interpreting investment strategies, and supporting decision-making across asset classes. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can help improve financial literacy, strengthen portfolio analysis, and support investors and analysts worldwide. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI. We’re looking for individuals with familiarity in areas such as equity and fixed-income markets, portfolio management, asset allocation, derivatives, valuation methods, financial modeling, risk management, behavioral finance, and macroeconomic influences on markets. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics such as fundamental and technical analysis, portfolio construction, diversification strategies, market cycles, performance evaluation, and investment research—documenting failure modes so we can strengthen model reasoning and analytical accuracy. On a typical day, you will engage the model with investment scenarios, analytical questions, and market-based reasoning tasks; verify factual correctness and financial logic; assess the validity of investment reasoning; capture reproducible error traces; and provide structured feedback to improve prompts, evaluation frameworks, and analytical depth. You may also help identify where models oversimplify market behavior or misinterpret financial data. A background in finance, economics, accounting, business, or a related field is preferred but not required. Experience in asset management, brokerage, research, financial planning, or related roles is valuable, and entry-level candidates with foundational knowledge of investments and strong analytical skills are encouraged to apply. Clear, metacognitive communication—explicitly articulating reasoning and decision processes (“showing your work”)—is essential. Ready to turn your knowledge of investments into the knowledge foundation for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and help train systems that support investors, analysts, and financial professionals worldwide. We offer a pay range of $6 to $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply. items.title: Junior Software Engineer
items.summary: About Syd Life AI We build life quality infrastructure that compounds validated research and action into better living .
items.description: About Syd Life AI We build life quality infrastructure that compounds validated research and action into better living . Syd , our companion , draws on 2.7 million+ peer-reviewed studies and 14.3 billion+ person-years of longitudinal data , and turns that evidence into action across nine dimensions of life quality . Every recommendation traces back to its evidence . Syd is available in 30 languages and deployed in 26 countries . Privacy and security sit at the centre of how we build : SOC 2 , ISO 27001 , ISO 42001 , GDPR and HIPAA . Our goal is to give people their agency back . We hire people who already act that way : you choose the problem , test the idea against the evidence and measure the impact . Small remote team , real ownership from your first week , consulting agreements with equity . The role Syd is looking for a resourceful , high-agency software engineer with solid JavaScript and TypeScript fundamentals and hands-on React and React Native experience . You will work directly with our CTO in a lean engineering team , with real ownership and influence on our architecture from day one . Your main focus is UI and product feature development across our mobile app ( React Native bare workflow with Expo OTA updates ) and web applications ( React ) . As you settle into the role , you will expand into our backend ( Node.js ) and cloud infrastructure ( AWS ) . What you bring 2 to 4 years of experience , fluent in modern TypeScript and JavaScript , clean component architectures and async state patterns . Proven experience shipping production features in React and React Native , across web and mobile . Comfortable inspecting native builds , handling CocoaPods and Gradle , and debugging build steps in Xcode and Android Studio . Autonomous problem solving : reading official documentation and build logs , and diagnosing and fixing problems independently . Clear communication : clear pull requests , proactive updates , and blockers raised together with a proposed solution . Located within 3 hours of UK time ( GMT / BST ) for real-time collaboration . What you will do Build , polish and maintain member-facing features across our React Native mobile app and React web apps . Manage the practicalities of a bare React Native setup , including native dependencies and OTA deployments with Expo . Work closely with the CTO on feature scope , technical trade-offs and architectural direction . Own delivery end to end , from early design discussion to production rollout and monitoring . Progressively take on backend initiatives ( Node.js APIs ) and cloud workflows ( AWS ) . Terms Remote , within 3 hours of UK time . Consulting agreement with equity . How to apply Apply at careers.syd.life/careers/junior-software-engineer . Every candidate completes an online assessment and a 48-hour task before any interview . Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote US Head of Growth Outmarket AI · Remote (US) · Full-time · Reports to the SVP of Marketing About Outmarket Insurance still runs on manual work. Most policies are sold through agents and brokers, and the people who know the work best are buried in the documents: checking policies line by line, comparing quotes, building proposals, on nights and weekends. We think that's backwards. The best people in insurance should spend their time advising clients. Outmarket, the AI platform built for insurance, makes that possible. Account teams drop in their documents and get back finished work to review, with every finding linked to the page it came from. Outmarket connects to the systems they already use. The judgment stays with the person; the groundwork doesn't. It's working. More than 10,000 people at over 300 agencies use Outmarket, including 30 of the top 100 U.S. insurance brokers. Most of those agencies found us through other customers. We raised a $34.5M Series B led by SignalFire four months after announcing our Series A because customers were pulling us forward faster than we planned. Why this role Demand that already exists. Customers recommend us to each other. Your job is to turn that word of mouth into an engine we can plan around. Ground floor. You'll join marketing while the team is being built, alongside a new Head of Product Marketing and Head of Content. You'll have room to shape the function instead of inheriting a playbook. A direct line. You'll work with the SVP of Marketing, the CRO, the founders and customers, and you'll see your decisions show up in pipeline within weeks. The role You own marketing's pipeline number. That means qualified meetings with the right brokers and the sales-accepted opportunities and dollars that follow, not leads. You'll run the programs (named-account campaigns, event follow-through, webinars, paid and nurture), own the programs budget, and work closely with the CRO and the account executives. There are two motions. Independent agencies buy through an outbound and events engine. Large brokers buy through a named-account program aimed at a buying committee: principal, producers, operations and often the person who runs their agency management system. You'll run both. A growth marketing associate reports to you from day one. The SVP of Marketing runs demand gen until you arrive and hands it to you in your first month. What you'll do Own the marketing-sourced pipeline number and report it weekly with sales: meetings, sales-accepted opportunities, pipeline dollars and cost per opportunity. Run the named-account program for our top 10 broker targets: choose accounts with sales, run buying-committee plays, and coordinate outbound, paid and event touches. Plan and run the campaign calendar, including renewal-season campaigns, customer webinars and one experiment a month. Own paid media on LinkedIn and search, favoring short customer videos over vendor claims. Cut whatever doesn't produce meetings. Turn events into pipeline with our Director of Industry Events & Programs: pre-show targeting, meeting booking and post-show follow-up. Build nurture and follow-up so no event lead or demo request goes stale, and own lead routing and the marketing tools you run on. Get the customer stories and video made by the Head of Content in front of the right buyers. What we're looking for 5+ years in B2B demand generation or growth marketing You've run named-account or ABM programs aimed at a buying committee and can show what they produced in opportunities, not MQLs. You've worked with a field sales team in an events-heavy motion and know how to turn a conference into meetings. You're hands-on with HubSpot or Salesforce, LinkedIn Ads and outbound tools, and you can build a campaign yourself before you hand it off. You've managed at least one person or a contractor team and can set priorities without hand-holding. You have startup experience at Series A to C, and you built a demand gen function How we work High agency: you find the work instead of waiting for it. Ownership: you carry a number and a function, not a task list. Startup pace: we ship weekly instead of planning quarterly. You don't need to know insurance. You'll spend your first month in agencies and on calls with producers. Curiosity is the requirement, and becoming fluent is part of the job. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/outmarket-ai-head-of-growth

You will perform quality checks on initial ratings produced by evaluators—validating user intent assessment, query annotation, text classification, and multimedia (video, image, audio) reviews for relevanc, accuracy, and guideline adherence. Re-rate items (double-scoring) to verify labels; resolve discrepancies and document decisions. Perform linguistic quality checks (grammar, tone, clarity, local relevance) and media comprehension reviews. Classify and track errors using an agreed error taxonomy; surface trends and edge cases. Excellent grammar, writing, and proofreading skills. Strong video and image comprehension; good hearing ability for audio tasks. Solid understanding of search engines, user intent, and web content. Preferred qualifications Experience in QC/QA for text classification, query annotation, data labeling, or search quality evaluation.
