items.description: Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. GET TO KNOW US At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company. We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! THE OPPORTUNITY We are hiring a in our Senior Director of Growth, Web Strategy & Operations area in Brazil (Remote accepted) ! Reporting to the VP of Marketing Operations, this role owns the evolution of Wellhub's website — from a traditionally-managed site to an Agentic Website Experience and Operations model, where AI agents increasingly handle content assembly, personalization, identity resolution, and optimization, freeing the team to focus on strategy, judgment calls, and the exceptions that matter. This is a hands-on strategic role: owning the roadmap, design, testing, data, and execution, and leading product managers, UX designers, web analytics, and developers to deliver on that vision. You're expected to have a real point of view on where agentic AI creates leverage on a website versus where it introduces risk, and to be able to defend that point of view to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike. YOUR IMPACT Lead the vision, roadmap, and strategy for Wellhub's website experience, driving its evolution toward an Agentic Website Experience and Operations model — where AI agents increasingly handle content assembly, personalization, and optimization. Own conversion rate optimization end-to-end: define experimentation strategy, size and prioritize A/B tests, lead qualitative research and behavioral surveys, and translate results into optimization decisions. Own website performance measurement and automated reporting (traffic, MQLs, sign-ups, conversions), analyzing visitor behavior through data synthesis, heat mapping, and tools like Amplitude + Looker. Partner with stakeholders across the organization to shape the website experience for product launches, content, campaigns, and the broader roadmap. Lead the website design and UX function, including the Mantra design system and the end-to-end design-to-code operating model (Figma to Mantra to Strapi), owning the quality bar for both human- and agent-generated work. Evaluate, pilot, and scale agentic AI and AI orchestration tools for the website — defining human-in-the-loop boundaries, guardrails, and escalation paths — and identify, procure, and roll out best-in-class website technology and platforms. Own the site's readiness for AI-driven discovery and personalization: architect content and information architecture for SEO, GEO/AEO, and Web MCP, lead the rollout of AI-powered personalization and predictive experimentation, and ensure conversational/AI-assisted website interactions align with the broader company AI architecture. Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness. WHO YOU ARE A seasoned digital/website leader with proven experience and ownership of a website and hands-on experience running experimentation programs. Deep expertise across web tech stacks — analytics platforms, headless CMS, and web design systems — with a track record of managing them end-to-end. Concrete, hands-on experience applying AI/agentic technology to marketing or web workflows (agent frameworks, AI personalization/CRO, conversational content tooling, or GEO/AEO strategy), including AI-assisted design-to-code workflows in production. A clear, defensible point of view on where agentic AI creates leverage versus risk in B2B contexts, with the ability to bridge marketing, martech/engineering, and data teams on AI implementation. Experience leading design and/or research functions, or credibly managing senior design ICs and design system owners, including owning a design system as shared infrastructure rather than a component library. A strong cross-functional leader who thrives in matrixed, fast-paced, hyper-growth environments, balancing internal business needs with a customer-centric mindset. Analytically rigorous, with strong critical thinking to translate complex AI topics into actionable insights and a sharp focus on KPIs and conversion metrics. Quick to adapt to new domain contexts, AI trends, and vendor tools, with experience working across global companies and website localization. We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in B2B website management and hands-on application of agentic AI/experimentation are mandatory requirements. WHAT WE OFFER YOU With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs! Our benefits include: WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content. HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance. FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office. FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines. PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday! PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled. CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube ! Wellhub was named a Top Sales Team of 2025! This is a recognition of the collaboration and impact we create together every day. Ready to be part of a team that’s making a real difference? Read more about the award here. Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here. Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos. #LI-REMOTE

items.summary: Headquarters: CA - San Francisco HQ; CA-Remote Employee Applicant Privacy Notice Who we are: Shape a brighter financial future with us. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: CA - San Francisco HQ; CA-Remote Employee Applicant Privacy Notice Who we are: Shape a brighter financial future with us. Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance. We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world. The role: SoFi is seeking an energetic, organized, and resourceful Direct Mail Marketing Manager for a one-year contract to manage the end-to-end direct mail creative process for the SoFi Credit Card product, from strategy and planning through creative development, stakeholder review, approval, production, and tracking. This role will also analyze campaign performance and provide recommendations to optimize future direct mail strategies and creative. At SoFi, you’ll become part of a new kind of finance company whose ambition is to help our members achieve financial independence and reach their goals. We aim to be at the center of our members’ financial lives and help every member get their money right. We created student loan refinancing, addressing the biggest financial challenge of a new generation through a modern approach to lending and personal finance. Next, we expanded our products and services across loans, investing, and cash management. SoFi has achieved significant growth, with ambitious plans ahead, but to continue this growth, we need great talent. And that starts with you. What you’ll do: This role owns four core areas of responsibility: 1. Creative Strategy & Planning Lead end-to-end creative strategy and execution for Credit Card direct mail campaigns, partnering with Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to align initiatives with business goals, priorities, and growth objectives. Lead quarterly creative planning with the creative agency, using audience insights, customer behavior, performance data, and test-and-learn principles to develop strategic recommendations for the Product Marketing Manager. Lead upfront data and audience planning with DM Data Strategy, Marketing Data Science and agency team defining targeting, segmentation, personalization, measurement requirements, and data inputs that inform the creative strategy, testing plan, and campaign brief. Own the creative roadmap and partner with the creative agency to develop compelling messaging, visual storytelling, offers, personalization, branding, and calls to action. 2. Campaign & Production Management Serve as the day-to-day campaign lead and primary liaison among Product Marketing Manager, the creative and data strategy agency, DM Data Strategy, Marketing Data Science, other internal stakeholders, and print vendors. Serve as the lead DM representative in Credit Card business unit meetings, Marketing Data Science handoff meetings, and other recurring meetings. Prepare slides as needed, capture key decisions and action items, and distribute notes to appropriate stakeholders. Translate approved strategies into actionable campaign plans, creative briefs, testing plans, and production requirements. Manage monthly direct mail tests and creative variations, ensuring audience definitions, segmentation, data requirements, personalization, and creative variants are aligned and executable. Own campaign timelines and the shared production calendar, including data due dates, creative milestones, review rounds, release dates, print dates, and drop dates. Manage assets, versioning, production samples, dependencies, risks, and bottlenecks to ensure campaigns launch accurately and on time. Maintain the monthly campaign matrix, including audience targeting, creative variations, testing plans, data requirements, and other campaign details. Partner with Marketing Data Science to update campaign matrices and verify that targeting and personalization information is accurate before each drop. Lead weekly status meetings with Product Marketing Managers, including agenda development, stakeholder alignment, and action-item follow-up. 3. Compliance, Quality & Operations Lead the Compliance and Legal review process for direct mail materials, partnering with Product Marketing and the creative agency to ensure executions meet regulatory, disclosure, brand, and business requirements. Manage creative review and quality control across messaging, data, personalization, offers, URLs, disclosures, and final production files. Serve as the central point of accountability for ensuring every campaign is accurate, compliant, data-aligned, approved, and production-ready. Manage campaign production and postage costs, partnering with the DM billing team to keep campaigns within budget. 4. Performance, Insights & Competitive Intelligence Partner with Marketing Data Science, analytics, and the creative agency to evaluate campaign and creative test results against product and business goals. Translate audience, performance, and campaign data into actionable insights that inform creative recommendations, messaging, offers, personalization, segmentation, and future test strategies. Lead weekly Product Marketing Manager performance updates and monthly reporting, presenting results and optimization recommendations to Product Marketing and cross-functional stakeholders. Apply campaign learnings to improve future direct mail initiatives and inform the creative roadmap. Build and maintain a competitive direct mail library, monitoring competitor activity, creative trends, offers, formats, personalization, and audience strategies. Share monthly competitive and performance insights with the broader Marketing organization to inform future campaign and product marketing strategy. What you’ll need: Bachelor's degree with 4+ years of project management experience, preferably supporting direct mail or other marketing campaigns within financial services or another highly regulated industry. Experience partnering with cross-functional teams to execute complex, multi-channel campaigns and operational initiatives. Experience managing high-volume direct mail, CRM, lifecycle, or integrated marketing creative execution, ideally within financial services, credit cards, banking, or another highly regulated industry. Strong project and production management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, creative versions, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously. Highly proficient in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets, Docs, Slides, Gmail, and Calendar, Tableau, Snowflake; comfortable building and maintaining detailed trackers and production workflows. Strong understanding of creative development, production, version control, review/approval processes, and vendor management. Experience working directly with Legal, Compliance, Creative, Marketing, Analytics, Data, and external production vendors. Strong attention to detail and a high level of ownership, particularly when managing personalized credit card communications where small errors can have significant downstream impact. Comfortable working in a test-and-learn environment, using campaign performance data to inform future creative decisions. Excellent communication and organizational skills with the ability to keep senior stakeholders informed while driving day-to-day execution. Financial services or credit card marketing experience strongly preferred, particularly familiarity with regulated marketing, compliance reviews, disclosures, and credit-related communications. Compensation and Benefits The base pay range for this role is listed below. items.description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity: We’re looking for an enthusiastic, tech-forward product marketer to grow our Observability products by boldly positioning them and running campaigns to attract, convert and retain customers. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will be in charge of the messaging and positioning for a broad product area. Then you’ll work closely with product managers and the marketing team to deliver campaigns, content, events, and training that help buyers buy (and sellers sell) our value. Product Marketing lives within the Product org rather than the Marketing org at Grafana Labs, and we think differently about the job. Rather than purely executing launches or campaigns, we want PMMs to teach product managers and engineers in our org how to think about growth and demand, and to codify product marketing knowledge into AI-forward tools and processes that anyone in the organization can use. For example, we all contribute product information to a shared knowledge base, which we use to generate enablement materials and decks. Grafana Labs is a fast-paced and growing organization. As such, this role requires strategic skills, an interest in teaching, and hands-on tactical execution (blogs, webinar outlines, video scripts, etc). Our team is full of people who crave impact and independence - if you are seeking a role with narrow scope where you run a defined playbook, this is not the job for you. What You'll Be Doing: Actively partner with and teach product managers to define product value, messaging, and go-to-market strategy, from competitive positioning to sales enablement collateral. Partner with product management, engineering and various go-to-market functions to create materials that help customers evaluate and adopt our products: reference architectures, implementation guides, detailed product information and more. Own customer lifecycle campaigns (competitive positioning, retention, upsell/cross-sell) to strategically shape marketing programs and drive growth across the entire customer journey. Conduct market and customer research to understand pain points, competition and opportunities. Teach go-to-market and sales teams our products’ capabilities and the value they provide, deliver training and enablement, ensure customer facing teams are able to effectively engage with customers, partners, and prospects. What Makes You a Great Fit: 4+ years of relevant experience (product marketing, solutions marketing, product management) Experience with marketing and selling to a technical audience A passion for open source, cloud native, and infrastructure technologies Proven ability to take on complex projects and efficiently drive them from start to finish Ability to clearly articulate the value of technical products to customers and sellers alike Experience leading product or feature launches autonomously as well as part of a team Experience working with AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude to automate messaging and workflows Comfort working with a variety of internal and external stakeholders in complicated processes Strong product and technical curiosity that translate to clear packaging, positioning, and messaging Demonstrated quantitative analytical skills for analyzing campaign performance, evaluating lifecycle metrics, and making data-driven recommendations. Exceptional writing and communication skills A high “say-do” ratio in executing and delivering impact Compensation & Rewards: In Sweden, the base compensation range for this role is SEK 775,444 - SEK 930,533. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. #LI-Remote For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy .

Create and model realistic shopping scenarios that reflect authentic consumer behavior and decision-making processes. Collaborate with AI development teams to define data needs and optimize catalog structures for scalable AI training. Document workflows, taxonomies, and metadata structures with clear, concise written communication. Proficiency with SQL and NoSQL database concepts, schema design, and product data modeling. Strong command of product taxonomy development, categorization, and data normalization methods. Deep understanding of structured dataset management, including large and complex e-commerce catalogs. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes and communicate technical concepts clearly. Experience building data-driven shopping experiences and simulating consumer journeys. High attention to detail and a collaborative mindset for working with cross-functional teams. items.title: Market Curation Editor — Politics
items.summary: The Opportunity As a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch.
items.description: The Opportunity As a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch. An automated pipeline drafts candidate political prediction markets every day; you are the human judgment layer on top of it — deciding which go live, sharpening the ones that are nearly right, and catching the markets the pipeline missed entirely. This role calls for deep, current expertise in politics and elections, and in the conventions that govern how political outcomes are officially called and settled. What You'll Do Review a daily queue of system-generated political markets against a fixed completion deadline, working event by event across every market a political development generates. Assess each candidate market for factual accuracy, clarity, and whether the resolution criteria can actually be adjudicated against a named authoritative source (e.g., the AP, official state election boards, certified results) and a defined settlement date. Verify that open and close timing is correct for the underlying event, including scheduled and unscheduled delays — runoff elections, recounts, and certification delays. Apply the correct settlement convention for the type of political event in question — election calls and concession timing, recounts and certification, runoff triggers, ballot measure outcomes, legislative vote counts, and official statistical or vote-count corrections. Confirm policy fit against community standards and content guidelines, escalating anything ambiguous, contested, or politically sensitive rather than making an unsupported call. Approve, edit, or reject each candidate, recording a structured reason every time — this record is a product deliverable, not admin. Rewrite questions and resolution language for precision, and for how the public and press actually talk about the event. Author timestamped clarifications when ambiguity emerges in a live market, and resolve settlement exceptions the data feed can't handle — contested results, recounts, litigation. Run proactive gap scans — monitor live markets for visible errors, and track campaign schedules, polling releases, and political and press social media for events the pipeline didn't capture. Participate in weekly calibration reviews to stay consistent with published guidelines and fellow curators. What We're Looking For 3+ years in political trading or prediction markets, political data operations, political/data journalism or editorial, polling and election modeling, or a comparable role requiring current subject-matter expertise. Demonstrable current fluency in U.S. politics and elections — following it now, not historically — across federal, state, and major local races. Fluency with political media and political social media (campaign accounts, press pool reporting, breaking political news accounts). Working knowledge of official election administration and settlement conventions (certification timelines, recount thresholds, runoff triggers, Electoral College mechanics where relevant), and of which sources are authoritative for results and vote counts. Proven judgment on edge cases: contested results, recounts, litigation, ballot curing, ambiguous or delayed official calls. Ability to interpret official sources quickly and reach a defensible determination. Exceptional written precision under deadline — able to write unambiguous rules that hold up after the outcome is known. Comfort applying a written policy framework, with the instinct to escalate rather than guess — especially on politically sensitive or contested topics. Flexible availability for evening and weekend work around debates, primaries, and election nights. Nice to Have Direct experience trading on, or working with, political prediction markets or exchanges such as Kalshi or Polymarket. Background in polling and election modeling — for example, FiveThirtyEight during its ABC/ESPN era, Decision Desk HQ, VoteHub, or similar outlets; data-journalism experience of this kind, including at spinoffs such as Fifty Plus One, is also relevant. Prior work on a political trading desk, or standing as a super-user of political prediction apps. Political journalism background and/or experience contributing to guidelines, style guides, rulebooks, or annotation standards. Familiarity with content policy, moderation frameworks, or editorial standards, particularly around politically sensitive content. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote URL: http://wevote.us Help Shape How Millions of Voters Engage with Reliable Civic Information WeVote is a nonpartisan civic technology nonprofit dedicated to increasing voter participation through innovative digital tools and trusted voter education resources. As a Fast Forward nonprofit technology grantee, WeVote empowers voters with the information they need to make informed decisions and participate confidently in democracy. We are seeking a strategic and innovative Director of Content Strategy to lead the development and execution of WeVote's content vision across digital channels. This volunteer leadership role is ideal for an experienced content strategist, communications leader, digital marketer, or media professional who is passionate about civic engagement and audience growth. As Director of Content Strategy, you will define how WeVote communicates with voters, volunteers, supporters, and stakeholders through impactful content initiatives. You will oversee content planning, messaging strategy, editorial priorities, audience engagement efforts, and cross-functional collaboration to expand WeVote's reach and influence. What You'll Do Develop Content Strategy Create and lead a comprehensive content strategy that aligns with WeVote's mission, organizational goals, audience needs, and voter engagement objectives. Drive Audience Growth & Engagement Identify opportunities to expand audience reach, increase engagement, and strengthen relationships with voters, volunteers, donors, and supporters through strategic content initiatives. Lead Content Planning Oversee content roadmaps, editorial calendars, and campaign planning across blogs, newsletters, voter education resources, thought leadership content, and digital communications. Shape Organizational Messaging Develop messaging frameworks and content guidelines that ensure consistency across all channels while reinforcing WeVote's nonpartisan mission and brand voice. Collaborate Across Teams Partner with leaders across Product, Political Data, Communications, Marketing, Partnerships, and Volunteer Recruitment to identify content opportunities and align messaging efforts. Analyze Content Performance Monitor content effectiveness, audience behavior, engagement metrics, and communication trends to continuously improve content strategy and impact. Lead Content Contributors Provide strategic guidance and leadership to volunteer writers, editors, researchers, content creators, and communications team members. Support Thought Leadership Initiatives Help position WeVote as a trusted leader in civic technology, voter education, and democratic participation through compelling storytelling and content innovation. What We're Looking For Content Strategy Experience 3+ years of experience in content strategy, communications, digital marketing, content leadership, audience development, media, publishing, or related fields. Strategic Thinking Demonstrated ability to create and execute content strategies that drive awareness, engagement, audience growth, and organizational impact. Audience & Engagement Expertise Experience understanding audience needs, developing content journeys, and optimizing content performance across digital channels. Strong Communication Skills Exceptional writing, editing, messaging, and storytelling abilities with the ability to translate complex topics into clear, accessible content. Data-Informed Decision Making Comfortable using content analytics, engagement insights, and performance metrics to guide strategic decisions. Cross-Functional Leadership Experience collaborating with diverse stakeholders and managing projects across multiple teams and initiatives. Mission Alignment Passion for democracy, civic engagement, voter education, and leveraging content to create meaningful social impact. Self-Starter Mentality Ability to thrive in a remote, volunteer-driven environment while independently driving strategic initiatives forward. Why Join WeVote? Help shape how millions of voters access and engage with trusted civic information. Lead content strategy for a nationally recognized civic technology nonprofit. Build executive-level experience in digital strategy, communications, and audience development. Collaborate with mission-driven professionals in technology, media, civic engagement, and nonprofit leadership. Make a measurable impact on voter participation and democratic engagement. Position Details Location: Remote (U.S.-based volunteers preferred) Time Commitment: Approximately 5–10 hours per week Compensation: Volunteer Position * Fraud and phishing warning * Please apply directly via our volunteering portal/ATS at https://wevote.applytojob.com/apply. Do not apply via any other job portals, aggregators, or sites, as your information may not be secure, or the role may no longer be accepting applications. Thank you!! items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote Why join us Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek. Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career. Marketing at Brex Marketing tells the story of Brex to the world. From acquisition to activation, we translate product value into business results. Our team spans Revenue, Product, and Brand Marketing, and works closely with nearly every function at Brex. We move fast, experiment often, and think deeply about customer behavior. If you want your creativity to drive growth and shape perception, this is the place. What You'll Do As a Field Marketing Coordinator, Upmarket, you'll play an important role in helping Brex scale regional marketing programs that drive pipeline generation, accelerate opportunities, and strengthen relationships with senior finance, accounting, and procurement leaders across Enterprise and Mid-Market organizations. Reporting directly to the Field Marketing Lead, Upmarket, you'll support a diverse portfolio of revenue-driving initiatives, including executive experiences, regional events, account-based marketing (ABM), and digital campaigns. You'll take ownership of day-to-day program execution and operational coordination, working closely with Sales, Marketing, and cross-functional partners to bring programs to life. Your work will help expand our regional presence, improve program efficiency, and ensure consistent Sales activation before, during, and after each program. The ideal candidate is a proactive, highly organized marketer who thrives in a fast-paced environment, builds strong relationships with Sales, and understands how thoughtful execution drives business growth. You’ll bring attention to detail, creative problem-solving skills, and the ability to balance multiple projects and competing priorities while delivering high-quality work. Where you'll work This role will be fully remote and based in the United States. Responsibilities Own day-to-day planning and execution for Upmarket field marketing programs, including executive experiences, regional dinners, sporting events, and digital activations. Coordinate event logistics, including venue sourcing, vendor management, catering, gifting, shipping, registration, attendee communications, budgets, and onsite execution. Develop and maintain event timelines, registration pages, attendee trackers, run-of-show documents, and internal event briefs. Partner with AEs, SDRs, and Sales leadership to support account targeting, prospect outreach, attendee engagement, and pre- and post-event follow-up. Execute smaller, repeatable regional programs and sales-led experiences that strengthen customer relationships, support multi-threading, and accelerate pipeline. Support integrated digital marketing campaigns across email and paid media, coordinating audience lists, creative assets, landing pages, campaign launches, and performance tracking. Coordinate ABM and direct-mail campaigns, including prospect targeting, vendor management, gifting, fulfillment, and delivery tracking. Maintain the Field Marketing events calendar, campaign documentation, and performance reporting across Salesforce, registration platforms, and marketing automation tools, tracking meetings generated, qualified pipeline, and pipeline influence. Requirements 2+ years of experience in field marketing, event marketing, demand generation, project management or a related role. Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally. Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership of day-to-day execution with minimal supervision. Ability to adapt to changing priorities, solve problems quickly, and maintain high-quality execution under tight deadlines. Ability to travel up to 40% of the time to support regional events and onsite execution. What Success Looks Like Seamless program execution: Deliver high-quality field events and integrated campaigns on time, within budget, and with minimal operational friction. Increased program capacity and efficiency: Expand the team's ability to execute more regional and digital programs through repeatable processes, automation, and streamlined workflows. Stronger Sales activation: Improve the consistency and timeliness of prospect outreach, attendee engagement, and post-event follow-up. Measurable business impact: Support programs that generate qualified pipeline, strengthen customer relationships, and accelerate revenue opportunities. Compensation The expected salary range for this role is $73,600 - $105,800. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package. Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/brex-field-marketing-coordinator-upmarket

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, Germany Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team: Celonis grew up with the private sector: Deutsche Telekom, Mercedes-Benz, Uniper and three quarters of the DAX companies rely on Celonis Process Intelligence. Now we are taking the next big step in Germany: scaling our business with the public sector. To make this happen, Celonis is investing heavily through 2029 in its German public sector business. Over the past year, we have built our Public Sector team from the ground up. Today, a strong go-to-market core team of Account Executives and Value Engineers is in place, working with federal and state-level institutions. The police are one of our primary target organizations in the public sector. Police officers spend a large proportion of their time on data work and comparatively little on the actual investigation. We want to turn that around. With our new police solution, Metropolis, we help police authorities connect and make sense of their data, so that officers can focus on what matters most: solving cases and keeping people safe . To address this, we are now complementing our existing Public Sector team with a highly specialized Account Executive who brings first-hand experience from inside the organization we serve: the Police . The Role: This is not a typical Account Executive role. You bring the perspective of someone who knows police work from the inside: how investigations really run, where time is lost in data work, and how decisions are made and budgets are approved. You will use this credibility to build trusted relationships with police authorities at federal and state level and position Celonis as a long-term partner for their digital transformation. Working closely with our Public Sector AEs, Value Engineers and product experts, you will translate the operational reality of police work into compelling use cases, contribute to the creation of solution blueprints, drive opportunities from first conversation to signed contract, and help shape how Celonis enters and grows in this market. The Work you'll do: Build and own relationships with police authorities at federal and state level, e.g. Bundespolizei, Bundeskriminalamt (BKA), Landeskriminalämter (LKA), Landespolizeien and the responsible Interior Ministries . Engage with decision-makers from police leadership, investigation units, IT and digitalization departments, and procurement Translate investigators' daily challenges into concrete, AI-enabled use cases for Celonis and Metropolis, with measurable impact (e.g. time saved per case, faster case processing). Bring the voice of the police into Celonis: share insights with our product, marketing and value engineering teams to sharpen our offering. Own an individual revenue target and drive complex, long sales cycles to a successful close. Navigate public procurement and tender processes (e.g. VgV, VSVgV, UVgO, framework agreements) together with our partners and internal experts. Work closely with partners such as consulting firms, system integrators and public IT service providers. Represent Celonis at public sector events, conferences and police-specific forums. The qualifications you need: Several years of professional experience within the German police (federal or state level), ideally in a leadership role and/or in an area close to investigations, criminal analysis, IT, digitalization or organizational development. A solid network within the police landscape and a deep understanding of how police authorities and Interior Ministries are organized, how decisions are made and how budgets are planned. First-hand understanding of the data challenges in police work, e.g. case management, evidence and data analysis, and cross-agency information sharing. A strong interest in moving into a commercial, customer-facing role. Prior experience in sales, business development or consulting is a plus, but not a must. We will support your onboarding into the sales role. Strong affinity for technology, data and AI, and the ability to explain complex topics in a simple and convincing way. Degree in Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program Grit, a hands-on mindset, and the drive to build something new. Excellent communication and presentation skills in German (native or fluent) and very good English. Familiarity with public procurement processes is a strong plus. Willingness and eligibility to undergo a security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung) if required by our customers. Ability to adapt to a fast-moving, high-growth environment and approach challenges with positivity, creative thinking and a growth mindset. Willingness to be collaborative and inclusive, to embrace diversity, and strong interpersonal skills #differentmakesusbetter Ability to leverage internal resources and work as a team #bestteamwins #LI-SS6 What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. About Us: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video . Celonis Inclusion Statement: At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. Your Privacy: Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process . Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations. The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it. Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/celonis-account-executive-public-sector-germany-police-polizei

If you love bringing order to a busy environment, have a sharp eye for detail and are curious about the creative side of marketing, this role is a great place to grow. Responsibilities Task & Pipeline Management Turn monthly creative requests (videos, images and ad copy) into clear, well-structured tasks in ClickUp (our project management system). launched and reviewed Quality Control Review final images, videos and ad copy before launch against briefs, client guidelines and technical specifications Catch typos, formatting errors and visual glitches before assets go live Develop an eye for visual inconsistencies, such as AI-generated artifacts, distorted details or elements that don’t make sense in context Collaborate with team members on final reviews and approvals Reporting & Documentation Maintain structured logs of what is live, what is in testing and what has been learned Prepare clear status updates and reports using automated data and AI tools Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards Process Improvement & AI Identify repetitive work and use AI tools and automations to streamline the workflow Help scale the pipeline to handle 100–350 tasks per month without losing accuracy Suggest improvements to task structure, templates and handoff processes Creative Collaboration Take part in team brainstorming Job Role: SEO / AEO Manager Job Type: Contract - USA Job Description About This Role Bounteous is leading the charge in dynamic digital experiences and is looking for forward-thinking search experts to help drive measurable impact for some of the world's most recognizable and ambitious brands. In today's AI-driven, zero-click search landscape, our approach helps brands envision, harness, and enable their digital presence across traditional search engines, AI-powered discovery platforms, and emerging search experiences. We are seeking a SEO / AEO Manager to lead holistic search strategy across our client portfolio, spanning traditional SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), and AI search visibility across platforms including Google AI Overviews/AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Copilot. This individual will drive performance across traditional SEO, AEO, and AI-powered search experiences. The ideal candidate understands how search has evolved beyond rankings- into entities, AI Overviews, generative search, and full-SERP ownership, and can translate that evolution into business growth. The ideal candidate has already built or scaled an AI-search-visibility practice, not just a traditional SEO program with AI terminology added on top. This contractor will work cross-functionally with internal teams and client stakeholders to develop and execute advanced search strategies that drive visibility, authority, and measurable ROI, defined jointly with each client at engagement kickoff (see Success Metrics below). Role & Responsibilities As the SEO & AEO Manager, you will lead strategic search initiatives across enterprise client accounts, driving business growth and client success as a key member of our search practice. You will own strategy development, execution oversight, and performance measurement across traditional SEO and AI-driven search ecosystems. Â Key Responsibilities Search & AEO Strategy Leadership Lead holistic search strategy development, including traditional SEO, AEO, and AI search optimization, to drive full-funnel growth. items.description: Are you ready to own something big? Automox is turning IT admins into IT heroes by replacing traditional tools with our award winning cloud-native endpoint management platform. Our product works autonomously and so do our teams. We value a ‘one team’ mentality where everyone’s unique skills contribute to an environment that encourages collaboration and ownership. At Automox you’re enabled to do your best work, grow your career, and have an impact that will be noticeable. WE ARE A_TOMOX… all that’s missing is U! Our Customer Experience team doesn’t wait for the renewal conversation to prove value. We’re searching for a strategic, action-oriented Director of Customer Adoption & Digital Success who’s excited to build the programs that get every Automox customer to realize value at scale. You’ll own the lifecycle automation, customer education, in-product guidance and 1:many engagements that reach every customer, from small businesses to our largest enterprise accounts. This is a strategic builder role reporting to the VP of Customer Experience. You’ll arrive with a point of view, experiment quickly, and improve with data. You’ll work closely with Account Management, Customer Success, Support, Professional Services, Product and Marketing to turn adoption into stronger retention. WHAT YOU’LL OWN & DRIVE Define the adoption model for each customer segment, including what is automated, what is 1:many, and where human touch matters most. Build and run lifecycle journeys at scale for onboarding, adoption milestones and pre-renewal sentiment using data-driven triggers for risk, low deployment and expansion. Partner with Ops to enhance our customer success platform, health scoring, journey orchestration and dashboards. Partner with Marketing to develop and execute customer campaigns that drive product adoption, engagement, retention, and expansion opportunities. Lead the strategy for Automox University (our on-demand training platform for users), customer workshops and in-product guidance, partnering with Product and Growth to improve education directly in the product. Lead the strategy for Automox’s knowledge management and AI-powered self-service support experience called Patch AI. Own roadmap planning of customer engagements (webinars, office hours, campaigns and communication). Lead the pooled digital customer success motion for our digital customer segment. Run the NPS program, routing voice of the customer themes to executive leadership. Measure the effectiveness of customer engagement initiatives, continuously optimizing campaigns to improve adoption, customer health, and retention. Lead and grow a team covering customer enablement, education and digital customer success. WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE 8+ years in customer success, digital success or customer marketing at a B2B SaaS company, including 3+ years leading teams. A track record of building a scaled or digital customer success program from an early stage, not only running an existing one. Hands-on experience with a customer success platform (Gainsight, ChurnZero, Planhat, Vitally or similar) and journey automation. Strong data skills: health scores, cohort analysis, and tying programs to gross and net dollar retention. Experience partnering with Product on onboarding, in-app guidance or customer education. Clear writing and the ability to turn a strategy into a plan with owners, dates and metrics. A bias to action, driving impactful work forward quickly. The ability to build strong partnerships with Sales, Marketing and Product. NICE TO HAVE Experience with IT, security or infrastructure software sold to technical buyers. Background with in-product guidance tools such as Chameleon, Pendo or Appcues, and customer education platforms. Experience applying AI to customer engagement or self-service support. A background in IT operations, endpoint management or security, such as patching and vulnerability response. The range listed is the on target earning (OTE) potential. OTE is a mix of base pay and variable pay earned based on meeting sale's goals. In addition to OTE our compensation package includes equity and variety of great benefits. Actual earnings may be less or more depending on a candidate's direct experience, skills, industry knowledge, and location. Details of the OTE split will be shared during the interview process. Sales OTE range $195,000—$225,000 USD LOCATION We are a fully distributed company of remote employees. ***Note: We currently don't hire in California or New York metro*** ABOUT AUTOMOX Automox is the cloud-native IT operations platform for modern organizations. Our award-winning answer to modern IT operations and best-in-class results earned Automox four straight quarters of record growth. We are now trusted by more than 2,500 leading companies and MSPs worldwide, including NASA, Yale, Xerox, Allbirds, and Unicef. It makes it easy to keep every endpoint automatically configured, patched, and secured – anywhere in the world. The future of IT Operations is cloud-native – and right now. Will you join us? EMPLOYMENT AT AUTOMOX ✅ Must be able to pass a federal, state, county background check ✅ Complete a local in-person verification TOTAL REWARDS: Thrive with Us 💵Competitive Salary 📈Equity for Full-Time Employees 🏦 401K Match 🏝Flexible PTO, generous sick time policy Health & Wellness 🩺 Comprehensive Health Plans with generous employer contributions 🩺100% Company-paid Short Term/Long Term Disability and Life Insurance 🩺 Company HSA Contribution: $100-$200 per month based on tier Happiness & Well-Being 🎁 $25 per month Lifestyle Spending Account 💻 Internet Reimbursement - $50/month 🗄 $500 Home office stipend 👨‍👧‍👦 $10k Adoption Benefit 🤰🏽Comprehensive Family Planning Covered on Meritian Medical Plan We are committed to an inclusive and diverse company. Automox is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any legally protected status. We are not able to sponsor work visas at this time.

items.title: Liquidity Operations Analyst
items.summary: Work with the best We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms.
items.description: Work with the best We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms. We are not satisfied with the limitations of centralized exchanges or the complexities of building decentralized order books. We aim to make trading easy, fast, and secure for everyone. How? By fusing the simplicity of CeFi with the power of DeFi. At the heart of the issue lies “liquidity”. Builders often grapple with a paradox; traders need liquidity, but liquidity demands traders. Our solution is simple as is bold –concentrate all liquidity into one order book. One order book that connects all the liquidity in the crypto space. Our ambition doesn't stop there. We're omnichain, championing chain abstraction. We envision seamless transactions, where the underlying blockchain is merely a detail. By concentrating liquidity, we aim to redefine the crypto landscape, making bridging and wrapped assets a thing of the past. We are Orderly, and we are here to revolutionize DeFi, democratizing access to financial opportunities and fostering a fair, equitable paradigm for all. A Glimpse into Your Future at Orderly Network What will you be working on? Process, clean, and validate liquidity and trading data to ensure accuracy and usability. Extract and transform trading data to generate regular reports (weekly/monthly) and support alerting mechanisms. Monitor liquidity dashboards and identify anomalies in a timely manner. Maintain and update market parameter configuration tables. Support market maker onboarding and assist with incentive distribution processes. Participate in data analysis for liquidity mechanism design and assist in testing new incentive models. Who will you be working with? Work closely with the liquidity operations team on daily monitoring and execution. Collaborate with product, trading, and data teams to ensure data accuracy and operational efficiency. Support coordination with market makers during onboarding and ongoing operations. What challenges will you face? Handling large volumes of trading data with high accuracy requirements. Identifying anomalies and ensuring data quality in a fast-moving trading environment. Balancing data processing, monitoring, and operational support tasks simultaneously. Adapting quickly to evolving liquidity strategies and incentive mechanisms. Interested in Learning More? Our hiring process begins by meeting with our People Team, who help facilitate the process of placing you in your new role. You can expect to share your experience and ideas in online video interviews with our hiring team, made up of management and potential new colleagues. If you have experience in developing trading systems or financial-related products is a plus. You can prepare for this interview by mentally organizing your strategies and opinions on topics such as Web3, cryptocurrency trading platforms, and your vision of how to succeed. Share this! Don’t be afraid of friends or co-workers stealing this job! If you are amazing and smart we will find a place for you. Check out our External Referral Incentives Program as well. items.description: Product Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, US; Remote, US About Pinterest: Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product. Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible. At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI. Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here . The Team Pinterest's Infrastructure organization builds and operates the platforms that every engineer at Pinterest uses to build, test, ship and run software. Our CI and deployment platforms handle the journey of every change from commit to production. We're investing heavily in making that journey faster, more efficient and safe by default, especially as AI-assisted development sharply increases how much we ship. We work closely with engineering teams across Pinterest to make sure the platform scales with the business. What You'll Do Lead cross-team programs that make production changes safe by default, driving adoption of progressive rollouts, automated canary analysis and fast rollback across code, config, data and ML model deployments. Drive the CI platform roadmap to reduce build cost and wait times, improve fleet utilization and migrate CI workloads to our next-generation compute platform. Define and track the delivery and reliability metrics that measure success, such as change failure rate, recovery time, lead time for change and build performance, and build dashboards that surface regressions early. Manage dependencies and migrations across CI, artifact, deployment and compute platforms and the many service teams that depend on them. Influence engineering teams across Pinterest to adopt new standards and paved paths, managing timelines, pushback and risk. Communicate technical tradeoffs among velocity, safety, cost and reliability clearly to audiences from individual engineers to senior leadership. Use GenAI as the default operating model for program execution: produce AI-assisted first drafts of core program artifacts, turn high-toil workflows into AI-first mechanisms (for example, intake triage, status synthesis, action and decision extraction, and risk and dependency tracking), and synthesize signals to surface risks, tradeoffs and escalation paths early. Prototype solutions that improve decisions with data (dashboards, analysis) or simplify processes (workflow helpers, internal tools) using AI coding assistants ("vibe coding"). Follow Pinterest AI guidance for risk, governance and safety by design: handle sensitive data appropriately, validate AI-generated outputs, document assumptions and limits, and make sure AI-assisted workflows meet policy and compliance expectations before broad adoption. What We're Looking For 5+ years of TPM experience leading complex, cross-functional technical programs in infrastructure, platform engineering, developer productivity or SRE. A solid understanding of CI/CD systems, build infrastructure and safe-deployment practices (canaries, progressive delivery, automated rollback), and the tradeoffs between velocity and safety. A track record of driving platform or standards adoption across many engineering teams without direct authority. Strong analytical skills, with experience defining delivery and reliability metrics (for example, DORA metrics) and using data to drive decisions. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including giving clear, candid status and risk updates to senior leadership. Comfort with ambiguity: you can take a broad mandate, define the plan and measures of success, and drive it to outcomes. Experience with infrastructure efficiency, compute cost or capacity planning is a plus. Workflow design, AI fluency, and a data-and-insights orientation: experience turning repeatable program work into durable, low-toil mechanisms and improving decisions using GenAI (for example, strong prompting, vibe coding lightweight scripts or tools, dashboards, data analysis and using agents where appropriate). Safety-by-design AI fluency: experience operating within AI governance expectations (risk assessment, data handling, output validation, auditability) and recognizing where AI use isn't appropriate or needs extra controls. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field or equivalent experience. Join us and help shape the future of Pinterest's infrastructure! Relocation Statement: This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model. In-Office Requirement Statement: We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role. This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times every 6 months and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country #LI-REMOTE At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise. Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here . US based applicants only $123,684 — $254,644 USD Our Commitment to Inclusion: Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines URL: https://www.catonetworks.com Cato Networks is the converged network and security cloud for the AI era. As AI reshapes cybersecurity, enterprises face a dual challenge: unlocking AI’s potential while defending against AI-driven attacks. Cato addresses both through a unified, cloud-native platform, providing the visibility and context to prioritize risks and stop threats in real time across users, applications, data, and AI agents. Join us as we scale: take on ambitious technological challenges and shape the next generation of enterprise security at a company trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide. Cato Networks is seeking a NOC Engineer to join the team. In this critical role, you will be monitoring, supporting, and providing advanced troubleshooting of a large complex data network infrastructure by using network monitoring and management tools. You will work closely with teams from our business areas, network engineering, and management as a team representative on major incident bridges. This is a remote position based in the Philippines. Key Responsibilities Own and manage the uptime, stability, and overall functionality of the company’s production systems. This includes troubleshooting and resolving system and network issues end-to-end. Monitor and respond to NetOps alerts during working hours, and review/follow up on alerts triggered outside business hours as required. Continuously track and analyze system performance to identify risks, bottlenecks, capacity constraints, and opportunities for optimization. Proactively mitigate outages and system malfunctions to prevent customer impact. When necessary, prepare clear and prioritized escalations to the relevant Development teams. Coordinate with third-party service providers (e.g., carriers, SMS providers, IX providers, and other vendors) to resolve network and system-related issues. Provide advanced (higher-tier) technical support to internal Customer Support teams (T1–T3). Design, implement, and maintain dashboards and alerting mechanisms to ensure system visibility and operational awareness. Serve as a technical focal point for Customer Support and Field Engineering teams by understanding business use cases and translating them into operational requirements. Contribute to building, improving, and expanding NetOps ownership, processes, documentation, and operational best practices. Role Scope The role is primarily driven by automated system alerts requiring investigation, troubleshooting, and escalation when necessary. The role also involves handling customer-impacting issues escalated by the Customer Support organization. In addition to reactive tasks, the position includes ongoing projects and operational initiatives to be managed during working hours. Required Skills & Experience Strong experience in network architecture, cloud architecture, and security architecture. Deep knowledge of TCP/IP networking, routing, firewalls, proxy servers, and related technologies. Strong ability to analyze system and application logs to identify root causes of issues. Advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose complex network and system incidents. Experience working in a Cloud or SaaS technology environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document findings and communicate with cross-functional teams. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple concurrent projects and incidents simultaneously. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/cato-networks-noc-engineer
