This role will be responsible for managing the systems, processes, and governance that power our partner marketing progr
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote USA Sumo Logic is seeking a highly organized, analytical, and process-driven Partner Marketing Program Manager to support the growth and operational effectiveness of our global partner marketing organization. This role will be responsible for managing the systems, processes, and governance that power our partner marketing programs, with a primary focus on our Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platform, Market Development Funds (MDF), partner program operations, and performance reporting. The ideal candidate brings experience in B2B technology channel marketing, understands the complexities of working with MSSPs, VARs, and distributors, and thrives on building scalable processes that improve efficiency, accountability, and business impact. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex programs, improving operational workflows, and enabling regional teams and partners to execute successfully. What Success Looks Like In this role, success means: Establishing a reliable, well-managed PRM platform that supports global partner marketing needs. Improving partner and internal team adoption of Impartner. Implementing consistent MDF governance, approval processes, and financial tracking. Providing accurate, timely visibility into MDF spending, utilization, and program performance. Reducing manual processes and administrative delays across partner marketing operations. Improving partner accountability and reporting of marketing-generated opportunities and pipeline. Enabling regional marketing teams to execute programs efficiently through standardized tools and processes. Building scalable operational foundations that support Sumo Logic’s growing global partner ecosystem. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in B2B technology marketing, partner marketing, channel operations, or marketing program management. Hands-on experience working with Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platforms, preferably Impartner. Demonstrated experience managing MDF programs, including funding requests, approvals, budget tracking, governance, and reporting. Understanding of MSSP, VAR, and distributor (DISTI) partner ecosystems. Experience managing program budgets, financial tracking, and reconciliation processes. Strong understanding of channel marketing operations and partner program workflows. Experience with Salesforce and familiarity with marketing automation platforms. Strong analytical skills and experience developing dashboards, reports, and performance metrics. Excellent organizational, project management, and process improvement skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and coordinate stakeholders across global teams. Strong attention to detail, financial accuracy, and operational accountability. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work independently and proactively identify opportunities for improvement. Preferred Qualifications Direct experience administering Impartner, including MDF workflows and partner portal management. Experience developing or implementing MDF governance frameworks and standardized approval processes. Experience supporting global partner marketing programs across North America, EMEA, and APJ. Familiarity with two-tier distribution models and partner marketing programs involving MSPs, MSSPs, VARs, and distributors. Experience with Salesforce reporting, partner attribution, and pipeline tracking. Experience supporting PRM integrations, workflow automation, and data quality initiatives. Background in cybersecurity, SaaS, cloud, observability, or enterprise technology. Experience developing partner enablement materials and training programs. About Us Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com. Sumo Logic Privacy Policy . Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection. The expected annual base salary range for this position is $130,000. Compensation varies based on a variety of factors which include (but aren’t limited to) role level, skills and competencies, qualifications, knowledge, location, and experience. In addition to base pay, certain roles are eligible to participate in our bonus or commission plans and equity awards. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, and paid time off. This position will remain open until filled; there is no application deadline. To be considered, please submit your application. Must be authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and for the duration of employment. At this time, we are not able to offer new non-immigrant visa sponsorship or OPT hiring for this position. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sumo-logic-partner-marketing-program-manager

items.summary: Headquarters: Remote, UK Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, UK Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com . We are looking for a Leader to lead the EMEA small to medium and Mid market team and is based remotely in the UK. The Role This role leads the EMEA Small to medium and MidMarket business team and is accountable for new logo acquisition and expansion revenue across the region. The expectations are high: a team that generates its own pipeline across multiple countries, deals that are qualified with discipline, forecasts that hold, and Account Executives who improve every quarter. This is not an oversight role. The leader in this seat works deals alongside their team, sets the standard for outbound execution in each market, and uses data to drive performance. It is a first-line leader role who has already delivered results in EMEA and wants to operate at the pace and scale of a fast-growing company. Responsibilities Deal leadership Engage directly in the team's most important opportunities: discovery, executive alignment, mutual close plans, commercial structure, procurement, legal, DPA, and security review. Set the standard for value-based selling: quantifying the customer's business pain, building the business case, and tying Bitwarden to risk reduction and compliance outcomes that drive European buying decisions (GDPR, NIS2, DORA, ISO 27001). Diagnose and unblock stalled deals, and use them to raise the skill level of the entire team. Coach disciplined excellence and field skills to find, transition and close deals efficiently. Work tirelessly in the detail of each customer requirement, enabled by experience and strategic effort, placing Bitwarden in the best position possible to win deals and transfer this knowledge to the team. Drive accountability through metrics, motivation, method and effective communication techniques. Be accountable, methodical, pragmatic and foster by example lead from the front. Outbound pipeline generation Build and mature a repeatable cold outbound motion with AEs and partnered SDRs, localized by market: territory and account prioritization, ICP and persona targeting, multi-threaded sequencing, and messaging adapted for country and language. Set activity and pipeline-generation standards, inspect them weekly, and hold every AE accountable for self-sourced pipeline. Align and drive our message with Marketing, Sales Development, and Channel on programs, including partner-sourced plays, that produce qualified pipeline at a predictable rate. MEDDPICC and value-based execution Run MEDDPICC as the team's operating system across qualification, deal reviews, forecast calls, and win/loss analysis, with value-based selling defining how the team earns and proves each element. Inspect every material opportunity for quantified Metrics, a validated Economic Buyer, a tested Champion, clear Decision Criteria and Process, a mapped Paper Process (including works council, procurement, and data-protection steps), and an honest read on Competition. Deliver an accurate weekly forecast built on deal evidence and maintain CRM data the business can rely on. Data-driven coaching Own the team's KPIs (pipeline generation, coverage, stage conversion, win rate, cycle length, average deal size, and activity-to-outcome ratios) by rep and by market, and act on what they show. Identify where each AE is losing ground and build targeted coaching plans to close the gap. Run a disciplined operating cadence across time zones: weekly 1:1s, pipeline and deal reviews, forecast calls, and call reviews. Team building Recruit, hire, onboard, and ramp high-caliber Account Executives across EMEA markets, and develop them toward promotion. Build a culture of accountability, competitiveness, and continuous improvement across countries and cultures. Work across Sales Operations, Sales Enablement, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Channel, and Marketing, to deliver revenue as one team. Requirements 3–5 years of first-line sales leadership in EMEA, ideally leading AEs selling security SaaS (identity, access, credential, endpoint, or adjacent categories). A proven, documented track record of quota attainment as a leader, and as an individual contributor before that. Deep working fluency in MEDDPICC and value-based selling, applied together to qualify, inspect, forecast, and coach. A track record of building and maturing a cold outbound pipeline across more than one EMEA market, with the ability to explain exactly how it was done and what it produced. Strong analytical skills, including fluency with Hubspot & industry tooling for reporting, dashboards, and spreadsheets, and a record of using KPIs to direct coaching and improve AE performance. A hands-on approach to leadership, with direct, regular involvement in live deals. Player-coach, building own pipeline coaching the team through example, including closing and processing, customer excellence. Strong intellect, a fast learning curve, and the drive to perform in a high-growth environment with demanding targets. Strong command of EMEA buying dynamics, procurement processes, regulatory drivers, and channel/partner models. Fluent business English. (Additional languages are beneficial considering the role supports all of EMEA e.g., German, French, Dutch, etc.) A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone––from our friends and family to the world’s largest organisations. Become an expert in a growing market. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. Learn and grow professionally. Embrace the opportunity to build up your demand generation and product-led growth expertise in a fast-growing startup. We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bitwarden-mid-market-sales-leader-emea

Still here? Keep reading. We're Wealth Without Wall Street. We teach business owners, professionals and families how to build real wealth without handing their future to some stranger in a Manhattan high-rise. Our mission is to help over 1 million people create financial freedom. The equation for us is simple: the day your passive income exceeds your monthly expenses, that is the day you're financially free and that is what we help people achieve. The movement is growing faster than we can handle. That's why we are writing this. We are looking for ONE Sales Manager. But not the kind you're picturing. No dashboard-hiders. No "Q3 alignment" types. We want a player-coach. A killer with a headset who can master our system in weeks, close deals from the front lines, and set a pace that makes the rest of the team stand up straighter. Then you get the keys. You hire your team. You train them in your image. You build something that didn't exist before you got here. That's not a department. That's a legacy. This is not a coast job. Not a "circle back Tuesday" job. Not a place where mediocrity gets another quarter to figure itself out. If your pulse picked up while reading this, prove it. Don't send us a resume that reads like a LinkedIn obituary. Tell us what you've closed. Tell us what you've built. Tell us why you're the one. What You’ll Do: Phase 1 – Master the Machine Learn our scripts, CRM, and booking process Sharpen your sales skills and start closing deals Audit our current system and identify areas for improvement Work with our existing team to increase their output Phase 2 – Scale the Team Continue to recruit insurance agents and closers for our coaching offer Continue to recruit and add to your SDR Team Lead 1:1 coaching, daily huddles, live sales reviews, and performance tracking Build sales culture and help the team hit their stride fast Work with leadership on onboarding, training systems, and KPIs Phase 3 – Own the Department Drive the department’s revenue, recruiting, and team performance Collaborate with execs to scale campaigns and comp plans Develop internal leaders and create strong bench strength under you You're the kind of person who doesn’t wait for direction — you take it and run. You’ll crush this role if you: Have 3–5+ years in sales, including 1–2 years leading high-performing teams Have managed a sales team of 20+ people You are tech savvy You understand and are proficient with pipeline management Have built, hired, or scaled a sales team before Are a strong closer with deep understanding of sales psychology Know how to motivate, coach, and hold others accountable to results Want ownership, not micromanagement Have a track record of driving numbers into the green and scaling sales systems Are obsessed with growth — both personally and professionally Want to build something long-term with real legacy potential KPI Ownership: 400+ Appointments Set / Month 250+ Appointments Held / Month 100+ Applications / Month $1M+ in Funded Policies / Month Reps onboarded and fully ramped within 30 days We believe in building something bigger than ourselves — and taking care of the people who help us do it. What You’ll Get: Compensation: Compensation: Base of $5,000 - $10,000+ Per Month to Start Based on Experience, Past Results & Tenure Up to $12,000/month in bonus potential for Funded Policies 3% revenue share on Lab division which is our coaching business Leadership Opportunity: Real decision-making power — not just managing, but building Direct collaboration with founders and execs A voice in compensation, culture, and long-term strategy Team & Culture: Join a mission-driven team that cares deeply about freedom A high-performance culture built on accountability and growth Systems and support to help you win Long-Term Potential: Opportunity to build your own division within the company Create systems, culture, and success that outlast you Mentorship from 7- and 8-figure business builders To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wealth-without-wallstreet-sales-manager

items.description: About Us Our leading SaaS-based Global Employment Platform™ enables clients to expand into over 180 countries quickly and efficiently, without the complexities of establishing local entities. At G-P, we’re dedicated to breaking down barriers to global business and creating opportunities for everyone, everywhere. Our diverse, remote-first teams are essential to our success. We empower our Dream Team members with flexibility and resources, fostering an environment where innovation thrives and every contribution is valued and celebrated. The work you do here will positively impact lives around the world. We stand by our promise: Opportunity Made Possible. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, we invite you to join us in expanding your skills and helping to reshape the future of work. At G-P, we assist organizations in building exceptional global teams in days, not months—streamlining the hiring, onboarding, and management process to unlock growth potential for all. About this Position As a Sr. Technical Program Manager - Information Security , you will drive the development and execution of our security programs to protect our organization and its customers. You’ll work closely with a variety of teams to ensure security is a core component of all our processes. Your main focus will be on defining, managing, and improving security initiatives from conception to completion, while providing critical visibility into delivery performance for executive leadership. What you will do: Lead Security Programs: Develop, manage, and execute end-to-end security programs that align with organizational goals and industry best practices. Engage and Influence Technical Stakeholders: Partner closely with engineering, IT, legal, and other cross-functional teams to integrate security requirements into business processes. Communicate regularly and effectively with technical leaders to align on security inputs, resolve dependencies, and identify key areas for ongoing collaboration. Executive Communication & Materials: Leverage exceptional written and verbal communication skills to produce high-quality materials. Draft, refine, and present comprehensive strategic updates, specifically including Monthly Business Reviews, Quarterly Roadmap Reviews, and Board of Directors presentations. Advanced Reporting & Dashboards: Exercise meticulous attention to detail by pulling and synthesizing reporting from a variety of systems to update engineering stakeholders and leadership. Design, build, and maintain operational dashboards linking Jira and security data to accurately illustrate program delivery performance and key performance indicators (KPIs). Drive Roadmap Creation: Lead quarterly planning and roadmap development in collaboration with the Information Security leader and security functions. Drive Communication and Enablement: Champion the enablement of security initiatives and programs across a global audience. Manage Security Incident Response: Assist with incident response activities to ensure a swift and effective resolution of security breaches. items.title: Senior SEO Manager at Spotlight Sports Group
items.summary: Spotlight Sports Group is a global media and technology company with a clear purpose, to set the standard for trusted, customer-driven experiences across global racing and sports betting. Guided by our mission to create experiences that fans love, we combine more than 40 years of heritage with bold innovation to deliver award-winning content, data
items.description: Spotlight Sports Group is a global media and technology company with a clear purpose, to set the standard for trusted, customer-driven experiences across global racing and sports betting. Guided by our mission to create experiences that fans love, we combine more than 40 years of heritage with bold innovation to deliver award-winning content, data and digital products. With over 400 employees worldwide, our portfolio includes Racing Post, myracing and Free Super Tips, as well as the international marketing agency ICS-digital and ICS-translate. Together, we partner with leading operators, affiliates and media groups to power growth and engagement across the industry. We are looking for a Senior SEO Manager to own Racing Post’s organic search strategy end to end. This is a hybrid role that combines on-page/content SEO, technical SEO and AI search optimisation in a single, high-impact position. You will be the department’s subject-matter expert and the person accountable for how Racing Post is found, cited and recommended across Google, Bing and emerging AI platforms. Accountabilities: Own the SEO strategy, roadmap and quarterly priorities, aligned to audience and affiliate revenue targets. Set KPIs, forecast impact and report clearly on performance to senior stakeholders, translating technical activity into commercial outcomes. Own the technical health of the site: crawlability, indexation, site architecture, XML sitemaps, canonicalisation, redirects, pagination and international or regional variants where relevant. Complete regular technical audits and log file analysis, identifying issues and specifying clear, prioritised tickets for developers. Lead Core Web Vitals and page speed improvements in partnership with engineering and product, as well as managing the structured data strategy at scale. Guide editorial and commercial teams on search-led content planning, including event-driven calendars (e.g. major racing festivals, sporting events) and Google Discover and Top Stories optimisation. Build and maintain scalable SEO frameworks, briefs and guidelines so that editors and content producers can apply best practice without direct involvement. Develop and lead the strategy for visibility in AI search and generative answer engines, defining how we track performance, manage crawler access and run experimentation. Optimise content for retrieval and citation by large language models, including clear entity definitions, authoritative sourcing, structured and answer-ready formatting, and strong E-E-A-T signals. Strengthen brand and entity signals across the wider web, working with PR, social and partnerships on authoritative mentions and digital PR that support both traditional and AI search. Work closely with editorial, commercial, affiliate, product, engineering, data and CRM teams, influencing priorities without direct authority. Monitor algorithm updates, SERP changes and competitor movements, adapting strategy quickly. Significant experience in SEO (typically 5+ years), with demonstrable hands-on expertise in both content/on-page and technical SEO. A proven track record of growing organic traffic and revenue, ideally in publishing, affiliate, iGaming, e-commerce or another high-volume, content-led environment. Experience in news SEO, including Google News, Discover and Top Stories. Strong technical knowledge: HTML, JavaScript rendering, site architecture, structured data, crawl and index management, and site speed. A clear understanding of how AI search and large language models surface and cite content, with evidence of testing or applying AI search optimisation approaches. Strong analytical skills, comfortable working with data, building dashboards and drawing out actionable insight. Experience using AI tools and workflows to improve SEO efficiency (e.g. content analysis, schema generation, reporting automation) is desirable. Knowledge of the sports betting, horse racing or sports media landscape is advantageous. We offer a range of well-being initiatives, including private medical insurance, excellent parental leave, a working globally policy, mental health support, assistance programs, and social gatherings. We also provide a pension scheme and various other benefit schemes. Plus, we all get our birthdays off work and enjoy 25 days of holiday per year. We’ve also got you covered with life assurance and exclusive perks like the Star card and our Step Further Awards (our employee recognition program) to recognise your dedication. You can also take advantage of complimentary access to our Racing Post Members Club, complete with an Ultimate Membership. We believe in making a positive impact beyond the workplace, and you’ll have the chance to volunteer two days per year with our charity partner.

items.description: Back-End Programming Headquarters: Poland - Remote Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work. Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. About the Role: You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike’s Backend Reliability (BRE) team is the backbone of our backend infrastructure and the guardian of our uptime. Our mission is to achieve and sustain 99.99% availability while building the tools, components, and safety nets that the entire engineering organization relies on. As a Senior / Staff Backend Engineer on this team, you won’t just close tickets - you’ll architect core reliability solutions that shape how Wrike scales, performs, and recovers from failure. Your Impact: Design, build, and maintain critical reliability components such as HTTP rate limiters, internal DB schema migration tools, circuit breakers, and distributed Redis-based caching. Troubleshoot complex production issues, optimize PostgreSQL usage, and ensure our distributed systems remain performant and stable under high load. Lead preliminary investigations during severe production incidents: identify likely root causes, assess impact, and propose mitigation options. The long-term fixes are then implemented by the owning team, based on your findings. Create scalable, reusable tools and frameworks that help other engineering teams build more resilient services. Leverage AI-powered tools and coding agents to accelerate development, analyze architectures, and automate repetitive or error-prone tasks. Influence reliability best practices across engineering by sharing knowledge, reviewing designs, and setting high technical standards. Your Qualifications: Strong expertise with Java/JVM, building scalable, high-performance backend systems; open to leveraging other languages when appropriate. Solid understanding of distributed systems concepts, including high availability, CAP theorem, and fault tolerance. Deep experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and key–value / non-relational storages (Redis). Practical experience with containerization and cloud-native environments, including Docker and Kubernetes. Hands-on experience with message brokers such as RabbitMQ or Kafka. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, using critical thinking to question assumptions and validate your own decisions. Strong written and spoken English skills suitable for collaborating in an international engineering environment. Standout Qualities: Background in infrastructure engineering or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), including infrastructure-as-code practices. Experience leading technical initiatives, driving cross-team projects, and mentoring other engineers while remaining an individual contributor. Familiarity with observability and monitoring stacks (e.g., Graylog, Zabbix, Grafana) and/or data analytics tools such as BigQuery. A strong interest in how complex systems fail and a track record of designing them to recover gracefully. Team Dynamics: You will join the Backend Reliability (BRE) team, a small, highly specialized, senior group focused solely on Wrike’s reliability. The team operates as an internal “reliability task force,” partnering closely with product and platform engineering teams across the company. You’ll collaborate with other senior engineers who value autonomy, deep technical discussions, and rigorous engineering practices. The culture is ownership-driven: you are trusted to manage your time, make architectural decisions, and drive initiatives to completion. Our Work Style: The BRE team works on core backend and infrastructure services that support millions of users. We operate in a collaborative environment that values clear communication, thoughtful design, and fast feedback loops. Tech focus areas include: Java/JVM-based services, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, RabbitMQ/Kafka, and observability/monitoring tools. We encourage the use of modern AI-based tooling and coding agents as part of daily development and troubleshooting workflows. Work is organized with an emphasis on impact and reliability goals rather than ticket volume, giving you room for deep work and long-term improvements. Hybrid work mode (Prague, Czech Republic / Nicosia, Cyprus), with flexibility to balance focused individual work and collaborative sessions. What’s next? Interview with a Recruiter Technical interview System Design Interview Cultural interview Your recruitment buddy will be Aleksandar Chernev , Senior Technical Recruiter. #LI-AC1 Who Is Wrike and Our Culture We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow. Hybrid work mode Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations. While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection. Our persona Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched. Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too! Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful. Our culture and Values Customer-Focused We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind. Collaborative We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement. Creative We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions. Committed We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth. Check out our LinkedIn Life Page , Company culture page , Instagram , Wrike Engineering Team , Medium , Meetup.com , Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wrike-staff-software-engineer-1

items.title: Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer at Compass Education
items.summary: Come shape the future of education with us. At Compass, we’re on a mission to transform the school day for everyone - from staff and students to families and administrators. We build smart, seamless technology that empowers schools to focus on what really matters: learning, growing and thriving. That mission has fuelled our growth into a global sca
items.description: Come shape the future of education with us. At Compass, we’re on a mission to transform the school day for everyone - from staff and students to families and administrators. We build smart, seamless technology that empowers schools to focus on what really matters: learning, growing and thriving. That mission has fuelled our growth into a global scale-up, now supporting 5,500+ schools across three countries, backed by a team of 300+ people. Our all-in-one school management platform is redefining how education communities connect, communicate and operate. About the role: We’re looking for a Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer to help run the cloud and co-location environments that keep Compass available for schools every day. You’ll join a team that owns our two core environments: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for cloud workloads and NextDC for physical and virtualised infrastructure, with a footprint in the EU and UK. You’ll work closely with our Cyber Security team and build depth across both environments over time. The role includes participation in our out of hours support roster. Responsibilities: Provision and manage GCP infrastructure using Terraform, and contribute to infrastructure design decisions Support the management of GCP project structure, IAM, networking and cost optimisation across shared and customer-specific environments, including secrets and credential lifecycle through GCP Secrets Manager Support day-to-day management of physical and virtualised infrastructure at NextDC, including server provisioning, networking and hardware lifecycle Administer and maintain our Apache CloudStack environment, managing compute, storage and networking through Terraform Run tape backup and disaster recovery processes, and contribute to business continuity planning Monitor GCP and NextDC infrastructure for security, availability, performance and cost anomalies, using Zabbix and related tooling Join the rotating out-of-hours support roster, resolving incidents methodically using runbooks and escalation paths Maintain and improve runbooks and documentation for common incidents and operational procedures Work with our Senior Cyber Security Engineer on security hardening, vulnerability management and compliance (ISO, GDPR), making sure changes are reviewed against security standards before they reach production About you: This role suits an engineer with 3-5 years of experience who communicates clearly, takes ownership of their work and is keen to grow across the stack. You will bring 3-5 years of experience in infrastructure, cloud or systems engineering Hands-on experience with GCP (or another major cloud platform), or with virtualised on-premises or co-location infrastructure, and an interest in growing into the other Working knowledge of Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool Scripting skills for automation (Bash, Python or similar) Experience working in an on-call or incident response roster Clear communication, with the ability to explain infrastructure decisions to technical and non-technical colleagues A disciplined approach to documentation and automation, a drive to reduce toil, and use of AI tooling and scripting to speed up your work Exposure to both cloud and co-location environments (highly regarded) Experience with Apache CloudStack, VMware or similar virtualisation platforms, and familiarity with ISO and GDPR requirements (highly regarded) Our tech stack: We’ll support you to build depth across the stack over time. Cloud: Google Cloud Platform (primary), with a small legacy AWS footprint Co-location: NextDC, Apache CloudStack, VMware or equivalent IaC and CI/CD: Terraform, GitLab CI/CD Monitoring and logging: Zabbix, Opsgenie, Grafana, Logstash, GCP Logging Edge and secrets: Cloudflare (DNS, CDN, WAF), GCP Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault Why Join Compass? You’ll join a purpose-driven company at a genuinely exciting stage of growth, with the opportunity to make a real impact on education at scale. What We Offer Flexible working: A hybrid working environment, with collaboration and connection across our office hubs. Learning and development: Opportunities to grow your skills, supported by a dedicated professional development budget. Wellbeing support: 24 ⁄ 7 access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), including face-to-face, phone and live chat support. Parental leave: A dedicated parental leave program for both primary and secondary carers. Inclusive culture: A supportive and collaborative workplace where your ideas, contributions and voice are valued. Team connection: Opportunities to connect, collaborate and celebrate successes with colleagues. Compass is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Prior to Commencing Employment, You’ll Need A valid Employee Working With Children Check A satisfactory National Police Check Verification of unrestricted work rights in Australia (e.g. citizenship, passport or birth certificate) Ready to Apply? If you’re excited about building and running the infrastructure that keeps Compass available for schools, we’d love to hear from you. Find out more about Compass on our website: www.compass.education.

PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices,…
items.description: What is PerfectServe? PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue. PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians. Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach: In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years. At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward. If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place! The Customer Success Advisor (CSA) owns the day-to-day relationship with a portfolio of PerfectServe customers, with a focus on Lightning Bolt Scheduling. This role builds trusted customer relationships, helps teams get more value from the product, and improves adoption, workflows, and overall satisfaction. The CSA works closely with customers and internal PerfectServe teams to resolve issues, support optimization efforts, strengthen retention, and identify opportunities where additional PerfectServe solutions may help customers meet their goals. Responsibilities Serve as a strong advocate for customers and end users, representing their needs within the PerfectServe organization Build trusted day-to-day relationships with customer stakeholders, including executive sponsors, department and service line leaders, and key practice administrators. Partner with customers to ensure they are fully leveraging Lightning Bolt Scheduling to achieve desired business outcomes Develop strong product and workflow expertise, including a clear understanding of scheduling processes and how Lightning Bolt Scheduling can help customers improve them. Use Salesforce, Zendesk, Pendo, and Looker to monitor utilization, adoption trends, service request data, and account health; identify risks, resolve recurring issues, and improve customer satisfaction and retention. Lead process improvement and optimization initiatives that drive measurable value for customers Own and resolve escalated service issues, coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely and effective outcomes Collaborate with Account Executives and Technical Consultants to establish and execute customer account plans. Support renewal readiness and account health by coordinating with Account Executives or Sr. Contract Specialists as appropriate; for select lower-tier accounts, manage renewal paperwork and related Salesforce opportunity updates. Lead customer retention and save efforts when needed, keeping renewal risks visible and coordinating next steps based on account tier and customer needs. Use virtual engagement, scalable outreach, and in-app messaging to keep lower-ARR accounts informed, engaged, and connected to product value. Partner with internal teams across PerfectServe to coordinate customer-facing work and keep customer commitments moving forward. Maintain accurate customer documentation, meeting notes, and key account intelligence in Salesforce and Confluence. Travel to client sites as needed to support onboarding, training, adoption, and optimization initiatives Success Factors Strong technical aptitude and the ability to apply Lightning Bolt Scheduling to solve complex customer challenges A proactive, ownership-driven mindset with the ability to anticipate customer needs and act decisively A consultative approach to customer engagement, focused on guiding customers toward best-practice solutions Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively in high-pressure environments Proven ability to build and sustain strong professional relationships Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills Excellent written, verbal, and documentation skills Commercial judgment to recognize renewal risk, support tier-appropriate renewal activity, connect customer needs to growth opportunities, and partner effectively with Account Executives or Sr. Contract Specialists. Customer-focused ownership, follow-through, and professionalism when supporting complex or sensitive account needs. Essential Qualifications 4+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Professional Services, or a related customer-facing role. 2+ years of experience in supporting SaaS products; healthcare software experience strongly preferred Experience with scheduling workflows, clinical operations, or healthcare operations preferred. Experience using CRM, support ticketing, analytics, or customer engagement tools such as Salesforce, Zendesk, Looker, Pendo, or similar platforms preferred. Excellent verbal and written communication skills Available to travel up to 25% Why Join PerfectServe? At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission-driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation. We offer a salary range of $70,000 USD plus incentives per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and potential to grow within the team. The salary range listed for this role reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. compensation will be determined by a combination of factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, and the specific team or product area they support. We regularly review compensation across the company to ensure fairness and consistency. If you are a current employee and have questions about how your compensation aligns with our ranges, we encourage you to speak with your manager or People Operations. Benefits: Remote first work environment Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one. 401K - with match and immediately vested. 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy Internal Advancement Opportunities PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

items.description: Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision? Then Pennylane is the right place for you ! Our vision We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business. About us Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!) In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to : 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants 💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more... 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor . 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings 🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France! WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission While some companies count on marketing and sales to gain market share, we are a product-led company and we are investing primarily on building an innovative and scalable platform. Tech teams have a crucial role to play to achieve this goal. 👪 Team and context You’ll work within a DevOps team currently composed of 4 engineers, reporting to the Engineering Manager. You’ll collaborate closely with 300+ engineers to define and elevate performance, reliability and observability standards across the organization. You’ll be embedded in multidisciplinary product teams (Frontend & Backend), working closely with another DevOps Engineer and an Application Security Engineer. This is a high-impact role : you’re joining early and will help shape how reliability works at scale. 🏠 Offices The company's HQ are in Paris, but the whole Tech team is remote-first. You are thus free to work from wherever you want in Europe. 🎯 Your Missions Evangelize and simplify SRE practices across our engineering organization (300+ engineers). Proactively identify reliability and performance improvement opportunities - not just react to incidents. Define and evolve performance, metrics and observability standards (SLIs/SLOs, monitoring frameworks, alerting strategies). Scale production resources efficiently while ensuring resilience and cost awareness. Design, implement and continuously improve tooling and monitoring systems. Contribute to engineering guidelines and best practices around reliability and production excellence. Collaborate closely with Product, Backend, Security and Platform stakeholders to embed reliability by design. 🥇 You're the right candidate if you have experience : Working with cloud environments (we use AWS). Building and evolving observability and monitoring systems (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk or similar). Scaling production systems and web applications, including asynchronous job systems. Operating in high-growth or product-led environments. Influencing engineering teams and driving reliability practices at scale. What do we do to make your work life easier 🏢 You'll be able to work remotely from anywhere in Europe, as long as your contract allows you to 💵 You’ll have a compensation package 📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us 🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it ⛹️Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness 🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your english or your french 💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment 🎉 You’ll be part of a vibrant social community : we do lots of sports together (Foot, running, climbing...), we love to hang out and have a drink together (thursday afterwork drinks on our rooftop is a usual thing. Twice-a-year we do company seminars, last time we went on a trip to Centerparcs and it was fabulous !) And.. If you're based in France : 🏢 You’ll be able to work fully from your home or any co-working space in France, or from our wonderful office in the center of Paris 🏝You’ll get between 8 to 13 additional days off (to the 25 standard ones) to rest and do what you love each year 🍜 You’ll have lunch credits (Swile card) to buy your favorite food every day 🏥 You’ll have a great healthcare cover (Alan Blue) to take care of yourself and your family We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries. What does the recruitment process look like ? Intro call with Technical Recruiter (30 min) Technical interview (1h) System design interview (1h) Final discussion with the Tech Leadership (1h) Encouraging diversity in all its forms, Pennylane strives to offer an inclusive, caring and fulfilling work environment in our offices and remotely. We provide equal opportunities and consideration regardless of background, origin, gender, religion, sexual orientation or handicap. 🇫🇷 Données personnelles Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : Notre data policy 🇬🇧 Personal Data Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more 🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren 🇪🇸 Datos personales Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

items.description: EverHelp is a team of professionals, that’s developing outsourcing support services for plenty of products all over the world at a dynamic tempo. The project launched in 2021, and last year we experienced a yearly growth rate of +82%. Since February 2022, we've managed to preserve all our workplaces and, most importantly, we continue to strengthen our team while maintaining an employee satisfaction rate of over 90%. In 2026, EverHelp received 9 international workplace and employer awards. The company ranked #1 in the Top 30 Inspiring Workplaces in Europe, was named the #1 employer among European companies with 500–4,999 employees, and earned Best-in-Class recognition across 6 categories: Culture & Purpose, Leadership, Inclusion & Belonging, Wellbeing, Employee Voice, and Employee Experience. EverHelp was also named one of the 28 Best Places to Work by Business Intelligence Group — a global award recognizing companies with strong workplace cultures and outstanding employee experience. Our statement: We’re against war and unjustified aggression, We evacuated all the teammates and their families from the frontline, helped them find a new place to live and provided financial support, We provided the team with charging stations, We continue to work together for the future of Ukraine. As EverHelp continues expanding its portfolio of international customer support projects, we are looking for a Customer Support Representative (Hospitality) to join our team. In this role, you will support guests of a fast-growing hospitality project, ensuring every interaction reflects genuine care, professionalism, and a guest-first mindset. You'll help resolve booking-related inquiries, reservation issues, and other service requests while creating an outstanding customer experience across multiple communication channels. Your future responsibilities include: Providing support to guests via phone calls, email, live chat, WhatsApp, and online booking platform messages; Assisting guests with booking inquiries, reservation updates, property access, and other accommodation-related requests; Delivering exceptional customer service with a genuine hospitality mindset and a "guest-first" approach; Resolving customer inquiries efficiently while maintaining a warm, professional, and empathetic communication style; Escalating critical cases, including refund requests, legal matters, or sensitive guest complaints, to the appropriate internal teams; Accurately documenting customer interactions and case details in internal systems; Collaborating closely with teammates to ensure a seamless guest experience across all communication channels; Following internal quality standards while balancing efficiency with exceptional service. Needed experience & skills: 1–3 years of experience in Customer Support, Hospitality, or another customer-facing role; German language proficiency (B2+) and English language proficiency (B2+); Experience communicating with customers across multiple channels, including calls and written communication; Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to make sound decisions independently; Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-first mindset; Ability to remain calm, professional, and solution-oriented in challenging situations; High adaptability and willingness to work in a dynamic, fast-changing environment; Strong multitasking skills while maintaining high service quality; Positive attitude, resilience, and genuine enthusiasm for teamwork. Work with EverHelp is about: 20+ vacation days and 10 paid sick leaves; Ability to work fully remotely; A professional team of specialists, ready to share their expertise, along with internal communities and team activities, fosters continuous learning and development both within the team and on an individual level; Opportunity for a career growth. 32% of our teammates obtained a new role during their first year of work in our company. 86% of our Team Leads have been our Customer Support Agents in the past. Submit your resume and join our team! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Senior Software Engineer, Verticals (AI Native)
items.summary: Headquarters: Canada URL: http://www.life360.com About Life360 Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver rep
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Canada URL: http://www.life360.com About Life360 Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries. Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family). Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com . Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above. We are AI Native We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process. Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy. About The Team This role sits on the Verticals team within Life360 — the group building the next frontier of meaningful connection beyond the core family circle. This role's initial focus is Aging in Place: helping aging parents stay safely independent while giving the families around them real peace of mind. Over time, this role may flex to support other emerging verticals — Things (Tile, connected trackers) or Pets — as priorities shift, so we're looking for someone who wants to help define the pattern for new member segments, not just ship one feature set. We are a product-minded, AI-Native engineering team. That means AI isn't just a tool we use — it's how we work. We've redesigned our team workflows around AI, treating it as a first-class collaborator at every stage: ideation, coding, testing, review, and iteration. We ship faster and go deeper because of it, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what that looks like at scale. About the Job Life360 is hiring an AI Native Senior Software Engineer — a senior engineer who doesn't just use AI tools, but thinks natively in them. You'll be central to how the Verticals team builds products. You'll design and build features that serve one of our most important and fastest-growing member segments: aging parents who want to stay safely connected with, and independent from, the families who care about them. As priorities change, you may also apply these same patterns to Things (connected trackers) or Pets. You will take full ownership of what you build from the first line of code through production, on-call, and the member impact it has. You obsess over the humans on the other end of the product, not just the ticket. Full-stack experience is required for this role — you should be comfortable moving between backend services and the mobile surfaces that expose them. Our stack spans Spring Boot microservices, Java, Kafka, and Kafka Streams on the backend, a modern cloud-native platform on AWS, and native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) apps on the client side. In your first year, success looks like having shipped end-to-end features serving the Aging in Place member segment and establishing at least one AI-native workflow the broader team adopts. For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $103,500 to $192,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is 149,500 to 177,500 CAD. Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers. Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) , as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits. What You’ll Do Ship end-to-end across the stack — from backend services and APIs through to the iOS and Android surfaces members use, serving tens of millions of users — moving between layers as the feature demands. Work with AI (Claude Code) as a first-class collaborator — orchestrate agents to create specs, generate code, and perform reviews, moving faster without sacrificing quality. Define and codify AI-Native engineering practices for the Verticals team, establishing playbooks the broader org can adopt. Collaborate closely with product managers and designers to turn complex user problems into scalable engineering solutions. Contribute to architectural decisions, code reviews, and a culture of craft and continuous improvement. Participate in on-call rotation and incident response. Mentor team members and contribute to team processes and technical standards. Support performance, reliability, and accessibility across the features you own. Adapt patterns and services built for Aging in Place to future verticals (Things, Pets) as team scope expands. What We’re Looking For 4+ years of experience building and operating high-quality, consumer-scale services. 1+ years of hands-on experience prompting, evaluating, and building with LLMs. Full-stack proficiency spanning backend services (Java, Spring Boot, Kafka) and mobile client development (Swift for iOS and/or Kotlin for Android), with the versatility to work across the whole stack as needed. Hands-on experience with agentic workflows, prompt engineering, context window management, and MCP/function calling. A track record of using AI tooling to multiply your own output — not just as autocomplete, but as a development partner. A strong sense of ownership — you don't wait to be told what to fix, and you follow through past "it works on my machine" to "it works for the member, in production, at scale." Strong communication and collaboration skills — you work well with product, design, and platform engineers. Excitement for defining what it means to be AI-Native — you're not waiting for the playbook, you want to write it. Empathy for the humans behind the product — an aging parent trying to stay independent, or a family member trying to help from afar. Bachelor's Degree in a Technical field, or equivalent experience. Nice-to-Have Experience with IoT, telematics, or embedded/hardware-adjacent systems. Familiarity with Kafka, Kinesis, or other high-throughput streaming platforms. Background with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, DataDog). AI-Native Expectations We use AI coding tools as a professional standard on this team. Here's what that means in practice: Daily use: You use AI coding assistants (we support Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot) for real, substantive tasks: analysis, coding, refactoring, testing, navigating codebases, and documentation. Not just research or autocomplete but as a development partner. Judgment and ownership: AI-generated code gets the same review you'd give any PR. You are accountable for everything you ship. Velocity: We expect senior engineers who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage — doing more with the same time, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team. Team leadership: You share what works. You automate prompting strategies that others can build on and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed. Continuous learning: The tooling is changing fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team when something would meaningfully improve how we work. Our Benefits Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees. 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees. Paid parental leave. Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being. Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns. Learning & Development programs. Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment. Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers. AI Usage: We use AI to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Life360 hiring teams Life360 Values Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust. Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard. Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families. High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done. Our Commitment to Belonging Life360 is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected status. We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and we’re building a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. Don’t meet every qualification? Apply anyway. #LI-Remote ____________________________________________________________________________ To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/life360-senior-software-engineer-verticals-ai-native

items.title: Content Creator - YouTube
items.summary: Important: Applications without an intro video will not be considered. Job Overview Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media. About us Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them. We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone. We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world. What you'll do Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way. Write video scripts and outlines. Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos. Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor. What we're looking for Native-level written and spoken English Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work Ability to take feedback and continuously improve Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada Nice to have Previous experience creating educational video content Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos Working at Metics Media At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work. At the same time, you'll get hands-on support, feedback, and training from people with over 8 years of experience making YouTube videos. Compensation Base salary: $70,000 USD per year (US) / CA$80,000 per year (Canada) Profit sharing: Earn a percentage of the profit generated by every video you create, paid out quarterly For reference, our current creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed. Benefits 15 days of paid vacation per year, plus public holidays 10 paid sick days per year Medical, dental, and vision coverage A 401(k) with employer contributions (US) How to apply Applications require a short intro video (max. 5 minutes) and your CV. Click "Apply" for all details.

items.title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
items.summary: Job Title: Patient Care Advocate Job Location: Remote About Us: We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. Role Overview: As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. What You’ll Do: Patient Enrollment & Eligibility : Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. Prescription Coverage : Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. Cost-Sharing & Payment : Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. Prescription Fulfillment : Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. Refills & Continued Use : Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. Program Renewal & Updates : Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. What We’re Looking For: High school diploma or GED required Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus) Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment Success Factors for Working from Home Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. Ergonomics : A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. Reliable Internet Connection : Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace : A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. Tech-Savvy : Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. Self-motivation & Independence : Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. Communication Skills : Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. Adaptability : Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. Compensation & Perks Hourly Pay : $16.50 per hour Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. Comprehensive Benefits : Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. Cell Phone Benefits : $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). Generous Referral Program : Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. Comprehensive Training : Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. Career Growth : Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. Work-from-Home Convenience : Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. Inclusive Culture : We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. What Success Looks Like: Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance Why Join Us? Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors Competitive compensation and benefits package A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture Ready to Make an Impact? Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!
